DoorDash Help Guide

DoorDash’s official customer help, gathered into one screen-reader-friendly document

2026-07-29

DoorDash Help Guide

This guide gathers DoorDash’s official help for customers: getting started, placing and tracking orders, delivery, payments and refunds, DashPass, promotions, accessibility, alcohol orders, managing your account, and troubleshooting. It was taken from DoorDash’s own help centre on 28 July 2026.

DoorDash runs on the web and as a phone app. There is no Windows program and no Alexa skill, so the usual four-interface scope narrows to those two.

The sections below are DoorDash’s own categories, and each article sits where DoorDash files it; anything the categories do not reach is gathered at the end. Help for Dashers, for merchants, and for business accounts lives in separate estates for different audiences and is not included here.

A word about what is in the promotions material. DoorDash publishes the terms of every offer and challenge it runs as help articles, and there are a great many of them — a large part of this guide is promotional terms rather than instructions. They are kept because they are part of the help centre and because the terms of an offer you are enrolled in are worth being able to read, but if you are looking for how something works, the earlier sections are where it lives.

Headings run three deep: this title, then a category, then an article, with each article’s own subheadings nested beneath. Every article is listed in the table of contents below.

Alcohol Orders

Alcohol warning and deactivation guidelines

Alcohol Delivery Rules for Consumers

As part of our commitment to responsible alcohol delivery, we have in place clear and common sense rules to ensure alcohol is delivered safely and in compliance with law.

Our goal is, and always has been, to enforce these rules fairly and consistently. If we receive a report that a rule has been violated, we investigate it further to understand what happened.

Depending on the nature and severity of the violation by a consumer, DoorDash may take a range of actions including issuing a warning, blocking any further alcohol orders or removal from the platform.

Rules for Consumers

For alcohol delivery, consumers must not:

  • Use a fake ID, expired ID or someone else’s ID.

  • Refuse or decline to provide an ID

  • Order or accept alcohol if they are under the legal drinking age (21 in the US)

  • Harass, threaten or intimidate a Dasher

  • Be intoxicated or under the influence when accepting an alcohol delivery

  • Provide alcohol to anyone under the legal drinking age

There are other requirements of consumers, including being present to collect an alcohol order. Failure to follow these rules will result in an investigation and a corresponding enforcement decision based on the severity of non-compliance.

We appreciate your partnership as we continue our efforts as a leader in the marketplace space as a responsible, safe, and compliant alcohol delivery service.

Do I need my ID to pick up my alcohol order?

Do I need my ID to pick up my alcohol order?

Yes. Dashers will ask for an ID and use proprietary technology on their smartphones to check the validity of a customer’s form of identification. Upon delivery, you may be asked to produce your ID along with the credit card used to make the purchase.

Don’t want to see or receive alcohol on DoorDash?

Don’t want to see or receive alcohol on DoorDash?

SELF-EXCLUSION

If you do not wish to receive alcohol items on DoorDash, you are able to voluntarily exclude yourself from having alcohol delivered via our Marketplace platform.

Excluding yourself from alcohol delivery will also exclude you from direct marketing communication surrounding DoorDash’s alcohol-related promos. Click here to submit your exclusion request.

If you wish to order alcohol items again on DoorDash Marketplace, you can submit your request to terminate the exclusion period using the same form.

DoorDash Alcohol Help Page

DoorDash Alcohol Support Resources

DoorDash is committed to the delivery of alcohol safely and compliantly and has put several guardrails in place in order to prevent under age drinking and promote responsible drinking. If alcohol is harming you or someone you know, it may be time to seek advice from a professional. Reach out to your primary care provider, local health service or call/chat online with one of the services listed below.

If you need immediate help, please contact 1 (866) 314-6572

______________________________________________________________________________________________

DoorDash is proud to have corporate partnerships with Responsibility.org and Students Against Destructive Decisions (SADD) - aimed at promoting alcohol responsibility and preventing under age drinking. The company has partnered with Responsibility.org, a national not-for-profit that aims to eliminate drunk driving and underage drinking and empower adults to make a lifetime of responsible alcohol choices as part of a balanced lifestyle. Responsibility.org will help DoorDash continue to advance its corporate responsibility initiatives surrounding alcohol delivery, provide guidance for future product builds based on their industry-leading research and provide shared resources surrounding responsible decision making with DoorDash customers. Additionally, DoorDash has teamed up with Students Against Destructive Decisions (SADD) in order to open the dialogue around preventing underage drinking through online purchases.

How is my age verified for alcohol orders?

How is my age verified for alcohol orders?

There is a two-step process for age verification.

  1. To check out: DoorDash offers a one-time process to check your age when ordering alcohol. Provided you are of legal drinking age, after you upload a photo of your ID, you’ll be able to check out and complete your order.

  2. To receive your order: Dashers will do a physical examination of the recipient’s ID and will also scan the front of that ID to run a variety of compliance checks. Provided these checks are successful, you will receive the alcohol order.

What information is shared with the Dasher?

  • Only necessary information - your first name and last initial - will be shared with the Dasher prior to delivery. When the Dasher arrives at your delivery location, they will be prompted to physically check your ID and also scan the front of your ID before handing off your order. They will not be able to view your address after the order is complete, nor will they have a copy of your ID (see below for more info).

Does the Dasher keep my ID on their phone?

  • No, the Dasher does not keep your ID on their phone. Your ID is scanned via the DoorDash Dasher app and retained by DoorDash in alignment with the security measures described below. Your ID information will not be available to the Dasher once the scan is complete. The ID scan process takes place entirely within the DoorDash Dasher app.

Where does my data go after it’s been scanned?

  • We may share this information with third parties located in the United States, for storage and processing. DoorDash security and privacy teams review such third parties for compliance with our security and privacy requirements.

Will I need to complete this process when ordering alcohol again?

  • Once you go through and pass the age checking procedure before your first alcohol delivery, you won’t be required to do it again to checkout until the ID you used expires(see below)! Your information will be stored securely for future alcohol purchases.

  • When your ID expires, you will be prompted to upload a new ID. That new ID, which will go through age checking procedures again, will replace the expired ID and will be stored securely on file so you do not need to go through another scan at checkout.

  • Note: to reiterate the above, each time a Dasher arrives at your delivery location, they will be prompted to physically check your ID and also scan the front of your ID before handing off your order.

What if I want DoorDash to change or remove my ID?

  • To change your ID, select “Change ID” on your next alcohol purchase and upload a new ID for age verification. If you’d like to remove your ID entirely, please visit the Manage Account center here.

Why does DoorDash scan IDs when it also does visual verification?

  • DoorDash takes our legal obligations seriously and our goal is to comply with applicable laws and otherwise set leading responsibility and safety standards for this industry. We take these precautions as a safety measure and to document our process for age checking purposes.

What if I’m not available for the order?

  • Alcohol purchases require in-person delivery. If you or a 21+ recipient are not available, the Dasher will abandon the order and take the items back to the store.

** What if someone else receives the order?**

  • If the order is received on your behalf, the Dasher will ask to check the recipient’s age and scan a valid government issued ID to help ensure they are of legal age.

  • If you believe the order was incorrectly delivered to someone else, please contact DoorDash Support.

What about a gift order?

  • If you are sending a gift order, the Dasher will be prompted to check the recipient’s age and also run a scan on a valid government issued ID.

How do I know my photo ID is stored securely?

  • DoorDash takes the security of your personal data seriously. We recognize that the information on your ID may be considered sensitive or biometric information.

    • We implement security controls to handle the information on your ID with due care, in consideration of what is appropriate for information that may be sensitive in nature.

    • We limit our retention of information collected from your state issued identification, basing our retention period on what is required under applicable laws or to the extent needed for legitimate business purposes. While in certain instances we may retain your ID information for up to 3 years and your signature for up to 6 years, we do not always retain it for that length of time. If we can verify that we do not need to retain your information to prevent fraud, demonstrate our legal and regulatory compliance, or for another legitimate business purpose, we will delete it. We will not sell this information or share it with third parties for other commercial purposes.

    • We limit our use of the ID information we collect and use it for the limited purposes of fraud prevention, to demonstrate our legal and regulatory compliance and similar legitimate business purposes. We will not sell this information or use it for other commercial purposes.

    • To learn more about how we protect your data, read our privacy policy here.

DoorDash Alcohol Support Resources

DoorDash is committed to the delivery of alcohol safely and compliantly and has put several guardrails in place in order to help prevent underage drinking and promote responsible drinking. If alcohol is harming you or someone you know, it may be time to seek advice from a professional. Reach out to your primary care provider, local health service or call/chat online with one of the services listed below.

If you need immediate help, please contact 1 (866) 785-9796.

SELF-EXCLUSION

If you do not wish to receive alcohol items on DoorDash, you are able to voluntarily exclude yourself from having alcohol delivered via our Marketplace platform. Excluding yourself from alcohol delivery will also exclude you from direct marketing communication surrounding DoorDash’s alcohol-related promos.

Click here to submit your exclusion request.

If you wish to order alcohol items again on DoorDash Marketplace, you can submit your request to terminate the exclusion period using the same form.

DoorDash is proud to have corporate partnerships with Responsibility.org and Students Against Destructive Decisions (SADD) - aimed at promoting alcohol responsibility and preventing under age drinking. The company has partnered with Responsibility.org, a national not-for-profit that aims to eliminate drunk driving and underage drinking and empower adults to make a lifetime of responsible alcohol choices as part of a balanced lifestyle. Responsibility.org will help DoorDash continue to advance its corporate responsibility initiatives surrounding alcohol delivery, provide guidance for future product builds based on their industry-leading research and provide shared resources surrounding responsible decision making with DoorDash customers. Additionally, DoorDash has teamed up with Students Against Destructive Decisions (SADD) in order to open the dialogue around preventing underage drinking through online purchases.

What if I don’t have an ID to pick up my order?

What if I don’t have an ID to pick up my order?

Dashers have the right to refuse to deliver alcoholic beverages in the event that the customer is not in compliance with our alcohol terms and conditions. A few scenarios in which a dasher will refuse delivery include instances where the customer is not able to produce a valid government issued ID, the customer is not 21 years or older, the customer’s name on the order does not match their ID, or the customer is clearly intoxicated.

Backup Payment Method FAQ

Backup Payment Method FAQ

In this article

  • What is a backup payment method?

  • What happens if the default payment method fails?

  • What happens if both the default and backup payment methods fail?

  • Will I be notified when a backup payment is used?

  • How does backup payment work for scheduled orders?

  • What if you do not want backup payments to be used?

  • If a backup payment method was used for my order, but I want to pay with a different card, how can I switch to my preferred payment method?

  • After placing an order using a backup payment method, how long do I have to change the payment method?

  • What are valid backup payment methods?

  • What payment methods are not valid?

Q: What is a backup payment method?

A: A backup payment method is a feature that allows you to set an alternative payment method to be used if the default payment method fails or is unsuccessful. If the default payment attempt is unsuccessful, DoorDash will automatically select the next most frequently used alternative payment method to retry the transaction and ensure the order goes through without disruption. This process helps minimize any interruptions.

Q: What happens if the default payment method fails?

A: If the default payment method fails during a transaction, the system automatically retries the next most frequently used payment method to ensure the order goes through seamlessly.

Q: What happens if both the default and backup payment methods fail?

A: If both available payment methods fail, you will be notified with clear instructions on how to resolve the issue. This may include updating payment details or selecting an alternative payment method.

Q: Will I be notified when a backup payment is used?

A: Yes, you will receive real-time updates via the DoorDash app that the backup payment method is used, including transaction details and a link to update payment settings if needed.

Q: How does backup payment work for scheduled orders?

A: For scheduled orders, if the default payment method fails, the system will automatically retry the next most frequently used payment method.

Q: What if you do not want backup payments to be used?

A: You can disable the backup payment feature in your payment settings at any time. Disabling this feature will require you to manually resolve any issues with failed payments, which may result in order delays or cancellations.

Q: If a backup payment method was used for my order, but I want to pay with a different card, how can I switch to my preferred payment method?

A: You can change the payment method for the current order directly from the receipt page in the DoorDash app. By updating the payment method there, the order will be charged to the new selected payment method, and the amount previously charged to the backup payment method will be refunded.

Q: After placing an order using a backup payment method, how long do I have to change the payment method?

A: You have up to 7 days after an order is placed using a backup payment method to switch the payment method for the existing order.

Q: What are valid backup payment methods?

A: Valid payment methods include Credit/Debit Cards, PayPal, Venmo, and CashApp.

Q: What payment methods are not valid?

A: Payment methods that are not valid include Apple Pay, Google Pay, SNAP/EBT, and HSA/FSA.

  • What happens if the picture is blurry?

  1. Please make sure you are in a well-lit environment

  2. That your device has a camera with good clarity

  3. That you position your credit card within the border shown on the screen

Combined Charges

Combined Charges

To simplify your billing, DoorDash may combine multiple orders you place close together into a single charge, instead of charging you separately for each one. Your cost breakdown per order stays the same — you’re just billed together instead of individually.

Example: If you place a $40 order in the morning and a $70 order later on, you may see a single $110 charge on your card rather than two separate charges. You can still see the breakdown for each order in your order history and receipts.

You will also see the Combined charges show up in your order history and can drill down into the details

This feature isn’t available for business profiles, for orders greater than $100 or orders paid with PayPal, Venmo, Cash App, Klarna, SNAP/EBT and HSA/FSA cards.

Opt out

You can update your payment frequency anytime:

To change your payment frequency

  • Open the DoorDash app and go to the Me tab.

  • Tap Settings

  • Tap Payment, then Payment frequency.

  • Select your preferred option.

Consumer Profiles FAQ

Jump to: DoorDash Experts Program

How do I view my profile?

Download the latest Android or iOS app. Click the profile icon on the top right corner of your screen to go to the Account page. Click the header with your name to view your profile.

What can I do on my profile?

From your profile, view all your store ratings, item ratings, approved public reviews and photos in a single place. Coming soon - more awesome features like the ability to curate your profile, see the impact your contributions are making for others, and more!

Why am I not seeing my review or photo on my profile?

Once approved, publicly submitted reviews and photos will show on your profile. If you do not see your review or photo, your content may still be pending moderation. If you selected “Store feedback” rather than “Everyone” (i.e., public review) as the audience when submitting a review, your review will be sent directly to the merchant and DoorDash and it will not appear on your profile. For more information, please visit our content guidelines for reviews and photos.

How can I see what others are saying / see other people’s profiles?

Anywhere you see other customer’s reviews and photos, tap the person’s name to view their profile

What will others see on my profile?

If your profile is public, anyone will be able to see your contributions, including approved public reviews, approved photos, store ratings, and item ratings alongside with some information about you (your first name, last initial, profile picture, and local expert status). In the future, we may allow other users to connect with you on the DoorDash platform, and having a public profile will mean these users can also see your public activity–such as your approved photos and public reviews.

A restricted profile will only display your first name, last initial, profile picture, and number of public contributions (but not the contents of any contribution). Even if you have a restricted profile, your public contributions will still display on the merchant’s store page.

Your profile (whether public or restricted) will not include any Dasher ratings.

See “How do I change my profile’s privacy settings” for more information.

How do I change my profile’s privacy settings?

From your profile, click “Edit profile”. You can toggle between a public profile and a restricted profile at any time. You can also change your name from this page.

A Public profile will allow anyone to see your profile and any photos, ratings, and public reviews submitted on your profile.

A Restricted profile will only display your first name, last initial, profile picture, and number of public contributions (but not the contents of any contribution). Publicly submitted individual reviews and photos will still be visible on store pages.

DoorDash Experts Program

What is a Local Expert? What about an Emerging Expert?

DoorDash’s Experts Program is available to select users in select U.S. markets. Local Experts are fellow DoorDash users who have ordered from and left high quality public reviews and/or photos for 10 or more restaurants. These users leave helpful reviews across many restaurants in their neighborhood after they order.

Emerging Experts are users that have left high quality reviews and/or photos on at least 3 restaurants. These users are well on their way to becoming Local Experts! Once they submit 10 high quality reviews, they will be upgraded to Local Expert status, which will be reflected in their profile.

Some users may not be eligible for our Experts Program based on additional criteria, for example:

  • Inactive Users: Users who have not placed any DoorDash orders in the last 12 months – this ensures that our Local Expert cohort is up to date with the available restaurants in their neighborhoods

  • Violators of our Terms and Conditions: Users who have at any time violated DoorDash’s Community Guidelines for written reviews or photos or violated DoorDash’s Consumer Terms and Conditions – this ensures the safety of our community

  • Biased reviewers: Users who do not maintain balanced review content sentiment as determined by DoorDash – this ensures that our Local Expert cohort hosts a diversity of opinions and is invested in maintaining honest feedback

DoorDash reserves the right to change our Local Expert and Emerging Expert eligibility criteria at any time and without notice to you. Selection for Local Expert and Emerging Expert status and ability to participate in our Experts Program is entirely at DoorDash’s discretion.

How do I know who is a Local expert?

You’ll be able to tell who a Local expert is based on their profile badge showing on the reviews they’ve left.

If someone is a Local expert, you’ll see their expert badge, title, and their total number of contributions.

If someone is an Emerging expert, you’ll see their title and total number of contributions.

If someone is Neither, you will just see their number of contributions.

How do I know if I’m an Emerging Expert or a Local Expert?

From your profile, you can view all of your contributions in one place and can see if you qualify as a Local expert. Navigate to your profile to view your current status and see how many more reviews you need to submit to level up to Local Expert.

What makes a Local Expert an “expert?”

Local experts are determined by how many high quality posts a user submits. Once a review (including both written text and photos) is submitted, they are evaluated for adherence to our Community Guidelines and for overall usefulness and quality by the DoorDash team.

Written reviews are considered to be high quality when the content is both relevant and useful to other users and have specific details about the food or the restaurant. For example, reviews that mention specific dishes, portion sizes, and the value are helpful for other users and are considered high quality.

Photos are considered to be high quality when they accurately reflect the food and clearly show the dish in the photo. For example, photos that are well-lit with the dish fully visible (all packaging removed) are considered high quality.

Examples of high quality posts (including written text & photo content)

How do I become a Local Expert?

DoorDash’s Local experts program is not available for all users in all regions.

If you are not a Local expert today and are eligible to become one, you can do so by simply submitting high quality review content for 10 unique restaurants. To ensure the Local Experts cohort is grounded in helpful, robust, and comprehensive review content, only high quality posts are counted towards Local expert status. These reviews can be for past DoorDash orders or experiences with this store outside of DoorDash. For more information on how to submit reviews, see our How to submit reviews page.

To view your progress to “Local Expert” click the progress banner from your profile.

DashAI Frequently Asked Questions

What can I use DashAI for?

  • DashAI helps you find the perfect restaurant to meet your needs. It will find nearby options based on the preferences you input, such as cuisine, dietary restrictions, or rating. DashAI is an experimental and evolving product powered by OpenAI. Please do not use or attempt to use DashAI for anything other than its intended purpose.

How does DashAI use my data?

  • In addition to what you input, DoorDash will share the zip code of your current delivery address with OpenAI to help show restaurants near you.

What does it mean that DashAI has no knowledge after September 2021?

  • DashAI is powered by OpenAI, specifically its large language models, which have no knowledge of the world and events after September 2021. This means, for example, that it does not know about any restaurants that have opened, closed, or been added to DoorDash since that date.

What do you mean by personal or sensitive information?

  • Anything you input in DashAI will be transmitted to OpenAI, so please do not input any personal information such as your name or home address, especially in association with sensitive personal information such as information relating to your health, allergies, or religious beliefs.

DoorDash Content Guidelines

DoorDash Content Guidelines

DoorDash strives to maintain a high level of integrity with respect to published user content, including ratings, reviews, photos, and videos. All user-submitted content is subject to approval before publishing. To maintain a safe and trustworthy community, any content that does not comply with DoorDash’s Content Guidelines will be removed. Per DoorDash’s Consumer Terms and Conditions, violations of the Content Guidelines may also result in account suspension or termination, subject to DoorDash’s discretion.

To ensure the authenticity of user feedback, DoorDash will never edit, alter, or change your review in any way. As such, we may be unable to publish reviews that do not meet our guidelines. Submitted photos and videos may be enhanced, modified, or compiled by DoorDash for use across our platform. For example, DoorDash may feature your submitted video snippet as part of a broader video highlighting a local restaurant. Photos may be lightly enhanced by DoorDash to correct issues such as blurriness or lighting.

Our Content Guidelines were created with fairness and equity in mind for both DoorDash customers and merchants. We value your honest feedback.

To flag a published review for extra moderation, please report the review to our team using this FORM.

Content Guidelines:

  • First Hand Customer Experience

  • Personally identifiable information (PII)

  • Relevance (Non-Merchant Content)

  • Food Safety

  • Spam and Fake Content

  • Solicitation

  • Profanity

  • Discriminatory or Derogatory Content

  • Sexually Explicit Content

  • Violence, Threats of Violence

  • Terroristic Content

  • Off Topic

  • Offensive Content

First Hand Customer Experience

Content submitted as feedback for a merchant must be based on a genuine, first-hand customer experience with the store. Non-patrons or customers with a conflict of interest, including current and former employees, competitors, investors, or owners, should not leave content for that store via our consumer facing DoorDash app. Content a business wishes to feature should be submitted solely via the Merchant Portal. Content which is suspected to be fraudulent will be removed, if available evidence supports the case for removal. DoorDash may take action against customers or merchants who repeatedly submit fraudulent content, including but not limited to account deactivation.

By submitting content, you represent you’re either the legal owner of the content in its entirety (including text, audio, photo, video) and/or have the legal right to submit such content for DoorDash to use (for example, to display on our platform). You also and acknowledge the content is governed by our Consumer Terms and Conditions.

Personally Identifiable Information (PII)

For your safety, content containing phone numbers, email addresses, physical addresses, social security numbers, personal social media accounts, or any other information considered personally identifiable will not be published.

Relevance (Non-Merchant Content)

Content submitted as feedback for a Merchant must pertain to your personal experience with a specific store (e.g. quality of items ordered, portion size, value for price). Only content containing relevant store content will be posted. This is to ensure that merchants do not receive negative commentary for issues (e.g. delivery related) that were outside of their control.

The following comments are considered delivery-related (and therefore not relevant to the merchant):

  • Dasher / Delivery feedback

  • Food temperature (e.g. “food was cold”, “food arrived hot”)

  • Arrival time

  • Food spillage

  • Food not received

The following comments are considered DoorDash platform-related (and therefore not relevant to the store):

  • Order canceled / not delivered

  • Single-serve accessories not provided (utensils, napkins, sauce packets)

  • Special instructions not followed

  • Issues placing order

  • Refund/ payment issues

  • Platform Fees

  • Issues with DoorDash app

Content not relevant to the store may not be published.

If you experienced a delivery-related or DoorDash platform-related issue, please see the following pages or visit our Consumer Help Center for resolution:

  • Missing or incorrect items

  • My food was delivered late

  • My special instructions weren’t followed

  • I never received my order

For faster resolution on delivery issues, use DoorDash’s Automated Help System.

Food Safety

In an emergency situation, please dial emergency services (911 for US/Canada, 000 for Australia, 111 for New Zealand) or visit your nearest Emergency Room.

If your content contains a food safety concern (e.g. foodborne illness, foreign object), we will do our best to redirect these to the appropriate team for investigation and resolution.

We encourage customers to reach out to our Consumer Support and Trust & Safety teams directly, where we can best address your concern:

  • If you were not satisfied with your food quality, please follow the instructions here to file a report

  • If you have experienced a serious allergic reaction or other serious food safety issue, please reach out to our Customer Support team here

Spam and Fake Content

Content which is suspected to be fraudulent will be removed. Content containing promotional content or external links are considered spam and will be removed.

Solicitation

At this time, DoorDash prohibits direct content solicitation from merchants. Stores should not request ratings, reviews, photos, videos, or other content directly from customers or offer incentives in exchange for content, as this constitutes a conflict of interest. Content which is suspected to be in connection with solicitation will be removed. DoorDash may occasionally offer incentives to customers for submission of content.

Profanity

Profanity of any kind, including mild profanity, acronyms, and profane symbols or emojis is not allowed. Please keep content appropriate for all members of our community.

Discriminatory or Derogatory Content

Community members are expected to exhibit respect toward everyone in the DoorDash community. Content that is dehumanizing, discriminatory, hateful, or bigoted, that threatens or advocates for harm, or that constitutes harassment, intimidation, or bullying is unacceptable and will not be published. This includes divisive symbols and imagery associated with discrimination.

DoorDash does not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race or ethnicity, religion, disability, age, nationality, sexual orientation, gender, or gender identity.

Sexually Explicit Content

Sexually explicit content will not be posted, regardless of intent. This includes reviews, photos, and videos that contain unwelcome or inappropriate sexual content, partial or full nudity, allusion to sexual acts or activities, emojis, and other content deemed sexually inappropriate. Please keep submitted content appropriate and respectful for all members of our community.

Violence, Threats of Violence

The safety of our community is extremely important, and we’re firmly committed to ensuring that everyone can use DoorDash safely and reliably. Any content or behavior that threatens or undermines the safety of our community is not tolerated. These include, but are not limited to:

  • Violent or gory content, including content referencing or depicting serious injury, death, or other bodily harms

  • Content or behavior that is physically or verbally threatening towards others and risks harm to people or property, including direct or implied threats of violence

  • Content that depicts cruelty to animals or people

DoorDash retains the right to take any action(s) deemed appropriate, including DoorDash account termination and reports to law enforcement.

In an emergency situation, please dial emergency services (911 for US/Canada, 000 for Australia, 111 for New Zealand) or contact local police.

Terroristic Content

The following is not allowed on our platform: Any commentary or photos that are viewed as supporting terrorism, terrorists and organized hate, any mention of a terrorist group or organization, any content that leads to radicalization or proclamation of a violent mission or recruitment. DoorDash retains the right to take any action(s) deemed appropriate, including DoorDash account termination and reports to federal agencies or local authorities.

Off Topic

Content submitted as feedback for a Merchant should be based on your experience with a specific store (see Relevance Non-Merchant Content). DoorDash is not intended as a forum for general political or social commentary. Off-topic content will not be published.

Offensive Content

DoorDash reserves the right to remove any content otherwise deemed inappropriate or offensive.

3. SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT GUIDELINES

  1. This Section 3 only applies when you post any content mentioning DoorDash or its products or services off-platform (whether or not such content is specifically connected to the Campaign).

  2. Affiliation with DoorDash must be conspicuously and clearly disclosed.

  3. Use platform-specific transparency tools (e.g., the “Branded Content” tools on Facebook and Instagram) in addition to (not as a substitute for) one of the following disclosures (Talent must also comply with all applicable platform-specific rules and guidelines):

    1. #DoorDash_Ambassador (when DoorDash hasn’t commissioned specific content)

    2. #ad (will also need clear statement from video/audio/caption that DoorDash is the sponsor of the post)

    3. “Sponsored by DoorDash”

    4. The following language as the opening (i.e. first) text of the post copy itself:

      1. “So [excited/happy/thrilled] to officially partner with DoorDash as brand ambassador”

      2. “I have partnered with DoorDash to promote its products”

      3. Note: If your mention of DoorDash is made audibly (for example, spoken in a video), the disclosure should be audible as well (e.g. speak the line: “So excited to officially partner with DoorDash…” or “as a DoorDash partner…”) in addition to text/written disclosure.

  4. Disclosure must be unavoidable (i.e. visible and prominently displayed)

    1. If using a hashtag disclosure: Disclosure must be the first hashtag (i.e. NOT be buried in the middle of other text or hashtags)

    2. For any disclosure format (hashtag or post copy):

      1. In-feed posts (e.g. Twitter, Facebook and IG grid posts): The disclosure must appear in first two lines of text

        1. Should not be buried in the middle or at the end of a series of hashtags, other disclosures or general copy

        2. Recommendation for hashtag disclosures: include as the first hashtag before copy/caption)

        3. If your mention of DoorDash is made audibly (for example, spoken in a video), the disclosure should be audible as well (e.g. speak the line: “So excited to officially partner with DoorDash…” or “as a DoorDash partner…”) in addition to text/written disclosure.

      2. Frame formats (e.g., IG stories, Snaps, TikToks):

        1. Must have text/written disclosure (audio disclosure is not sufficient)

          1. If your mention of DoorDash is made audibly (for example, spoken in a video), the disclosure should be audible as well (e.g. speak the line: “So excited to officially partner with DoorDash…” or “as a DoorDash partner…”) in addition to text/written disclosure.

        2. Disclosures must be large enough to read

        3. Disclosures must be easy to read or hear (as applicable). Consider the following:

          1. Contrast between text and rest of the frame (for written disclosures)

          2. How much time followers have to look at the frame (for written disclosures)

          3. How much competing text in the frame, etc. (for written disclosures)

          4. Speed, volume, and cadence (for audible disclosures)

          5. How close in time the disclosure is to the mention of DoorDash or its brand/product/service (for audible disclosures)

          6. Competing background music and other sounds (for audible disclosures)

        4. Written disclosures must be superimposed as text over images or video in each frame

      3. Videos (in-feed or frame):

        1. Disclosures must appear at the beginning of the video (within the video) as well as in the written video description (i.e. it’s NOT sufficient to make a disclosure only on the end card)

        2. Disclosures should appear long enough for a viewer to be able to read and understand it

        3. Disclosure must migrate (i.e. if Talent is posting on one social media platform and the post is syndicated to another social media platform, disclosures must travel with the post, and appear clearly and conspicuously (e.g. pre-click) on on all platforms)

      4. Livestream: Repeat disclosures throughout the stream to make sure that viewers joining at different times will hear them.

  5. General Do’s and Don’ts

    1. DO:

      1. Talent’s statements should always reflect Talent’s honest and truthful opinions and actual personal experiences and be typical of what the average consumer can expect to achieve.

      2. Make sure any claims about DoorDash products and/or services are substantiated (i.e. there is adequate proof to back up the claim)

      3. Talent should not comment on DoorDash competitors or their products and/or services, unless otherwise instructed by DoorDash to do so. If Talent comments on DoorDash competitors or their products and/or services (per DoorDash instructions), such comment cannot be understood to be malicious, misleading or deceptive, unfair, or unsubstantiated.

      4. Comply with the provisions of any applicable DoorDash policy and DoorDash instructions provided to Talent.

    2. DO NOT:

      1. Make deceptive or misleading claims about DoorDash products or services to consumers.

      2. Misrepresent the source of anything in their posted content, including impersonation of another individual or entity (other than that portrayed by Talent’s professional persona).

      3. Engage in defamation, libel, or slander.

      4. Use any content that is protected by intellectual property laws, rights of privacy or publicity, or any other applicable law unless Talent owns or controls all rights thereto or has received all necessary consents. For example, Talent may not post photos or video content without written permission from (1) the person who owns the photo or video and (2) any persons (other than Talent) depicted in the photo or video. Music must be royalty-free unless licenses/permissions have been secured.

      5. Offer for sale, or solicit, products or services on behalf of DoorDash without DoorDash’s prior written approval.

      6. Incite, advocate, or express hatred, ethnic slurs, bigotry, racism, or gratuitous violence.

      7. Use personal insults, pornography, vulgarity, profanity, obscenity, or other offensive language or content, nor depict nudity or sexually explicit content of any sort.

      8. Engage in any communication or disseminate content that is unlawful, harassing, or abusive.

      9. Promote excessive consumption of alcohol beverages, irresponsible consumption of alcohol beverages such as drunk driving or drinking under legal purchase age, or promote any illegal drug use.

      10. Provide or create links to external sites that violate any of the guidelines contained in this document.

      11. Use content that contains advertising for Talent or third parties (including, without limitation, money making schemes, discount cards, credit counseling, online surveys, or online contests).

      12. Engage in dangerous or unsafe activity or depict DoorDash or any of its affiliates, subsidiaries or merchant partners or any of their respective products in a manner that is inconsistent with DoorDash instructions.

DoorDash for Creators FAQs

DoorDash for Creators FAQs

How do I get started?

Read the DoorDash for Creators Agreement.

  1. Sign up. Visit creator.doordash.com. Log in to your DoorDash account, submit your application, and agree to the DoorDash for Creators Agreement.

  2. Upon application approval, you will receive a confirmation email from DoorDash and an account activation email from HyperWallet. Please check your Spam and Junk folders if you cannot find this email.Try searching for “” in your inbox.

4. Complete your HyperWallet account setup. Please ensure that your legal name, address, and tax identification number (TIN) are an exact match to IRS records. You must establish your HyperWallet account in order to receive payment.

5. Once your HyperWallet account is set up, you’ll be able to start submitting videos and earning money immediately.

Do I have to apply to join the DoorDash for Creators program?
  • Yes, participation in the program is subject to approval at DoorDash’s sole discretion. We review applications carefully to maintain program quality. DoorDash may, at its discretion, decline or remove applicants who do not meet our eligibility criteria, and in some cases, may limit future applications to keep the program fair and secure.
Does it cost anything to become a DoorDash Creator?
  • No, the program is completely free to apply and participate in. However, only eligible creators will be accepted into the program based on our current criteria. If you’re not accepted right away, don’t worry; you may become eligible in the future as the program expands.
What are the benefits of participating in the DoorDash for Creators program?
  • Creators get paid for their content and gain access to a first-of-its-kind food content program. You’ll reach new audiences through our platform, grow your brand, and spotlight local food spots with real impact. Plus, you’ll be part of a supportive, curated creator community.
Can I participate if I live outside of the United States?
  • Currently, DoorDash for Creators is open only to creators based in the United States. We’re not yet able to support participation from creators in U.S. territories — including Puerto Rico, American Samoa, Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands, and the U.S. Virgin Islands — due to tax and compliance limitations. We hope to expand eligibility in the future as the program grows.
I didn’t receive the HyperWallet account activation email.
  • First, check your spam, promotions, or junk folders and search for an email from . If you still can’t find it, please reach out to us at and request that the email be resent.
I have questions or issues with my HyperWallet account, What should I do?

For help with your HyperWallet account, please contact HyperWallet support. You can:

  • Log in to the HyperWallet Pay Portal and use the form under the Support section.

  • If you cannot access your account, call HyperWallet using the phone number listed on their Support page.

  • Review HyperWallet’s FAQs and support information here.

Reach out to HyperWallet directly if you need assistance with:

  • Account activation

  • Resetting your password

  • Tax verification questions

  • Transfer-related questions (e.g., adding a bank account or transfer method)

  • Using additional transfer methods

  • Tracing or recalling payments

How will I be paid?
  • Once your videos are approved, DoorDash will send your payment through HyperWallet. During onboarding, you’ll be asked to set up a HyperWallet account. After it’s approved, you’ll receive an email with instructions to log in and claim your account. Be sure to activate your HyperWallet account, as this step is required in order to receive payment.
Do I have to use HyperWallet to get paid?
  • Yes. DoorDash currently issues payments through HyperWallet exclusively. In order to fully participate in the program and receive payment, you must activate your HyperWallet account.
Why wasn’t my HyperWallet account activated?
  • This usually happens when some of the information you entered doesn’t match official records. To fix this, double-check and re-enter your details, then submit again. Your full legal name and address must exactly match IRS records for HyperWallet to create your account and handle tax reporting.If you need to make an adjustment to your name, please email us at for assistance.
What kind of videos is DoorDash looking for?

We are looking for:

  • Short, engaging videos (10–30 seconds) that feature one local restaurant per video. Videos featuring national chains or franchises will not be accepted.

  • Focus on small or medium-sized, locally owned spots that reflect the character of your neighborhood.

  • Highlight the food, not the ambiance. Quick shots of the space are great for context, but the food should be the star of your video. The best videos showcase 2-4 dishes to give viewers a good feel for the restaurant’s menu, including at least one entrée when possible. Videos that focus on just one small item may not be accepted.

  • Be honest and respectful in your review; we want authentic experiences, not just hype.

  • Use voiceover or royalty-free music only – videos with copyrighted music will be rejected.

  • All videos must follow our Content Guidelines to be approved for the program.

What kind of music should I use?
  • DoorDash videos must use royalty-free music only. Any video that includes copyrighted music will be rejected. We encourage adding sound to your videos — just make sure the music is unlicensed. When in doubt, a voiceover is always a great option instead.
Where do I submit my videos for review?
  • Submit your finalized video through your profile in the DoorDash app. Please upload your video only once. Duplicate submissions of the same video can lead to removal from the program. If you’re unsure whether your upload went through, check your profile for confirmation before trying again. Once submitted, videos can’t be edited or replaced, so make sure everything is final before uploading.
I don’t see the video upload feature in my profile. What should I do?
  • Make sure you’re logged in to the same DoorDash account you used to apply for the program. You would have signed in to DoorDash when you submitted your application — that account is your creator account, and all creator-specific access is linked to it. If you’re still not seeing the upload feature after checking, please reach out to us at for help.
Is there a list of restaurants I should order from?
  • Not yet — we’re currently working on creating a list of featured restaurants and will share it with creators soon. In the meantime, please order from locally owned restaurants in your neighborhood, not large chain or enterprise restaurants. Videos featuring chain restaurants won’t be accepted, since the goal of the program is to highlight local favorites in your community.
Where can I see my videos after I submit them?

  • After your videos are submitted, they will be reviewed by our team. If approved, you’ll see your video in your profile (https://www.doordash.com/consumer/profile/)

  • You can access your profile from the Me Tab by tapping the “Profile” button.

  • Your video might show up on the DoorDash homepage or in other parts of the app, depending on your location. Please note: video features are currently in beta, so they may not be visible to all users just yet.

I submitted a video but don’t see it on my profile.
  • If you’ve submitted a video, we’ve received it and it’s currently under review. Reviews typically take 4–5 business days. If your video is accepted, it will appear on your profile once approved. Videos that aren’t accepted won’t appear on your profile.
Can I post the videos I make to my own social media account?
  • Yes! While it’s not required, you’re welcome to share the videos you’ve created in partnership with DoorDash on your personal social media accounts. Just make sure to follow all requirements, especially about how to disclose your partnership with DoorDash, in Section 3 of the DoorDash for Creators Agreement.
Why wasn’t my video accepted by the DoorDash team?

There are a few common reasons videos may not be approved:

  • Food isn’t the main focus – The strongest videos clearly showcase the meal. While a bit of personality or restaurant context is okay, most of the video should highlight the food itself (close-ups, details, and different angles) so viewers know what they’re ordering.

  • Ineligible restaurant – At this time, we do not accept videos that feature national chain or franchised restaurants or restaurants not available on the DoorDash platform. If your video features one of these restaurants, it can’t be approved.

  • Visual quality – Videos may not be accepted if they’re blurry, zoom in too closely on the food, feel choppy or rushed, or don’t make the dishes look appetizing. Aim for clear, well-lit shots that showcase the food in the best possible way.

  • Content relevance – All videos are reviewed for safety and relevance. If your video isn’t related to DoorDash or doesn’t meet platform standards, it may be rejected.

Please visit creator.doordash.comto review the full video guidelines. If your video was rejected, you may fix it to comply with our guidelines and resubmit.

Do you accept more than one video per restaurant?
  • One of the goals for this program is to help bring awareness to small, locally owned restaurants through video content. At this time, we are only accepting one Creator video per restaurant. Once a restaurant has an approved video, it will no longer be eligible for video submissions.
Still have questions?
  • Please reach out to us at doordash-for-creators@doordash.com.

Frequently Asked Questions about DoubleDash

1. What is DoubleDash and how do I know if I can use it?

What is DoubleDash?
DoubleDash lets you shop from multiple stores in one order — with no additional delivery fee (service fee applies). Whether you want to add a sweet treat to your meal, are ordering for a group with different cravings, or need to get your grocery run done, DoubleDash helps you get everything in one order.

How does DoubleDash work?
You can DoubleDash in two ways, depending on where you are in your shopping journey:

  1. DoubleDash in the cart – pre-checkout

Step 1. Add items to your cart as usual

  • If DoubleDash is available, you’ll see recommended add-ons from nearby stores at the bottom of your cart in the “add items with no delivery fee” section

Step 2. Make your selections from the available items and stores

Step 3. Check out once — both baskets will be included with no additional delivery fee (service fee applies)

  1. DoubleDash after purchase – post-checkout

    Step 1. Add items to your cart as usual

    Step 1. Add items to your cart as usual

    Step 3. Select what you’d like to include

    Step 4. Confirm and checkout — the additional items will be bundled with your existing order with no additional delivery fee (service fee applies)

Can I add items from more than one store with DoubleDash?
DoubleDash currently supports adding one additional store to your original order. You can browse and add from eligible nearby stores, but only a single add-on merchant can be included per order.

When can I use DoubleDash — before or after checkout?
You can use DoubleDash both before and after checkout:

  • Pre-checkout DoubleDash is available while you’re building your cart

  • Post-checkout DoubleDash becomes available immediately after placing your order, giving you up to 20 minutes to add more items

Where can I find DoubleDash in the app?
You can find DoubleDash:

  • Pre-checkout: On the cart page when ordering from restaurants or retail stores

  • Post-checkout: Right after submitting your order, in the DoubleDash bottom sheet, or from the homepage if you have an active order

Why don’t I see DoubleDash as an option?
If you’re not seeing DoubleDash options:

  • Try updating your app to the latest version

  • Try ordering from a different primary store

  • If DoubleDash disappears post-checkout, your time window may have expired

  • Still having issues? Contact Support for help

2. What does DoubleDash cost, and what benefits apply?Are there extra fees for using DoubleDash?

  • Delivery Fee: $0 for the second store

  • Service Fee: A small fee minimum may apply (typically $1.19+), but it is often reduced and varies by region

  • DashPass Members: Benefit from combined subtotal calculations

Do DashPass benefits apply to DoubleDash?
Yes, DashPass members still receive benefits like lower service fees and exclusive promotions on DoubleDash. Some fees may still apply depending on the total value of items.Can I use a promo code or coupon on a DoubleDash order?
Yes — promotions can be applied to your post-checkout DoubleDash cart if eligible. Availability may vary depending on the specific offer and merchant. Note that promotions do not currently apply to pre-checkout add-ons, and eligibility is determined at checkout.Can I DoubleDash from alcohol or grocery stores?
Yes. You can DoubleDash from a range of stores including:

  • Restaurants

  • Convenience stores

  • Grocery stores

  • Alcohol merchants (where legally allowed)

  • Retail stores

Availability may vary depending on your location and local regulations.

3. How do I manage and track my DoubleDash orders?How long do I have to add a DoubleDash order after I check out?
For most instances, you will have 15–20 minutes post-checkout to add on a DoubleDash order before the window closes.

Will my DoubleDash items arrive at the same time as my main order?
Most DoubleDash orders arrive at the same time as the main order from one Dasher. In isolated cases, the orders will arrive separately. While delivery by one dasher is prioritized, you may see two Dashers if batching your orders together isn’t possible or ideal for food freshness.

What happens if one of the stores cancels my order?
If one of the stores cancels, you will still receive the remaining part of your order unless both stores are canceled. You will not be charged for the canceled portion, and any applicable fees will be adjusted automatically. You’ll receive updates via the app and can reach out to Support for assistance if needed.

Can I make changes to my DoubleDash order after checkout?
Once a DoubleDash item is added and confirmed post-checkout, you cannot modify or remove it. If you need to make a change, you may need to cancel the order if it’s still within the cancellation window, or contact Support for help.

Can I track my DoubleDash items separately?
Yes — DoubleDash items can be tracked separately in the app. If your order is being delivered by two different Dashers, you’ll see individual tracking updates for each delivery, including estimated arrival times and handoff status.

Feedback & Suggestions
We’re always working to improve DoubleDash. If you have feedback or suggestions, please submit a request or share your thoughts through the in-app Help section.

Frequently Asked Questions: Most Liked Items & Item Ratings

Where can I find Most Liked Items?

Most Liked Items is a feature that’s currently available on restaurant pages in select markets in the United States, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. Users with access to Most Liked Items must be signed into their DoorDash account in order to submit item ratings.

How are a store’s Most Liked items calculated?

Most Liked items are based on the number of positive (‘thumbs up’) ratings that an item gets from customers who have tried it on DoorDash. Up to three menu items from a store can display a “Most Liked” label at any given time. The items are ranked by the number of positive ratings, descending.

Why am I not seeing the Most Liked items on a store menu?

In order for a store to display a Most Liked item, an item must have a certain amount of positive ratings. If you’re not seeing Most Liked items, the store likely does not yet have any items that meet the criteria.

How do I rate items?

After placing an order from a restaurant on DoorDash, you can rate the menu items (‘thumbs up’ or ‘thumbs down’) from your most recent order. You’ll be prompted to submit item ratings (along with an optional rating and public review for the store) the next time you open your DoorDash app, after your order is delivered or picked up. You can also leave item ratings on your most recent order (that you have not yet submitted any form of feedback on) from a store by visiting the store page and selecting ‘Tap to Review’, then ‘Submit Review’.

Where do I go to submit item ratings?

To submit item ratings, visit a store you’ve recently ordered from on DoorDash and select ‘Tap to review’. If you’ve ordered from the store before and have not yet submitted any form of feedback on your most recent order from that store, you’ll see the option to ‘thumbs up’ or ‘thumbs down’ items. You’ll also automatically be given the option to submit item ratings right after completing an order upon opening your DoorDash app.

I see the option to leave a rating and review, but don’t see the option to rate items. Why?

If you’re not seeing the option to rate items from a store, there are likely two reasons:

  • You haven’t ordered from the store on DoorDash: In order to help ensure that most liked items are reflective of verified DoorDash experiences, we only allow customers to submit ratings on items they’ve ordered from the store on DoorDash.

  • You already submitted a form of feedback on your most recent order from that store: We only allow one “verified” review per order to help ensure that feedback is reflective of a customer’s experience on DoorDash. If you have ordered from the store before but are not seeing the option to rate items from your most recent order, you likely already ‘reviewed’ the order with one of the following forms of ratings or reviews: dasher rating, pickup rating, private feedback to the merchant, public review, or a rating.

You’ll be given the option to submit an item rating after your next order from the store.

I want to submit item ratings but don’t feel like submitting a rating or writing a review. Is that possible?

Yes! Item ratings are meant to be an easier way for you to share feedback that helps local restaurants grow their businesses and people in your neighborhood decide what to eat. Pick whichever format of feedback (rating, written review, item rating, or a combination of formats) works best for you.

Can I rate an item more than once?

Yes, if you order the item more than once. You’ll be given the option to submit item ratings after each order that you place from a restaurant on DoorDash. This means that if you order from a restaurant, you’ll be given the option to rate the items ordered. If you order the same items from the same restaurant location again, you’ll be given the option to rate these items again.

You’ll only be able to submit ratings for your most recent order.

Who can leave content?

Users must be signed into their DoorDash account in order to submit content.

Why should I submit content on DoorDash?

By sharing your love and honest feedback, you can help neighborhood merchants grow their businesses and help customers like you discover great food. Want to really help out your fellow customers and neighborhood stores? Add more details! The most helpful reviews mention specific things like items ordered and why you liked or disliked them and may include photos.

How do I submit content (reviews, photos, videos, etc)?

Content can be submitted on DoorDash by opening the mobile app or by going to www.doordash.com on a desktop. You can submit content directly from a store page, by filling out the prompt after your order, or from your order history.

To leave a review from a store page:

  1. Click on a store

  2. Scroll down to ‘Reviews’

  3. Click the grey pencil icon to the right side to start a review

  4. Select “Everyone” or “Store feedback” from the drop-down menu in the top right corner of the page

  5. Select your rating and tap into the textbox to type your review

  6. If available in your market, tap the plus sign below the text box to add photos or videos from your order either by uploading from your camera roll or accessing your camera. (Note: photo submission is not available on web)

  7. Tap the ‘Submit’ button when complete

To submit only photos (no review) from a store page:

  1. Click on a store

  2. Scroll down to ‘Reviews’

  3. Click on the add photo icon to the right side of ‘Reviews’

  4. Add photos of your items

What is the difference between “Everyone” and “Store feedback” when choosing who can see my review?

When leaving a review of a merchant, you can choose “Everyone” or “Store feedback” in terms of who can see your review.

  • Everyone (previously referred to as “public reviews”) - Customers and merchants will be able to see your review and order items. These will be displayed on the merchant’s DoorDash store page and your consumer profile (if set to public) for other customers to reference.

  • Store feedback (previously referred to as “private feedback”) - Only DoorDash and this merchant will be able to see your review of their store. Ratings will still be included in the average store’s rating score. Review text will be shared directly with the merchant and DoorDash, is not visible to other customers, and will not appear on your consumer profile.

What is the difference between 👎 “didn’t like”, 👍“like”, and ♥️ “loved”? How are these ratings used?

The new ratings system is a simplified feedback system (“Didn’t Like”, “Liked”, “Loved”) and replaces the previous 5-star ratings system for restaurant orders. We encourage selecting the rating that most closely matches your experience with the restaurant.

  • 👎 (“dislike”): poor experience

  • 👍(“like”): good experience

  • ♥️(“loved”): exceptional experience

The selected rating will be translated into a score for the restaurant and aggregated into their lifetime star rating.

How will you use my photos?

Photos that we approve will be displayed on the restaurant’s page and in your public profile. If you have also left a rating or review (which is not required), your photos will be displayed in connection with your rating or review.

At DoorDash, we are always looking for ways to enhance your experience. We may also display your photos on the restaurant’s menu and in other ways. As a reminder, any photos you submit are governed by our Consumer Terms and Conditions.

Can Merchants respond to my content?

Merchants may choose to provide a one-time response to reviews which DoorDash will share with you via email. In this case, DoorDash acts as an intermediary and your email address will not be shared with the Merchant. At this time, Merchant responses are not displayed publicly on store pages.

What personal information is visible with my content?

Both reviews made visible to “Everyone” or sent as “Store feedback” may include details such as your first name, last initial, and any items associated with a recent order from that merchant. At this time, there is not the option to submit a review anonymously. Private contact information such as your email address, phone number, or home address is not visible to Merchants.

Can I submit content anonymously?

No. To help ensure the authenticity of our reviews, both reviews made visible to “Everyone” or sent as “Store feedback” are displayed with the reviewer’s first name and last initial.

What happens after I submit my content?

Upon submitting, DoorDash will review your submission for adherence to DoorDash’s Content Guidelines. DoorDash will not edit, alter, or change your review in any way. Submitted photos may be lightly enhanced by DoorDash to correct issues such as blurriness or lighting. If approved, your content - including ratings, reviews visible to “Everyone”, and photos - will be displayed on the store page and on your public profile. Reviews set to “Store feedback” will be sent directly to the Merchant and DoorDash and will not appear on the store page or your profile.

How long will it take for my content to be posted?

Content and reviews shared with “Everyone” require approval. If approved, your content will be posted to the store page and your public profile approximately 1-5 business days after your submission. Reviews set to “Store feedback” will be sent to the Merchant and DoorDash immediately.

Why am I not seeing my content on a store page or my profile?

If you submitted a review visible to “Everyone” and are not seeing it on the store page or your profile, it could be due to one of the below reasons:

  • The store doesn’t have enough reviews. Reviews submitted for a store may not be publicly visible yet if the store has a low number of reviews.

  • It hasn’t yet been moderated by DoorDash.

  • It wasn’t approved to be published. Reviews are subject to approval. Reviews must be 25 characters or more in length to be published. Reviews that do not abide by DoorDash’s Content Guidelines will not be published. For example, non-relevant content may not ultimately be published or may be subject to removal. If your review is mainly related to issues with your delivery experience (which a Dasher is responsible for providing), it is considered non-relevant to the merchant’s business and will not be posted. Examples of this may include comments on food temperature or delivery time. This is to ensure that merchants do not receive negative reviews for any delivery issues that may have been outside of their control. Please fill out this form if your review has not been published and you believe an error has been made.

My content abided by DoorDash’s Content Guidelines, but was not approved. Why?

Content is subject to approval. Content that does not abide by DoorDash’s Content Guidelines, which disallow profanity as well as content that is threatening, harassing, racist, or sexist, will not be published. Please see DoorDash’s Content Guidelines for more information.

If your content did not meet the above criteria, it likely contained non-relevant content and therefore was not approved. For example, if your review or photo is related to issues with your delivery experience (which a Dasher is responsible for providing), it is considered non-relevant to the merchant’s business and will not be posted. This is to ensure that merchants do not receive negative reviews for any delivery issues that may have been outside of their control. For assistance on delivery issues, please contact our Support team directly in your DoorDash app or via this page.

Can I edit content?

At this time, reviews, including photos, cannot be edited. However, you may leave additional reviews and photos with your next review on the restaurant or request your review/photo be removed using this form.

Can I leave a review for the same store more than once?

Yes. Multiple reviews may be left for the same store; however, only one verified review can be associated with each order. Verified reviews are displayed with an “Ordered on DoorDash” tag and help us ensure that customer feedback is reflective of their experience ordering on DoorDash.

If you’ve only ordered from the store once, additional reviews will not be considered verified unless another order has been completed since your last review.

Is leaving a review the same thing as reviewing my Dasher or Pickup Experience?

No, after a delivery order, you’ll be prompted to rate your Dasher (no written text) and, separately, rate or review the store. Only store reviews have the option to be made visible to Everyone.

Gifting FAQ

Gifting FAQ’s

You can send family, friends, and loved ones a gift delivery through DoorDash. When you send a gift, you have the ability to customize it with a digital card and gift note. Recipients are notified about their gift 10-15 minutes before the Dasher arrives with their gift. They can also view their card, note, and gift tracking. Recipients do not need a DoorDash account.

Recipient gift link with animated card, note, and gift tracking

How can I place a gift delivery?

At checkout, look for “send as a gift” option under “Delivery Details.” The “send as a gift” page will contain a wide selection of digital cards animations. You can further personalize your card with a gift message. You will need to provide the recipient name and phone number in case the Dasher needs to contact the gift recipient at time of delivery.

Gifting flow at checkout

What can I send as a gift?

DoorDash has a wide selection of gift options that you can choose from. Some popular gift categories include:

  • Bakeries

  • Flowers

  • Groceries

  • Beauty products

  • Pet treats and toys

Do Dashers deliver gift orders differently from normal deliveries?

DoorDash notifies Dashers through the Dasher app when they are delivering gift orders. This way, they can treat each gift delivery with care and can contact the gift sender or recipient when delivery issues arise.

What if I don’t know if the recipient is at home?

If you’re not sure when to send your gift, you can let the recipient decide. When you’re on “Send as a gift” page, you can turn on “Let Recipient Schedule” feature. This feature allows the recipient to schedule their gift up to 2 weeks out from the purchase date. We’ll notify you if the gift recipient hasn’t scheduled their gift delivery within the 2 week schedule period.

Gifting page features “Recipient can schedule gift” toggle

Recipient gift link allows recipients to schedule their gift within 2 weeks.

Do you offer gift cards?

You can purchase gift cards through our purchase site here: https://doordash.launchgiftcards.com/. We currently offer gift cards for customers in the US, Canada, and Australia.

Home Cooked Customer Support

What is Meal Plan?

DoorDash Meal Plan provides home-cooked meals delivered straight to your front door so you can have authentic dishes ready anytime. Eat immediately, save and reheat tomorrow, or freeze the food for a later time - it’s up to you! Meal Plan makes all meals with extra love and care to get tastes you can’t find at a restaurant.

When can I get my order?

Meal Plan meals are made to order by a local chef, so you’ll need to schedule your order about a day in advance in order to get your food. At checkout, select the day you’d like to have your meals delivered and a Dasher will bring it accordingly.

Why are my meals delivered cold?

Meal Plan meals are safely chilled to give you the flexibility of eating now or eating later.

How can I learn more about who is preparing the food?

To learn more about the chefs, please visit their storepage.

How do I report an accident or safety issue?

IN AN EMERGENCY SITUATION, PLEASE CALL 911.

Offer Details: Earn DoorDash credit by sharing a photo or video

Earning credits for photos:

Select DoorDash consumers have the opportunity to earn account credits by sharing a menu-worthy photo of an eligible menu item, as specified on the DoorDash platform. Eligible menu items are marked, and all these items currently don’t have menu photos. DoorDash will reward customers for submitting photos that are used on store menus. These photos will help other customers discover more dishes and help merchants add more great photos to their menus. Please note that a menu item only has one photo; however, tapping the menu item will lead to the item page gallery, which can have multiple photos of that item.

Please look here for the Terms and Conditions of consumer-submitted photos.

Earning credits for videos:

Select DoorDash consumers may have the opportunity to earn account credits by sharing raw video footage of their food from an eligible restaurant, as specified on the DoorDash platform. Eligible restaurants are marked. DoorDash will reward customers for submitting food footage that is selected to be featured in a video about the restaurant. These videos will help other customers learn more about the dishes the restaurant offers and other helpful information. Please note that approved video footage will appear on the DoorDash homepage and explore page. At this time, videos will not appear alongside reviews.

Here are some commonly asked questions about these offers:

Videos:
