  • Can I get credit for the same item multiple times for video?

  • Is there a limit to the amount of credit I can receive?

How do I earn credit for a photo?

Select users are eligible to earn credit. If you are eligible, you can follow these steps to submit a photo (images of steps included below):

1. Click on the credit offer banner on eligible restaurant pages. There may be multiple banners, so you may need to swipe right to see the credit offer banner.

2. To find items eligible for the offer, click ‘Browse Items’ or explore the restaurant menu.

3. Order these items from the store and be ready to snap some photos when your order arrives.

4. Before you dig in, snap some photos of the eligible items in your order and make sure the photos are:

  • Showcasing the eligible item– you want the dish front, center, & fully visible

  • Well-lit– natural lighting looks best, and try to minimize shadows

  • Worthy of a menu– try plating the item and take your best shot!

5. After receiving your order, leave a rating for the delivery experience.

6. Add your menu-worthy photo of an eligible, unique menu item from your completed order. You are not required to submit a review or rating alongside the photo.

7. Tag the eligible item in the photo and ensure it meets our Content Guidelines.

DoorDash will review your photo, and if it’s selected for the menu, you will receive credit within 14 days. The credit will be automatically added to your account and applied to your next order. See full offer terms and conditions here.

If the pop-up doesn’t appear after your order, you can use alternative ways to submit a photo.

How can I submit a photo for credit?

Photos can be submitted via the DoorDash app (iOS/Android) after receiving an order, on the store page, or the ‘Orders’ tab.

Submitting photos through the pop-up after receiving an order:

  1. Leave a rating for your delivery experience on the pop-up.

  2. Add photos of your menu items.

Submitting photos through the store page:

  1. On the store page, scroll down to ‘Reviews’.

  2. Click the add camera icon on the right side of ‘Reviews’.

  3. Add photos of your menu items and tag them.

Submitting photos on the ‘Orders’ tab

  1. Click on the ‘Orders’ tab at the bottom of the app.

  2. Click “View Receipt” on the specific order.

  3. Rate the restaurant.

  4. Add photos of your menu items and tag them.​​​

How can I find items that are incentivized for photos?

To find items that are incentivized, follow these steps:

  1. Look for the offer banner on restaurant pages.

  2. Click on ‘Browse Items’ or review the restaurant menu to identify items eligible for the offer.

Why can’t I find a banner on the restaurant page for photo incentives?

The offer banner only appears on restaurant pages with eligible items. If a store does not have any incentivized items, the banner will not appear, and the offer will not apply. You may need to swipe right to see more banners if multiple offer banners appear.

When will I receive my credit for photos?

If your submitted photo meets the guidelines and criteria for menu-worthy, you will receive your credit within 7-14 days.

How do I know my photo was selected? Where will it appear?

If your photo was selected, it will appear directly on the restaurant’s menu. You will be notified via email (check spam and ensure you’re opted in to receiving emails from DoorDash), and credits will be automatically issued to your account. Please note that a menu item only has one photo; however, tapping the menu item will lead to the item page gallery, which can have multiple photos of that item.

Why didn’t I get my credit for photos?

Your photo submission must adhere to these criteria in order for you to receive credits:

  • Be chosen for the menu (look here for more information). Please note that only one photo will be chosen for the menu; however, tapping the menu item will lead to the item page gallery, which can have multiple photos of the item.

  • Be of an eligible, unique menu item from a completed order (e.g., 5 photos of the same menu item can only qualify for credit once).

  • Be tagged with the name of the menu item.

  • Be an original photo that you have taken.

  • Meet DoorDash’s Content Guidelines.

  • Not be only of a prepackaged item (such as a bottled or canned beverage, bag of chips, or sauce), utensils, or napkins.

What photos are considered menu-worthy photos?

Menu-worthy photos exhibit certain attributes to ensure they’re suitable for the restaurant menu. Here are some key features to focus on:

  • Ideal lighting- Place in natural light or a well-lit setting

  • Centered framing- Have the entire dish in view

  • Just one menu item- Ensure that the photo focuses exclusively on the single menu item

Here are some examples of menu-worthy photos:

Can I get credit for the same item multiple times for photos?

No, you cannot receive credit for the same item twice. Each unique menu item is eligible for credit once during each order. Submitting multiple photos of the same menu item will not increase the credited amount.

Is there a limit to the amount of credit I can receive?

The combined overall maximum lifetime credit amount for photo and video incentives is capped at $500 per person.

How do I earn credit for a video? How do I submit a video?

Select users may be eligible to earn credit in select markets. Raw footage submitted will be used to create future videos for the restaurant. Therefore, it is not necessary to edit the video before submitting.

Here are some tips when recording your video snippet:

  • Keep it short: Videos 10-20 seconds long that focus on individual dishes are usually best

  • Set the scene: Make your food shine with natural lighting and keep it focused on the dishes.

  • Leave the editing to us: No need to add any overlays, voiceovers, or other edits. We’ll take care of it!

If you are eligible, you can follow these steps to submit a video:

1. Click on the credit offer banner on eligible restaurant pages. Not all stores will be eligible for incentives. There may be multiple banners, so you may need to swipe right to see the credit offer banner. It will look something like this (language and exact offer may change).

2. Click on the offer.

3. You will be prompted to “add videos from library”.

4. Select the video.

5. Complete the submission video flow.

DoorDash will review your video, and if it’s approved, you will receive credit within 14 days. The credit will be automatically added to your account and applied to your next order.

How can I find stores that are incentivized for video?

Video incentives are only available in select markets for select users. To find stores that are incentivized, simply look for the offer banner on restaurant pages. Not all stores will be incentivized. There may be multiple banners, so you may need to swipe right to see the credit offer banner.

Why can’t I find a banner on the restaurant page for video incentives?

It is possible that you or your market is not a part of the video incentive program. Additionally, the offer banner only appears on eligible restaurant pages. If a store is not eligible, the banner will not appear, and the offer will not apply. You may need to swipe right to see more banners if multiple offer banners are available.

When will I receive my credits for the video?

If you submitted a high-quality video that meets the guidelines and criteria for approval, you will receive your credit within 7-14 days.

Why didn’t I get my credits for video?

Your video likely did not meet our guidelines or was not incentivized. See “Which videos are selected?” for more information. Please note that earned credits may take 7-14 business days to reflect in your account.

Which videos are selected? How are they selected?

Your video submission must adhere to these criteria in order for you to receive credits:

  • Feature food from only a single restaurant.

  • Be of high quality (clean background, good lighting, not blurry).

  • Be an original video that you recorded.

  • Be appropriate for all community members and meet DoorDash’s Content Guidelines.

Additionally, videos that attempt to link or refer customers to places outside of DoorDash will not be approved.

Can I get credit for the same store multiple times for video?

Yes, videos from separate orders are still eligible to earn incentives, provided the offer is still available and the content meets our guidelines.

Is there a limit to the amount of credit I can receive?

The combined overall maximum lifetime credit amount for photo and video incentives is capped at $500 per person.

Photos FAQs

  • How do I submit a photo?

  • How will you use my photos?

  • I want to submit a photo without leaving a star rating or review. Is that possible?

  • Can I submit photos for the same restaurant more than once?

  • What does “AI-enhanced” mean?

How do I submit a photo?

Photos can be submitted to DoorDash by opening the app on an iOS or Android device after receiving an order, on the store page, or on the ‘Orders’ tab.

Submitting photos through the pop-up after receiving an order

  1. Leave a star rating for your delivery experience on the pop-up

  2. Add photos of your items

Submitting photos through the store page

  1. On the store page, scroll down to ‘Reviews’ and click on the add camera icon to the right side of ‘Reviews’

  2. Add photos of your items

Submitting photos on the ‘Orders’ tab

  1. Click on the ‘Orders’ tab on the bottom of the app

  2. Click “View Receipt” on the specific order

  3. Rate the restaurant

  4. Add photos of your items

How will you use my photos?

Photos that we approve will be displayed on the restaurant’s page. If you have also left a rating or review (which is not required), your photos will be displayed in connection with your rating or review.

At DoorDash, we are always looking for ways to enhance your experience. In the future, we may also display your photos on the restaurant’s menu and in other ways. As a reminder, any photos you submit are governed by our Consumer Terms and Conditions.

I want to submit a photo without leaving a star rating or review. Is that possible?

Yup! Photos are meant to reflect your ordering experience and share visual feedback to help restaurants grow their business and people in your neighborhood decide what to eat. Please submit photos of the food in your order even if you do not leave a written review or star rating.

Can I submit photos for the same restaurant more than once?

Yes, if you order from a restaurant multiple times you can always add photos from your most recent order by following our review prompts or by going to the restaurant page, scrolling down to ‘Reviews,’ and clicking the add photo icon on the right side.

What does “AI-enhanced” mean?

If you see “AI-enhanced” on a photo, DoorDash has used AI to improve the image in ways that go beyond basic lighting or clarity adjustments. This can include re-plating the dish, replacing or adding background
elements (such as a table, plate, or surroundings), filling in missing parts of the image, or adjusting the perspective so the food is easier to see.

AI enhancements are made to better showcase menu items and create a more consistent browsing experience. DoorDash is focused on improving photos without altering the actual food, ingredients, or portion size, so the dish you see is representative of what the merchant oﬀers.

Retail Returns FAQ

How do I make a return on DoorDash?

To make a return:

  1. Go to your order history, which you can find by heading to the Me Tab and then selecting the Orders icon.

  2. Choose the order that includes the item you want to return from your past orders list and tap the “return” button to start your return.

  3. Select the item(s) you want to return and the reason you want to return them.

  4. Follow the instructions on the Returns Summary page (make sure to read the Return Policy for the Merchant before heading to the store).

  5. Head to the Merchant’s store that’s most convenient for you. At checkout (or the dedicated return section in store), tell the store associate you are making a DoorDash return and present the return barcode from the Return Summary tab.

  6. After the associate scans the barcode, confirm it was scanned in-app and follow prompts for details on your refund, including whether the Merchant is supposed to provide you store credit.

If you have any issues with your return, please contact support by tapping on “Help” in the app–we’re here to help!

Retail Returns Policy

What’s DoorDash’s return policy?

When you make a return through DoorDash, it follows the return policy of the store where your purchase was made. Once your return request is submitted, we’ll review it in line with the store’s policy and process it at our discretion.

If your return is approved, your refund may be issued in one of the following ways:

  • Back to your original form of payment

  • As a DoorDash credit

  • As store credit (depending on the store’s policy)

Refunds to your original payment method typically take up to 4 business days to appear.

What do I need for a refund to my original payment method?

To receive a refund to your original form of payment, you must complete all of the following steps:

  • You must start the return through the DoorDash app

  • You must return the item(s) in-store

  • You must upload the return receipt in the DoorDash app

How do I start a return?

  1. Go to your order history by opening the Me Tab in the app and tapping the Orders icon.

  2. Select the order with the item(s) you’d like to return and tap Start a return.

  3. Choose the item(s) you want to return and select a reason.

  4. Head to the Merchant’s store of your choice.

  5. At checkout (or the store’s returns area), tell the associate you’re making a DoorDash return and show your return barcode in the app.

  6. After the associate processes the return, take a photo of the return receipt and upload it to the DoorDash app.

  7. DoorDash will review your return and issue a refund to your original payment method within about 4 business days (timing may vary by bank).

  8. If you have any issues, go to Help in the app and contact support.

To learn more about how to make a return, please see our FAQ.

DashPass

DashPass Family Sharing FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions:

Q: How can I share my DashPass membership?
A: With an eligible account*, you can manage your Family Sharing benefits here.
To share your DashPass membership with someone, simply:

  1. Open the DoorDash app and tap the “Me” tab (bottom right corner)

  2. Tap “Family” and follow the prompts to invite one additional person to share your DashPass membership for free

  3. Once they accept it, they’ll automatically receive DashPass benefits in their account. You only share the benefits, not your login. Each person keeps their own DoorDash account, payment method, order history, and delivery preferences separate.

Q: What is DashPass Family Sharing?
A: DashPass Family sharing is a benefit that is available on most standard monthly and annual DashPass plans. This allows DashPass subscribers (primary account holders) to share a select number of their benefits with one other person (secondary account holders), without having to share account login details or pay for another DashPass membership.
Ineligible primary account holders include (but are not limited to) those account holders who are on partnership plans such as Chase, MasterCard, and DoorDash for Business. You may not share your DashPass benefits with anyone located in a different country.

Q: How do I know if I’m eligible for Family Sharing?
A: The quickest way to find out if your account is eligible for Family Sharing is to go to Me → Family → Family Sharing Page. You may not have Family Sharing available to you if you have DashPass through a partnership (Chase, MasterCard, DoorDash for Business).
If you think that your plan type should be eligible for Family Sharing, you can confirm your eligibility with our customer support team who can provide further details on your eligibility, usually after 48 hours from you providing your account details and issue.

Q: How many people can I share my membership with?
A: You can only share your benefits with one other account at a time. To share with a new account, you must first remove the current secondary account by clicking “Remove” next to the added user on the Family Sharing Page (Me → Family → Family Sharing Page → Remove).
Note: You may not share your DashPass benefits with anyone located in a different country.

Q: Will my secondary account holder have access to my order history/payment information?
A: No, your secondary account holder will join from their account. They will have no access to your personal information.

Q: If I cancel my membership, will the person sharing my account be charged?
A: No, the shared account will never be charged for the membership. They will be removed from your account immediately once your membership has ended. After your membership has ended, both you and your secondary account holder will lose access to DashPass benefits.

Q: Does my secondary account holder get notified if I remove them?
A: Yes, your secondary account holder will receive an email informing them that they are losing their DashPass benefits.

Q: What happens when someone clicks my invite link?
A: The recipient of your invite link will be taken directly to our join page, where they can start using DashPass benefits immediately and leave the membership at any time. If your recipient does not already have the DoorDash app, they will be directed to our web login page, where they are directed to download the app. Recipients must have the DoorDash app downloaded and an eligible account to accept a sharing invite.

Q: Why is my recipient unable to accept my Family Sharing invite?
A: There are a few things that may block your recipient from joining your invite. The error message will inform what is causing the issue. See primary issues below:

  • Issue: The Recipient already has an active DashPass membership.

    • Resolution: To join the family account, the recipient must first terminate their current membership. The membership cancellation must be finalized at the end of the billing cycle before they are able to join. Memberships in a pending pause or pending cancellation will not be able to join.

  • Issue: The recipient is not on the latest app version.

    • Resolution: Because family sharing is a recent feature, you must be on an updated app version to utilize the benefit. If you are receiving this message, you can go to the app store and update your DoorDash app.

  • Issue: The Sharing link is already redeemed.

    • Resolution: If your recipient receives this error, it means you already have someone sharing your membership. To share with a new account, you must first remove the current secondary account by clicking “Remove” next to the added user on the Family Sharing Page (Me → Family → Family Sharing Page → Remove)

Q: DashPass Family Sharing Terms & Conditions
A: For DoorDash Family Sharing Terms and Conditions, click here

DashPass for Students

For questions about the verification process, please click here. To contact Sheer ID about verification issues click here.

  1. What benefits do I receive when I sign up for the Student DashPass?

  2. Can I sign up for the Student DashPass Plan after I am already enrolled in the regular DashPass?

  3. Who is eligible for a Student DashPass Plan?

  4. How does DoorDash verify I am a student?

  5. What information is needed to get verified for the Student DashPass Plan?

  6. What should I do if the auto-verification fails?

  7. Why don’t I see the Student DashPass Plan offer in the DoorDash mobile app?

  8. ​​Can I have a Student DashPass Plan on more than one account?

  9. Can I switch my Student DashPass Plan to a different DoorDash account?

  10. What makes an order eligible for DashPass benefits?

  11. How do I sign up for the Student DashPass Plan?

1. What benefits do I receive when I sign up for the Student DashPass?

Consumers who sign up for Student DashPass Plan will receive DashPass at a discounted charge of $4.99 a month or $48 annually instead of $9.99 a month or $96 a year.

2. Can I sign up for the Student DashPass Plan after I am already enrolled in the regular DashPass?

We are currently working on a solution to enable you to switch from a standard DashPass plan to a DashPass for Students Plan in the DoorDash app. In the meantime, the easiest way to switch to a DoorDash Student Plan is to complete your current DashPass subscription and cancel your current subscription prior to the next payment cycle. Once your current payment cycle has concluded, you will be able to enroll in a DashPass Student Plan at the Student Plan price.

Not sure when your payment cycle ends? Follow these steps in your DoorDash app to see when your current payment cycle concludes:

  • In the DoorDash app, click account in the bottom right corner.

  • Click Manage DashPass.

  • Under Payment Details you will find the date of your next subscription charge, or when your next payment cycle begins. (This is the date before which you will want to cancel your current subscription.)

3. Who is eligible for a Student DashPass Plan?

This Student Plan is for US,Canadian,Australian and New Zealand customers who are enrolled in a University or Post-secondary school and passes the verification process.

4. How does DoorDash verify I am a student?

When signing up for the Student DashPass in the DoorDash App, a verification process is included in the app.

5. What information is needed to get verified for the Student DashPass Plan?

In order to verify on the DoorDash app that you are a student, you will need to provide your First Name, Last Name, College, Date of Birth and Email Address.

6. What should I do if the auto-verification fails?

If the auto-verification fails, manual verification will be offered to customers. You will be asked to upload one of these school issued documents; transcripts, class schedule, or registration or tuition receipt. These verifications can take up to 24 hours to get processed. We will send an email to users once SheerID finishes reviewing the document.

7. Why don’t I see the Student DashPass Plan offer in the DoorDash mobile app?

We are currently testing the Student Plan with a small percentage of our US,Canadian,Australian and New Zealand customers, so this plan may not be available to you at this time.

​​​​8. Can I have a Student DashPass Plan on more than one account?

No, each customer may only have 1 DashPass Student Plan because a customer can only be approved once by the verification process.

9. Can I switch my Student DashPass Plan to a different DoorDash account?

Unfortunately, once you are approved for our Student DashPass Plan, you cannot be approved again for a different account. However, you can update your delivery address, payment method and other personal information on that DoorDash account.

10. What makes an order eligible for DashPass benefits?

Things to check before placing an order:

  1. Check the DoorDash app or Doordash.com for restaurants near you that have the green DashPass symbol.

  2. Make sure your order subtotal meets the minimum requirement:

    • For US - it’s $12 or above to receive DashPass Benefits for restaurants or convenience stores, or $25 or above for grocery orders.

    • For Canada - it’s $15 or above to receive DashPass Benefits for restaurants or convenience stores, or $35 or above for grocery orders.

    • For Australia/New Zealand - it’s $20 or above to receive DashPass Benefits for restaurants or convenience stores, or $30 or above for grocery orders. Please note no reduced service fees apply.

  3. DashPass benefits should immediately apply if the above criteria are met.

11. How do I sign up for the Student DashPass Plan?

Mobile users:

To sign up for Student DashPass on the DoorDash app follow these steps:

  1. Open your DoorDash app

  2. Tap the account icon at the top of the screen

  3. Tap “Get $0 delivery fees with DashPass”

  4. Select “DashPass Student Plan”

  5. Fill out your personal information for our verification process then select “Verify Student Status”

  6. Choose if you want a monthly or annual plan then select “Get DashPass”

  7. You will get an in-app confirmation after successfully signing up

Web users:

To sign up for Student DashPass on the DoorDash website follow these steps:

  1. Log in to your account on the DoorDash website

  2. Select “Account” in the bottom left corner

  3. Tap “Get Free Delivery”

  4. Select “DashPass Student Plan”

  5. Fill out your personal information for our verification process then select “Verify Student Status”

  6. Choose if you want a monthly or annual plan then select “Get DashPass”

  7. You will get an in-app confirmation after successfully signing up

DashPass Gifting FAQ’s

DashPass Gifting FAQs

1. What is the DashPass gifting feature?

  • You can now give the gift of DashPass to your friends, family, and loved ones as a 3-month, 6-month, or 12-month membership in the US.

2. What is DashPass?

  • DashPass is a membership service that offers unlimited deliveries from thousands of eligible restaurants, convenience, and grocery stores with $0 delivery fee and reduced service fees that meet the minimum subtotal, as detailed in the app.

  • DashPass is currently available in the United States and Canada with some areas excluded. See full terms here.

3. How do I gift a DashPass membership?

  • New or existing DoorDash account holders can click here to start gifting. First select the number of months you’d like to gift and when you’d like to send your gift. Then input the giftee’s information and submit your payment information.

Note, you must be logged into your DoorDash account to complete the transaction.

4. How long after purchasing a DashPass gifted membership will the gift be delivered to my giftee?

  • You can choose to schedule your gifted DashPass membership to deliver immediately, or on any date up to 3 months into the future.

5. What makes an order eligible for DashPass benefits?

  • Things to check before placing an order:

  1. Check the DoorDash app or Doordash.com for restaurants near you that have the green DashPass symbol.

  2. Enjoy a $0 delivery fee and reduced services fees on the eligible restaurant, grocery, and convenience orders that meet the subtotal minimum, as detailed in the app.

  3. DashPass benefits of $0 delivery fee and reduced service fees should immediately apply if the above criteria are met.

6. What happens at the end of my gifted DashPass membership?

  • All DashPass gifted memberships will automatically enroll into paid monthly DashPass memberships at the end of the gift’s duration (for example, if you gift a 3-month DashPass membership, that membership will convert into a monthly DashPass membership that bills your gift recipient).

7. How do I redeem a gifted DashPass membership?

  • If you’ve been gifted a DashPass membership and would like to redeem it, you’ll receive an email or text notification from DoorDash on the delivery date specified by the gift sender, which contains the link to redeem your DashPass membership.

8. Does a gifted DashPass membership ever expire if it isn’t redeemed?

  • No. A gifted DashPass membership that isn’t redeemed will not expire, and your gift recipient will have the opportunity to redeem it at any given date.

9. What if my gift recipient already has a DashPass membership?

  • If your gift recipient already has a DashPass membership, their gifted months will apply following the completion of their current billing cycle.

  • Examples:

    • For Monthly DashPass - if your gift recipient has a monthly DashPass membership, they will receive their gifted months after that current month ends.

    • For Annual DashPass - If your gift recipient has an annual DashPass membership, their gifted months will apply following the completion of their year.

    • For Free Trial DashPass - if your gift recipient is on the free month of DashPass trial, they will receive their gifted months after the free month of DashPass ends.

Please note that DashPass members who are currently on a Partnership plan such as Chase, Mastercard, Royal Bank of Canada, or AfterPay plan will not be eligible to apply their gifted DashPass membership until their Partnership DashPass membership ends. Recipients in partner plans have the ability to transfer their gifted DashPass membership to another party.

Free Student DashPass FAQs

Eligible students at select colleges can now sign up for Free Student DashPass, providing all Student DashPass benefits for free while they are actively enrolled in school. Read on to learn how to see if your school is eligible for the offer, how to verify your student status, redeem your free membership, and understand what happens once you’re no longer a student.

For questions about the verification process, please click here.

To contact Sheer ID about verification issues click here.

Jump Section:

  • What is the Free Student DashPass?

  • Who is eligible for Free Student DashPass?

  • How do I sign up for Free Student DashPass?

  • Why don’t I see the Free Student DashPass offer in my app?

  • What benefits do I get with Free Student DashPass?

  • How long will my Free Student DashPass last?

  • How does DoorDash verify that I’m a student?

  • What should I do if verification fails?

  • Can I have Free Student DashPass on more than one account?

  • Can I switch my Free Student DashPass to another account?

  • What happens after I’m no longer a student?

  • Who do I contact if I have issues verifying my student status?

What is the Free Student DashPass?

Free Student DashPass gives eligible college students free Student DashPass membership while they are actively enrolled at select universities. You’ll enjoy the same benefits as a Student DashPass member—like $0 delivery fees and reduced service fees on eligible orders and at no cost while your student status is verified.

When your student status changes (for example, after graduation), your membership will automatically transition to a $9.99/month (plus tax) DashPass monthly plan. You’ll receive an email notification 30 days before that transition happens.

Who is eligible for Free Student DashPass?

To qualify, you must:

  • Be actively enrolled as a student at one of the following universities:

    • Central Michigan University

    • East Carolina University

    • Grand Valley State University

    • Pennsylvania State University (University Park)

    • University of Alabama

    • University of Akron (Akron)

  • Successfully verify your enrollment through SheerID, our verification partner.

This offer is available for a limited time and only to students enrolled at the participating universities stated above. If you do not attend any of the eligible universities, you can review our DashPass for Students Help Center article for more information about regular Student DashPass membership.

How do I sign up for Free Student DashPass?

  1. Set your DoorDash app location to your school address. The offer only appears to students located near eligible campuses.

  2. Tap the Free Student DashPass banner or visit the standard DashPass landing page.

  3. Complete student verification through SheerID by entering your name, school, birth date and student (.edu) email address.

  4. Once verified, redeem your Free Student DashPass offer and enjoy instant access to eligible benefits.

If you’re already a paid DashPass member, cancel your existing plan first to activate your free membership. Please note you may have to wait until your paid billing cycle ends in order to redeem the offer.

Why don’t I see the Free Student DashPass offer in my app?

If you don’t see the offer:

  • Make sure your location is set to your school address in the DoorDash app. The offer is only visible within participating locations.

  • The offer is only available at select participating universities for a limited time.

  • If you already have a paid DashPass membership, cancel your existing plan first to activate your free membership. Please note you may have to wait until your paid billing cycle ends in order to redeem the offer.

What benefits do I get with Free Student DashPass?

Free Student DashPass members receive the same benefits as Student DashPass members, including:

  • $0 delivery fees on eligible orders

  • Reduced service fees on the same eligible orders

  • Access to exclusive DashPass promotions and rewards

  • And more

Student DashPass benefits apply only to eligible orders from DashPass merchants that meet the minimum subtotal requirement, excluding fees and taxes. Subtotal minimums will be identified on DoorDash for each DashPass eligible merchant. Other fees (including service fee), taxes, and gratuity still apply. DashPass terms here and cancellation instructions here.

If you are having trouble with your DashPass membership and/or membership benefits, please contact our Support Team.

How long will my Free Student DashPass last?

Your Free Student DashPass remains active as long as SheerID verifies your student status. If SheerID confirms you are no longer an active student, your membership will automatically transition to the standard $9.99/month (plus tax) DashPass monthly plan and you will automatically be charged $9.99/month (plus tax) on a recurring basis until you cancel your DashPass subscription. You will be charged to any payment method we have on file for your account.

You’ll receive a 30-day advance email notice before this transition. You can cancel anytime before the transition date to avoid being charged if you prefer not to continue.

How does DoorDash verify that I’m a student?

DoorDash partners with SheerID, a trusted verification provider, to confirm your enrollment. During sign-up, SheerID will ask you to provide information such as your name, date of birth, school, and student email address.

If automatic verification fails, SheerID may prompt you to upload a school-issued document (e.g., transcript, class schedule, or tuition receipt) for review in order for SheerID to verify your status as an eligible student.

What should I do if verification fails?

If your student verification fails, SheerID will guide you through manual verification. You’ll be asked to upload an official school-issued document (such as a transcript, class schedule, or tuition receipt). Reviews typically take up to 24 hours, and you’ll receive an email once SheerID finishes reviewing your information.

Can I have Free Student DashPass on more than one account?

No. Each student can only have one verified DoorDash account with Free Student DashPass benefits.

Can I switch my Free Student DashPass to another account?

No. Once your student status has been verified, the Free Student DashPass membership cannot be transferred to a different DoorDash account.

What happens after I’m no longer a student?

When SheerID confirms you’re no longer an active student, your membership will automatically transition to a $9.99/month paid monthly DashPass plan. You will be provided an email 30-days prior to the transition. You can cancel at any time before that date to avoid being charged.

Who do I contact if I have issues verifying my student status?

For verification issues, please contact SheerID directly through the link provided on the verification page. If you’ve already been verified but are having trouble redeeming or activating your membership, contact DoorDash Support.

How do I cancel my DashPass subscription?

How do I cancel my DashPass membership?

We are sorry to see you go! You can cancel your DashPass membership any time using the DoorDash app or doordash.com. To avoid charges for the next subscription period, you must cancel your DashPass membership 24 hours before your next scheduled payment. After canceling, your DashPass benefits will be valid through the end of the current billing period. If you cancel during a free period, your benefits will be terminated immediately. After canceling your membership, you will receive a confirmation via email that your DashPass membership has been canceled.

To cancel your membership in the DoorDash app or on doordash.com:

1. Open the DoorDash app or open doordash.com.

2. Tap the account icon.

3. Go to “Manage DashPass”.

4. Tap “Cancel Membership” to cancel your membership.

5. Select a reason for your cancellation and select “Select reason.”

6. Select “Cancel DashPass”

7. Your membership has been successfully canceled. Select “Got it” to return to the “Manage DashPass” page.

To pause your membership on the app or doordash.com:

1. If you choose to “Pause” your membership instead of canceling, select “Pause Membership” on the “Manage DashPass” page.

2. On the pop-up, select “Pause DashPass” to confirm your selection.

3. Your membership has been successfully paused.

Summer of DashPass x Lyft FAQs

Summer of DashPass x Lyft FAQs

How long will the Lyft offer be active during the Summer of DashPass?

  • The 10% on-demand ride offer will be live between 6/25/2026 12AM PST - 7/8/2026 11:59PM PST for eligible DashPass subscribers who have (i) linked their Lyft account and (ii) book a ride in FIFA World Cup 2026 host cities in the U.S. and Canada. After 7/8, subscribers will continue to be able to enjoy 5% off on-demand and 10% off scheduled airport rides with DashPass and Lyft.

Where will this DashPass x Lyft offer be available to all DashPass subscribers for the FIFA World Cup 2026 Tournament?

  • The DashPass x Lyft benefit offer will be available at all U.S. and Canadian FIFA World Cup 2026™ host cities. The following are all of the host cities:

  • Host Cities

    • Dallas, Texas

    • New York / New Jersey

    • Atlanta, Georgia

    • Kansas City, Missouri

    • Houston, Texas

    • San Francisco, California

    • Los Angeles, California

    • Philadelphia, Pennsylvania

    • Seattle, Washington

    • Boston, Massachusetts

    • Miami, Florida

    • Toronto, Ontario

    • Vancouver, British Columbia

Do I have to have a DashPass account to access the Lyft offer?

  • Yes, you must have a DashPass account to gain access to the DashPass x Lyft offer. You must link your DashPass account to your Lyft account to redeem the offer.

How does Summer of DashPass interact with the regular Lyft benefit?

  • For eligible customers, you will still receive the same ongoing 10% off scheduled airport rides and 2 priority pickups per month, as well as DashPass benefits you already have today. During the promo period, this Lyft offer (10% on-demand ride offer) will supersede the standard save 5% on-demand ride benefit for eligible customers who book a ride in FIFA World Cup 2026 host cities in the U.S. and Canada.

Who is eligible for the Lyft x Summer of DashPass offer?

  • You must have a DashPass account, you must link your DashPass and Lyft accounts, and you must book a ride in a FIFA World Cup 2026 host city in the U.S. and Canada (see list of eligible cities above).

I’m not in one of those cities, will I get any other promo instead?

  • DashPass subscribers, within the U.S. and Canada, will continue to be eligible for existing Lyft offers.

I got a separate promo code for Lyft. Will this stack with the 10% off on-demand rides promo?

  • No. Only one promotion can be applied per ride.

Will all Lyft rides be eligible for the discount?

  • DashPass subscribers will get 10% off on-demand rides.

How many times can I redeem/apply the Summer of DashPass x Lyft offer to my rides?

  • You can apply the discount to a maximum of 4 rides per month. Discount will be automatically applied on qualifying Lyft rides.

Ticket Sweepstake FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions

Are there any sweepstakes for the World Cup during the Summer of DashPass?
DoorDash is running two separate sweepstakes this summer:

1. FIFA World Cup 2026™ Local Ticket Sweepstakes
A chance to win two (2) tickets (for the winner + guest) to a local World Cup group stage game in your city. Available to residents of select markets: Atlanta, Dallas, Houston, Los Angeles, Miami, New York/New Jersey, and San Francisco. Canadian residents in Ontario and British Columbia are also eligible. Entry period: May 28 – June 10, 2026.

2. FIFA World Cup 2026™ Final Sweepstakes
A chance to win a trip for two (2) (for the winner + guest) to the FIFA World Cup Final on July 19, 2026, in East Rutherford, NJ. Open to all legal residents across all 50 U.S. states, D.C., Puerto Rico, and Canada. Entry period: May 28 – July 8, 2026.

Note: Order-based entry is available for active DashPass members only. Non-DashPass members can still enter both sweepstakes via the free alternative method of entry — see the Official Rules for each sweepstakes for details:

  • FIFA World Cup 2026™ Final Sweepstakes — Official Rules

  • FIFA World Cup 2026™ Local Ticket Sweepstakes — Official Rules

What’s included in each prize?
The two sweepstakes offer different prizes:

FIFA World Cup 2026™ Local Ticket Sweepstakes — Winners receive two (2) tickets (for winner + guest) to a FIFA World Cup 2026 group stage match in their eligible city or province. Travel and accommodations are not included.

FIFA World Cup 2026™ Final Sweepstakes — Winners receive a trip for two (2) (for winner + guest) to the FIFA World Cup Final on July 19, 2026, in East Rutherford, NJ. The prize includes round-trip airfare (or ground transportation if residing within 150 miles), two (2) nights’ hotel, and two (2) tickets to the Final.

Can I enter both sweepstakes?
Yes! The Local Ticket Sweepstakes and the Final Sweepstakes are two separate promotions with separate entry requirements and prize pools. If you’re in an eligible local market, you can enter both. Check the Official Rules for each to confirm your eligibility and how to enter.

Do I need a DashPass membership to enter?
No — DashPass is not required to enter either sweepstakes. Active DashPass members can earn an automatic entry by placing eligible orders during the entry period, but a free alternative method of entry is available to everyone. See the Official Rules for each sweepstakes for free entry instructions:

  • FIFA World Cup 2026™ Final Sweepstakes — Official Rules

  • FIFA World Cup 2026™ Local Ticket Sweepstakes — Official Rules

How many times can I enter each sweepstakes?
Each sweepstakes allows one (1) entry per person, regardless of how many orders beyond the required amount you place. Placing additional orders beyond the minimum requirement will not increase your chances of winning.

When do the sweepstakes close?
The two sweepstakes have different entry periods:

FIFA World Cup 2026™ Local Ticket Sweepstakes — Ends June 10, 2026, at 11:59 PM PT
FIFA World Cup 2026™ Final Sweepstakes — Ends July 8, 2026, at 11:59 PM PT

Make sure to enter before the deadline for each sweepstakes you’d like to participate in.

How do I know if I’m eligible for the Local Ticket sweepstakes?
Eligibility is based on your location. The Local Ticket Sweepstakes is open to residents of Atlanta, Dallas, Houston, Los Angeles, Miami, New York/New Jersey, and San Francisco. Canadian residents in Ontario and British Columbia are also eligible. See the Official Rules for full eligibility requirements.

If I cancel my order, will it still count toward a sweepstakes entry?
No, cancelled orders do not count toward the sweepstakes entry.

How will I know if I won tickets to a local or finals game?
Winners will be contacted via email by our partner, Probability LLC. Winner notifications for each sweepstakes are as follows:

FIFA World Cup 2026™ Local Ticket Sweepstakes — Between June 15 and June 19, 2026
FIFA World Cup 2026™ Final Sweepstakes — Approximately July 8, 2026.

Winners will have 24 hours to respond to claim their tickets.

Why does it say “No purchase necessary” when it is asking me to complete orders to enter?
No purchase is necessary to participate. Although DashPass members can conveniently lock in their pick by completing eligible orders, a free alternative method of entry is also available. Making a purchase does not improve your chances of winning.

What is DashPass?

DashPass benefits apply only to eligible orders from DashPass merchants that meet the minimum subtotal requirement, excluding fees and taxes. Subtotal minimums will be identified on DoorDash for each DashPass-eligible merchant.

DashPass is currently available in the United States and Canada with some areas excluded. See full terms here.

My DashPass Benefits did not apply?

  • If you are a DashPass subscriber but your order does not meet the minimum basket subtotal, your DashPass benefits will not apply. Additionally, to make sure your order is eligible, look for the green DashPass icon underneath the merchant’s name. In order to make sure benefits are applied correctly please follow these steps:

    • Check the DoorDash app or Doordash.com for restaurants near you that have the green checkmark.

  • DashPass Members get $0 delivery fees and reduced services fee on all eligible orders that meet the subtotal minimum as shown in the app.

  • DashPass subscribers save an average of $4-5 per eligible order. With new restaurants added and more on the way, you’ll spend more time picking the food you want and less time hunting for deals across delivery platforms.

I see an unauthorized charge of $9.99.

  • We know that seeing an unfamiliar charge on your account can be alarming. We’re here to help. If you see an unknown charge:

    • Consider who else has access to your account. If a family member or partner has your login info, it’s possible for them to place an order with your saved payment information from a different device.

    • If you don’t have a DoorDash account, consider all parties with whom you have willingly shared credit card information. It’s possible that they used your card to place an order with their own account.

    • If the bank statement says DoorDash DashPass or DashPass then it is a charge for our subscription service. You can verify the same by opening Manage DashPass Banner and check Billing History.

What else is included?
  • Subscribers enjoy exclusive member benefits, like priority customer support and DashPass-only promotions. When you subscribe to DashPass you will be able to redeem the benefits on both Caviar and DoorDash. ​​​​​​
Will my DashPass benefits apply to both Caviar and DoorDash?
  • Yes! Please use the same login information for both Caviar and DoorDash. Your DashPass benefits will automatically be available on both platforms.
Who is eligible for DashPass free trial?
  • We offer a free trial for users who have not previously tried DashPass (whether on a free or paid plan). Once your trial is over, you will be automatically enrolled in the membership plan you selected at sign-up and a payment method in your DoorDash account will be charged. Your membership will auto-renew on your membership billing date until you cancel. DoorDash may change the eligibility requirements for a free DashPass trial at any time without notice. See DashPass terms here and cancellation instructions here.
What will happen if I cancel my free trial?
  • If you cancel during a trial period, your benefits will be terminated immediately. If you cancel after the billing date your subscription will be charged to your default payment method and DashPass benefits will be valid till the end of the billing cycle.
How much does it cost?
  • Get all of the above for just $9.99/month with the monthly plan or $96/year ($8/month) with the Annual Plan. With the Annual Plan, you save more upfront and with our monthly plan, it’s a subscription without the commitment - you can cancel anytime.
How can I sign up for DashPass?

Mobile app users

To sign up for DashPass on the DoorDash app follow these steps:

  1. Open your DoorDash app

  2. Tap the account icon at the top of the screen

  3. Tap “Get $0 delivery fees with DashPass”

  4. DashPass benefits and a link to Terms and Conditions are displayed on the “Get DashPass” page

  5. The recurring monthly charge will be billed to the card displayed on screen (this is your default card on file with the last 4 digits displayed)

  6. You can change to a different card by clicking on Change

  7. Tap on “Get DashPass” button to sign up

  8. You will get an in-app confirmation after successfully signing up

Desktop users

To sign up for DashPass on the DoorDash website follow these steps:

  1. Log in to your account on the DoorDash website

  2. Click Account in the bottom left corner

  3. Select Get Free Deliveries

  4. DashPass Benefits and a link to Terms and Conditions are displayed on the “Get DashPass” page

  5. The recurring monthly charge will be billed to the card displayed on screen (this is your default card on file with the last 4 digits displayed)

  6. You can change to a different card by clicking on Payment

  7. Select Get DashPass button to sign up

  8. You will get an in-app confirmation after successfully signing up

How can I use it?

  • Select an eligible restaurant and add items to your cart

  • Eligible restaurants are marked with a green checkmark

  • You can proceed to checkout after meeting the order minimum

  • If the DashPass subtotal order minimum was not met, the difference to reach the DashPass minimum will be displayed in the checkout page

  • DashPass savings will be displayed on the checkout page

We’re excited to welcome you as a DashPass user!

Still have questions? We’re here for you! Click here to contact our live support.

*An order minimum of $10 applies in the following areas: Bakersfield (CA), Charlotte (NC), Cincinnati (OH), Dallas (TX), Denver/Boulder (CO), Indianapolis (IN), Los Angeles (CA), Orange County (CA), Phoenix (AZ), Sacramento (CA), Salt Lake City (UT), Tulsa (AZ)

The $25 off will be available to redeem the day after the Qualifying Period ends and must be used within 8 days of becoming available to redeem.

DoorDash for Business Credits Back - Terms and Conditions

DoorDash for Business Credits Back - Terms and Conditions

Effective Date: June 24, 2025

Unless stated otherwise, defined terms within these terms and conditions have the same meaning as terms defined with the DoorDash for Business Terms and Conditions and the DoorDash Terms and Conditions.

DoorDash for Business Credits Reward. DoorDash may provide certain DoorDash for Business users a credit back reward, where select users will earn a percentage of their restaurant order subtotal back as DoorDash credits (DDfB Credits Reward). The DDfB Credits Reward will not be available to all DoorDash for business users, but only available to select DoorDash for business users as determined by DoorDash in its sole discretion. Subject to eligibility requirements, no additional registration, enrollment, or information is required for participation in the DDfB Credits Reward program. The DDfB Credits Rewards program is available for select US users only.

Earning credits. The DDfB Credits Reward will only be earned on restaurant orders with a subtotal of $15 or greater (excluding fees, taxes and gratuity) that are paid for using a payment method agreed upon by DoorDash and your Program Manager or for some end users, only if the purchase is made using their Business Profile. For example, DoorDash and your Program Manager may agree that a credit card issued to you by your Program Manager such as a corporate credit card is the only payment method that will earn the DDfB Credits Reward. Alternatively DoorDash and your Program Manager may agree that any payment method used when ordering from your Business Profile will earn the DDfB Credit Reward. The DDfB Credits Reward will not be earned on non restaurant orders including orders for groceries, alcohol, retail products, health products, pet products and convenience products and other non restaurant orders. The DDfB Credits Reward will not be earned on any pickup orders. Whether an order qualifies for the DDfB Credits Reward will be at DoorDash’s sole discretion and DoorDash reserves the right to exclude certain orders from earning the DDfB Credits Reward. The value of the DoorDash credits earned by the user will be calculated as 5% of the user’s order subtotal (rounded to the nearest cent). The subtotal value will not include any fees, taxes or gratuity and will also not include any promotional discounts, or the value of any DoorDash credits used to purchase the order. Credits will not be earned or on any restricted items as determined by DoorDash. DoorDash may change the value of credit earned on each transaction from time to time at its sole discretion.

Maximum credits. Users participating in the DDfB Credits Reward will only be entitled to earn a maximum of $50 worth of DoorDash credits for each transaction and maximum of $1,000 worth of DoorDash credits in a calendar year. DoorDash may change the maximum value of credits a customer may earn from time to time at its sole discretion.

Using credits. Credits will be deposited to a user’s account within 5 business days of transaction that qualifies for the DDfB Credits Reward. Credits have no cash value, may not be exchanged or redeemed for cash or any equivalent, and are not intended as payment. Credits are non-transferrable. DoorDash credits can only be redeemed for future DoorDash orders on www.doordash.com or in the DoorDash app with the latest version, and within DoorDash service areas and service hours. Credits can only be applied to orders in the jurisdiction of the currency in which the credits are issued. Credits cannot be applied to the purchase of alcohol or other restricted items where prohibited. Credits cannot be applied to the purchase of any gift cards unless otherwise permitted. DoorDash reserves the right to refuse or restrict the use of credits on any order.

Canceled Orders. Orders that are canceled whether by Program Manager, end user, Merchant or DoorDash will not be eligible to earn DoorDash credits.

Expiration of Credits. Credits earned under the DDfB Credits Reward program will expire 180 days after those credits are deposited into a user’s account. Should credits expire, the credits will be forfeited and users will not be entitled to any substitute, credit or compensation for the expired DoorDash credits.

Fraud and misconduct. DoorDash reserves the right to prohibit consumers from earning, accruing or redeeming credits and canceling a user’s ability to use the DoorDash platform without notice if DoorDash believes in its sole discretion that the user is or is attempting to act fraudulently or in bad faith when seeking to earn, accrue or redeem credits. DoorDash may also revoke a user’s credits at any time without prior notice.

Modification; Termination. DoorDash reserves the right to modify, suspend, terminate or discontinue the DDfB Credits Reward program at any time without any notice to users. In the event of termination or modification of the DDfB Credits Reward program, users will not be entitled to any substitute, credit or compensation for unredeemed credits.

Miscellaneous. User participation and use of the DDfB Credits Reward program is subject to the DoorDash Consumer Terms and Conditions, the DoorDash for Business Terms and Conditions and the Promotional Offer and Credits Terms and Conditions. Annual Plan Credits Reward are only available for select US residents only. Drone Delivery

DoorDash has partnered with Wing, Flytrex, and Manna to offer drone delivery from select local restaurants in eligible areas. Drone delivery is currently available in parts of Dallas–Fort Worth, TX, and Charlotte, NC.

Availability depends on your address and local conditions.

How do I place a drone order?

Find a drone-eligible store on the DoorDash homepage using banners or the drone filter.

  1. Add items to your cart. Smaller orders are more likely to qualify due to drone weight and size limits.

  2. Confirm you have a drone delivery zone at your address.

  3. Select your delivery zone.

  4. Choose Drone at checkout.

  5. Track your order in the app and watch it fly to you.

What is a drone delivery zone?

A drone delivery zone is a safe, designated drop-off area at your location that meets operational requirements.

If your address does not currently qualify, you can request a delivery zone by emailing air-support@doordash.com. While we aim to support as many addresses as possible, not all locations will meet eligibility requirements.

When is drone delivery available?

Drone delivery hours may vary throughout the year, but service is generally available during daylight hours.

Availability may be temporarily paused due to weather or other conditions that impact safe flight.

What items can be delivered by drone?

  • Drone deliveries are subject to weight and volume limits.

  • Some items or item combinations may not qualify.

  • Alcohol is not eligible for drone delivery at this time.

How does drone delivery work?

You place an order just like any other DoorDash delivery — selecting items, adding them to your cart, and tracking progress in the app.

Once ready, your order is loaded onto a drone at a nearby launch site and flown directly to your delivery zone.

The drone gently lowers your package to a clear area at your location.

How do I receive my order?

When the drone arrives, it will hover and lower your order using a tether.

The package is automatically released once it touches the ground. There’s no need to unclip or assist with the delivery.

For safety, please wait until the tether has fully retracted before touching your order.

Please note, it’s very important not to touch the package until after the tether line has safely retracted.

Have further questions or feedback?

Contact us anytime at air-support@doordash.com

Going Out Card Linking Help Article

Dine Out Rewards with DashPass

DashPass members can now earn DoorDash credits when they dine in at select local restaurants. Simply link a card to your DoorDash account and pay in person — your credits will appear automatically.

How It Works

When you dine at participating restaurants using a linked card, you can earn DoorDash credits in two ways:

  • First-time visits: Get up to $15 back in DoorDash credits when you claim the offer in the app and try a participating restaurant for the first time.

  • Ongoing rewards: Get 5% back in DoorDash credits on every in-store purchase at participating restaurants.

Credits are automatically deposited into your DoorDash account after you pay.

Eligibility Requirements

To use Dine Out Rewards, you must:

  • Be an active DashPass subscriber

  • Have a Visa or Mastercard card linked to your DoorDash account

  • Dine at a participating restaurant, as shown in the DoorDash app

Note: Other payment methods such as Pin Debit, PayPal, and Venmo are not eligible.

Getting Started

  1. Open the DoorDash app and tap the “Dine Out” or “Going Out” section.

  2. Link your eligible card when prompted.

  3. Explore participating restaurants near you and, for a first-time visit offer, claim the offer in the app.

  4. Pay in person with your linked card.

  5. Receive DoorDash credits automatically — no need to track anything manually.

FAQs

Do I need to claim an offer before dining?

Yes. For first-time visit offers (up to $15 back), make sure to tap “Claim” in the app before you go. The 5% back reward applies automatically after your first visit, as long as your card is linked.

What types of cards are supported?

Only Visa and Mastercard cards can be linked. Prepaid cards, debit-only cards, or other payment methods (like Apple Pay) are not eligible.

Can I use my debit card?

Yes, you can use a debit card using one of the networks listed. However, the transaction must be processed through the credit networks. Select “credit” instead of “debit” if given the option on the terminal or ask the staff to run it as credit. Any PIN based transactions are not eligible.

How do I know which restaurants are participating?

Participating restaurants are listed in the DoorDash app under the “Dine Out” section. You’ll see clear reward details on each restaurant’s page.

When will I receive my credits?

Credits are typically deposited into your DoorDash account immediately after you pay with your linked card though in some cases it may take up to 24 hours. You’ll see a notification and can track them in the “My Stuff” section of the app.

Can I remove a card or stop participating?

Yes. You can manage or unlink cards from your account at any time in the DoorDash app.

For more information or support, visit the Dine Out section in your DoorDash app.

Grocery Errands Prohibited Items

Grocery Errands Prohibited Items

Requests for prohibited items will not be fulfilled. If your order contains only prohibited items, it will be canceled. If your order contains both prohibited and non-prohibited items, only the non-prohibited items are eligible to be fulfilled.

Prohibited items include:

  • Alcoholic beverages

  • Tobacco products

  • Cannabis, CBD, and/or hemp derived products

  • Gift cards

  • Lottery tickets

  • Firearms and ammunition

  • Prescription medications

  • Over-the-counter medications that require age verification

  • Fireworks

  • Any other age-restricted items

Some items that are prohibited for Grocery Errands, like alcohol and over-the-counter medications that require age verification, may be available to purchase from other merchants on DoorDash. See merchant store pages for availability.

Guidelines for Third Party Data Requests and Service of Legal Documents

The following guidelines are intended to inform private parties, including civil litigants and criminal defendants, about the legal process for seeking records from DoorDash. These are merely guidelines, and this information may change at any time.These guidelines apply to non-law enforcement requests. For law enforcement requests, we recommend browsing Guidelines for Law Enforcement Authorities.

Where should I send service of legal documents to DoorDash?

DoorDash requires that all legal documents (including complaints and subpoenas) be served on its registered agent for service of process. Consult the Secretary of State’s website for your state to find the name and contact information for DoorDash’s current registered agent. Our acceptance of legal process does not waive any legal objections DoorDash may have and may raise in response to the request.

What legal process does DoorDash require before producing data to private parties?

DoorDash generally requires a valid subpoena issued in accordance with applicable law before we can process private requests for information. We require non-law enforcement subpoenas to be personally served through our registered agent for service of process.

What form of requests does DoorDash require, and how are requests processed?

We review each subpoena for facial and substantive validity, and will reject requests that do not meet this bar. We require requests to be narrowly tailored, and will reject overly broad, vague, or unduly burdensome requests. Before making a request, please check to see if the information sought is publicly available.In order to make sure your subpoena is valid, we ask for the following:

  • A sufficiently narrow and defined time period;

  • A specific reference (i.e., you must uniquely identify a merchant, Dasher, or customer ideally by more than just a name)

  • Your contact information (i.e., name and email address and/or phone number)

When we determine that we are required by law to disclose data in response to a subpoena, we will search for and disclose data that we are reasonably able to locate and retrieve.Note: We will not respond to emergency requests received from non-law enforcement officials. Non-law enforcement officials aware of an emergency situation should immediately and directly contact local law enforcement.

Does DoorDash provide a certificate of authentication or expert testimony?

We may provide a certification from our records custodian but are generally not able to provide in person or expert witness testimony.

Loblaws Grocery Delivery Information

We’re launching Loblaws Grocery delivery in select markets in Canada.

Did you receive a sign-up message or did a Loblaws order appear on your app while Dashing? Find out everything you need to know about a successful delivery below.

How do I know this is a Loblaws delivery?

When you get an order, you will receive a notification and the delivery details will appear in your app. The term “Grocery Order” will be mentioned in the details.

The store name can be Loblaws Grocery or one of their store banners.

Loblaws Grocery store banners include:

  • Real Canadian Superstore

  • City Market

  • Provigo

  • Maxi

  • Your Independent Grocer/Independent City Market

  • Loblaws

How does it work?

1. Accepting - Loblaws delivery opportunities show up just like regular deliveries, and you may receive one of these orders while on a Dash.

2. Picking up - Once you arrive at the store, park in one of the designated “PC Express Pickup” reserved parking spots. Call the store with the provided phone number, identify yourself as a delivery service and tell them the customer name on the order and order number. A Loblaws associate will meet you in the parking area, confirm that the order and customer match what you have on your app, and load the car for you. Please wait in the car until the colleague brings out the order.

When picking up from Loblaws, you should see this message in the pickup instructions and a photo of a PC Express Parking Sign:

3. Loblaws Process: When you arrive at the store, park in one of the designated PC Express spots or the nearest spot if all are occupied. Do not enter the store - we’ll bring the order to your car! Park in one of the designated PC Express spots and call the store. Please identify yourself as a delivery service and tell us the customer name of the order or order number. Please wait in the car until the colleague brings out the order.

4. Delivering - If you need to communicate with the customer, please let them know that this delivery is coming from Loblaws.

5. Dropping Off - Loblaws requests that Dashers complete a contactless delivery. When you arrive, please call the customer to notify of delivery and follow customer drop-off instructions carefully. If no instructions are available, call the customer and coordinate a safe location to leave the order. All Loblaws deliveries require a photo of the completed delivery and a brief description of the delivery drop-off. If there is no safe place to leave the order, you may chat with DoorDash Support so an agent can help you.

Meet Your New AI Assistant

Meet Your New AI Assistant

Everyday shopping on DoorDash is now faster and more intuitive. We’re piloting a new AI-powered Assistant designed to help you plan, discover, and shop with ease.

Your Assistant helps you go from an idea to a full cart in seconds. Whether you’re ordering meals, stocking up on essentials, or managing your weekly needs, it can suggest items based on your preferences, build your cart quickly, and surface helpful recommendations along the way.

You can use it to:

  • Search based on vibe or mood

  • Find recipes or meal ideas tailored to you

  • Quickly reorder your go-to meals

  • Add ingredients or household items directly to your cart

  • Plan ahead for the week, from breakfasts to snacks and more

Try prompts like:

  • “A cozy meal that isn’t too heavy”

  • “I need snacks for my kids for the week.”

  • “Something healthy that isn’t a salad”

  • “Add all the ingredients for spaghetti carbonara to my cart.”

  • “Lunch I can eat at my desk”

We’re committed to responsibly improving your shopping experience by monitoring performance, learning from feedback, and thoughtfully expanding what this technology can do.

Information you share in your messages may be used to personalize future chat sessions. If you want the Assistant to forget something and not use it to inform future interactions, you can request that directly in the chat.

Important things to keep in mind:

Always review the items in your cart to ensure they fit your specific requirements, quantities, and dietary needs before checking out.

  • AI can make mistakes: The Assistant is powered by AI and can make mistakes.

  • Informational use only: All AI-generated responses and suggestions are provided for reference only.

  • Not medical advice: No response or product detail is intended to replace professional medical advice. Don’t rely on this feature to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any health condition, disease, or for making medical decisions. Always seek the advice of a physician or qualified health provider.

  • Dietary guidance: Nutritional data is for general reference only. Please consult a nutritionist or dietary professional to verify that products meet your individual health needs. If you have any serious concerns about dietary content, please confirm directly with the restaurant.

  • Product accuracy: Suggestions are based on available product data which may not always be up-to-date. Always verify the physical packaging for the most accurate information regarding safety, nutrition, and ingredients (especially regarding allergens) or confirm with the restaurant prior to ordering.

  • Alcohol safety: Please consume responsibly. Alcohol delivery is strictly for individuals 21+.

  • Availability: As this is a pilot program, access to this feature is currently limited to select users.

When you text the DoorDash AI Assistant, you agree to receive recurring automated text messages from DoorDash at the number you use. Messages are generated by AI and may contain errors, so always review your cart before checking out. Message frequency depends on how you use the Assistant, and message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP at any time to opt out, or HELP for help. Your messages are processed by DoorDash and our messaging provider and may be used to personalize your DoorDash experience; you can ask the Assistant to forget information at any time. This feature is available to DoorDash account holders in the U.S. only, and your use of this feature is governed by the DoorDash Consumer Terms, Privacy Policy, and all other DoorDash policies applicable to your use of DoorDash products and services.

From time to time, DoorDash (as defined in DoorDash’s Consumer Terms and Conditions) may offer you a promotion, discount, credits, or other incentive in exchange for you submitting a photo that we approve (collectively, “Offer”). To qualify for and receive the Offer, you must submit a photo of food that you ordered, meet the requirements indicated in the specific Offer, and comply with all of the terms and conditions below. Each specific Offer will contain details applicable to such Offer (e.g., amount of credits you may receive, expiration date).

Offer only available to select customers as indicated on the DoorDash platform when logged into their DoorDash account and for photos of select items. Offer may end without notice. You must have an active DoorDash account in order to receive an Offer. All Offers are subject to DoorDash’s Consumer Terms and Conditions and Promotional Offers and Credits Terms and Conditions.

Your submitted photo must: (1) be selected by DoorDash; (2) be of an eligible, unique menu item from a completed order (e.g., 5 photos of the same menu item are only eligible for an Offer once); (3) be tagged with the name of the menu item; (4) be an original photo that you have taken; (5) meet the DoorDash Review & Photo Guidelines; and (6) not be only of a prepackaged item (such as a bottled or canned beverage, bag of chips, or sauce), utensils, or napkins. You do not need to submit a review or rating in order to submit a photo. DoorDash reserves the right to use or display your photo even if you don’t qualify for the Offer or to not use or display your photo even if you do qualify for the Offer. Multiple photos of the same menu item are only eligible for an Offer once. You will be notified via email if your photo has been selected.

By submitting a photo, you grant DoorDash a perpetual, irrevocable, transferable, fully paid, royalty-free, non-exclusive, worldwide, fully sublicensable right and license to use, copy, display, publish, modify, remove, publicly perform, translate, create derivative works from, distribute, and/or otherwise use the photo in connection with DoorDash’s business and in all forms now known or hereafter invented, without notification to and/or approval by you. You represent and warrant that you are the owner of, or otherwise have the right to provide, any photo that you submit. You further represent and warrant that any photo you submit (a) does not violate any third-party right, including any copyright, trademark, patent, trade secret, privacy right, right of publicity, or any other intellectual property or proprietary right; (b) does not contain material that is false, intentionally misleading, or defamatory; (c) does not contain any material that is unlawful; (d) does not violate any law or regulation; and (e) does not violate, and is governed by, DoorDash’s Consumer Terms and Conditions.

If the Offer is for you to receive DoorDash credits: (i) credits will be issued in the currency of the country associated with your DoorDash account, (ii) credits will be automatically added to your account and applied to your next order, (iii) credits may expire, (iv) amount of credits will be stated in the Offer, (v) maximum amount of credits that may be earned in connection with submitting photos to DoorDash is $500 per person per year, (vi) amount of credits and any other monetary or non-monetary consideration are inclusive of any applicable taxes, and (vii) credits are subject to DoorDash’s Promotional Offers and Credits Terms and Conditions. Further, if the Offer is for you to receive DoorDash credits in an amount equal to a percentage of an eligible item you ordered, in addition to the foregoing: (1) percentage will be applied to the price of the eligible item excluding fees and taxes, and (2) percentage and maximum amount of credits will be stated in the Offer. Any tax liabilities in relation to any supply by you to DoorDash are solely your responsibility.

If the Offer involves a percentage discount off a future order: (a) discount will be taken off the subtotal, (b) discount may be limited to a specific merchant, (c) discount may require use of a promo code, (d) discount percentage and maximum dollar value of the discount will be stated in the Offer, and (e) discount may expire.

Our response to a recent cybersecurity incident

Our Response to a Recent Cybersecurity Incident

Our team recently identified and shut down a cybersecurity incident that involved an unauthorized third party gaining access to and taking certain user information.

Importantly, no sensitive information was accessed by the unauthorized third party and we have no indication the data has been misused for fraud or identity theft at this time.

We want to let you know what happened, the type of data that was accessed by the unauthorized party, and how we’re responding.

What happened?

A DoorDash employee was recently targeted in a social engineering scam. The response team identified the incident, shut down the unauthorized party’s access, started an investigation, and referred the matter to law enforcement.

Who was affected?

Our investigation has determined that some users whose data is maintained by DoorDash were affected in connection with this incident.

What data was accessed?

The personal information accessed varied by individual and may have included:

  • First and last name

  • Phone number

  • Email address

  • Physical address

What data was not accessed?

No sensitive information, such as Social Security numbers or other government-issued identification numbers, driver’s license information, or bank or payment card information, was accessed.

What is DoorDash doing to respond?

At DoorDash, we believe in continuous improvement and getting 1% better every day. We are committed to protecting your privacy and have already taken the following steps to help prevent events like this from happening again:

  • Deployed new enhancements to our security systems to help prevent and detect malicious activities of this nature

  • Implemented additional training and awareness for our employees around various social engineering scams

  • Brought in an external firm to assist in our investigation and provide specialized support

  • Referred the matter to law enforcement for ongoing investigation

​​We are grateful to all our users for their trust in our platform and want to earn that trust, every time you choose to use or partner with DoorDash. We apologize for any concern this may cause. Any questions on the matter can be directed to our Support team, available by phone at (855) 431-0459, or through chat directly on your DoorDash app.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How do I know if I was affected by this issue?

A: We have notified affected DoorDash users where required.

Q: I am a Wolt or Deliveroo customer. Was I affected?

A: No. Only DoorDash users were affected by this incident.

Q: What types of DoorDash users were impacted?

A: This incident impacted a mix of consumers, Dashers and merchants.

Q: If my information was affected, why didn’t DoorDash notify me directly?

A: DoorDash has directly notified affected users where required, published information about the incident on our website, and set up a dedicated call center to answer questions from users.

Q: Was my payment card information compromised in connection with this incident?

A: No. Based on our investigation, the incident only impacted basic contact information.

Q: Do I need to do anything to protect my account or information?

A: This incident did not involve sensitive information, such as payment or bank account information, and we have no indication that affected personal information has been misused for fraud or identity theft at this time.

It is always a good idea to be cautious of unsolicited communications that ask for your personal information or refer you to a web page asking for personal information, and avoid clicking on links or downloading attachments from suspicious emails.

Q: What is DoorDash doing to prevent this from happening again?

A: At DoorDash, we believe in continuous improvement and getting 1% better every day. We are committed to protecting your privacy and have already increased training for our employees to help prevent social engineering scams, deployed new improvements to our security systems, enlisted the support of an external firm for specialized support, and referred the matter to law enforcement to help prevent events like this from happening again.

Q: How can I get more information?

A: Any questions on the matter can be directed to our Support team, available by phone at (855) 431-0459, or through chat directly on your DoorDash app.
