PC Optimum Loyalty Program

What is the PC Optimum <> DoorDash Loyalty Program?

PC Optimum on DoorDash is Canada’s most adopted loyalty program now available on DoorDash across restaurants and Loblaws’ banners for grocery and drugstore. Link your PC Optimum account on DoorDash and earn loyalty points on every $1 you spend on the DoorDash app across restaurants and eligible grocery and drugstore banners. Please reference the PC Optimum website for the full terms & conditions.

How do I link my PC Optimum account with DoorDash?

Linking your PC Optimum account with DoorDash is a simple and seamless process. Once you link your PC Optimum account, you can earn PC Optimum points on DoorDash through an exciting range of offers.

Step 1: You can link your account in any of the following ways:

  1. My rewards page

    1. Open the DoorDash app and log in.

    2. Tap the “Me” tab (bottom right), then tap “Rewards” (top right where you also access orders, settings, and profile)

  2. Loblaw Banner Store Pages

    1. Visit any Loblaw banner store page (excluding T&T Supermarket).

    2. Tap the PC Optimum logo in the top right corner.

  3. Cart Page

    1. Add items from a Loblaw banner store to your cart.

    2. Tap “View Cart”, and you’ll see the option to link your PC Optimum account.

Step 2: ​​​​Tap on “Continue”, then sign into your PC account.

Step 3: Tap on “Confirming linking”.

How are PC Optimum points earned through DoorDash?

PC Optimum points are earned on DoorDash by linking your PC Optimum account and placing an eligible order. On checkout, points will automatically apply on eligible orders*.

Earn rate: DoorDash orders will earn 5 PC Optimum points per $ spent across restaurants, Loblaws and PC Rapid Delivery orders. For a limited time only as a launch promotion, customers can also earn 2x the earn rate on eligible restaurant and grocery orders.

* Customers can earn points across all restaurants and the following grocery and convenience stores: Loblaws, Loblaws City Market, Shoppers Drug Mart, Fortinos, Pharmaprix, PC Express™ Rapid Delivery, PC Express™ livraison rapide, Provigo, Real Atlantic Superstore, Zehrs, Your Independent Grocer, Valu-Mart, and DashMart.

Why am I getting an error message when I try to link my PC Optimum account on DoorDash?

Check your app version
To link your PC Optimum account, you must have the latest version of the DoorDash app installed on your device:

  • iOS (Apple devices): Minimum version 7.22.0

  • Android devices: Minimum version 15.223.0

If your app version is older than these, please update it via the App Store (iOS) or Google Play Store (Android).

Is PC Optimum on DoorDash available across Canada?

PC Optimum on DoorDash is currently available in all Canadian provinces, except Manitoba.
If you are located in Manitoba, the feature will not be accessible at this time.

Still need help?

If you’ve confirmed your app is up to date and you’re in a supported province but still see the error, contact DoorDash Support for further assistance.

How do I see my points history?

DoorDash makes it easy to track your PC Optimum™ points, so you always know how much you’ve earned.

To view your points activity:

  1. As a logged in user on the DoorDash App, go to the “Me” tab in the bottom right.

  2. On your account page, tap “Rewards” in the top right (where you also access orders, settings, and profile).

  3. Scroll to the “Partner reward” section and select “PC Optimum”.

  4. Scroll to the “More options” section and tap on “Points activity” to view your points history.

You’ll be able to see a detailed breakdown of the points you’ve earned from eligible DoorDash orders.

What do I do if I disagree with points awarded?

At DoorDash, it’s our priority to ensure you are accurately rewarded for your PC Optimum points. If you believe the points awarded for an order are incorrect or missing, we’re here to help. To resolve the issue, please follow these steps to contact customer support:

  1. In your DoorDash app and tap on the “Me” tab in the bottom right corner.

  2. Tap “Settings”, then select “Get help”.

  3. Choose the order you need help with and follow the prompts to contact customer support.

Our team will review your case and ensure any points discrepancies are addressed as quickly as possible.

How do I unlink my PC Optimum account with DoorDash?

If your account PC Optimum account is not linked to your DoorDash account, you will earn PC Optimum points on eligible orders. If you wish to unlink your account,

  1. As a logged in user on the DoorDash App, go to the “Me” tab in the bottom right.

  2. On your account page, tap “Rewards” in the top right (where you also access orders, settings, and profile).

  3. Scroll to the “Partner reward” section and select “PC Optimum”.

  4. Scroll to the “More options” section and tap on “Unlink”, then “Continue to unlink”.

PC Optimum Terms & Conditions

General Partnership T&Cs

Link your PC Optimum™ account on DoorDash to start earning points on Canada’s largest loyalty points ecosystem starting June 16, 2025. You can earn PC Optimum™points when you order from your favorite restaurants and Loblaw banner stores on DoorDash.

A PC Optimum™ member must link their PC Optimum™ account with their DoorDash account to be eligible to earn PC Optimum™ points through the PC Optimum™ and DoorDash collaboration. Limit of one DoorDash account linked to any PC Optimum™ at one time. An account may be linked by accessing the PC Optimum™ mobile application or website, or via the member’s DoorDash account on the DoorDash website or mobile application (the “DoorDash Platform”). Points will automatically apply at checkout on eligible transactions. A member may unlink their PC Optimum™ account from their DoorDash account at any time.

Upon the successful linking of an account, a PC Optimum™ member will earn 5 PC Optimum™ points per $1 spent on (1) eligible purchases from participating restaurants on the DoorDash Platform, and (2) on qualifying purchases at participating Loblaw banner stores and Shoppers Drug Mart® stores that are available on the DoorDash Platform (each, an “Eligible Transaction”). Occasionally, a PC Optimum™ member may earn additional PC Optimum™ points per $1 spent on an eligible transaction during certain promotional opportunities that are sent to all or a certain group of PC Optimum™ members. Additional eligibility conditions may apply.

PC Optimum™ points cannot be earned on any of the following: (i) the purchase of tobacco, lottery tickets, or alcohol, (ii) deposits (e.g., a water bottle deposit, as it is not a purchase), (iii) gift cards, prepaid card products and wireless or long distance phone cards, (iv) transit tickets and passes, event tickets and post office transactions; (v) passport photos, (vi) cash back, (vii) gifts with purchases, (viii) delivery charges (where applicable),(ix) purchases made through non-participating licensed merchants located within or adjacent to Participating Stores or Program Participants, (x) any other products or services that may not legally be offered in connection with the Program, including pharmacy-related transactions in certain provinces (see PC Optimum™ general terms and conditions for more information about pharmacy-related transactions), (xi) purchases made through embedded digital stores on other third party websites or platforms or otherwise completed outside of the DoorDash Platform, or (xii) any other products or services that we may specify from time to time or where prohibited by law or as specified in the general PC Optimum™ program terms and conditions found at www.pcoptimum.ca/company-policy/terms-and-conditions.

You must be a PC Optimum™ member to earn points. To register as a PC Optimum™ member, visit pcoptimum.ca

Setting Your Business Profile for Easier Expensing

What is a Business Profile?

  1. A Business Profile is a feature that allows customers to more easily track and expense work meal spend. This feature allows you to:

    1. Separate orders placed for personal vs. work occasions

    2. Set a default card for your business expenses through DoorDash

    3. Set a default email for your business receipts to be sent to

    4. Connect with an expense provider to automatically send receipts to the provider, so it’s ready for you when you want to submit the expense report for that meal

Why Use a Business Profile?
  • A Business Profile simplifies managing business expenses and keeps personal and business meals separate. It helps users save time with expense reporting and companies save time chasing receipts for expense reports.
How to Set Up My Business Profile

  1. From your DoorDash homepage, click Account on the left-hand sidebar.

  2. Click Account again from under Account Settings.

  3. Under the Business Profile section of the Account page, click Create profile.

Desktop

Mobile (IOS)

Once within the ‘Create Your Business profile’ window:

  1. Fill out the email you would like business order receipts sent to. (Optional)

  2. Add + select the default Payment Method you want associated with your Business Profile.

    • Note: You can use the same default payment method for business profile as for your personal profile on DoorDash.

  3. Click Create Profile.

Desktop

Mobile (IOS)

4. Next, you’ll have the option to connect your business profile to an integrated expense provider, to automatically send business profile order receipts to that provider. If you would like to link an expense provider, click the corresponding Link button.

  • Currently, business profile offers Emburse Enterprise (Chrome River), Emburse Professional (Certify), Emburse Spend, SAP Concur, Expensify, Ramp, and Brex. We are constantly adding new providers to check back if your provider is not yet available.

Desktop

Mobile (IOS)

You can also create a Business Profile from the ‘Business’ tab of your Orders page:

Desktop

Mobile (IOS)

Linking to Your Expense ProviderNote: This experience varies by expense provider

For SAP Concur

  1. Once you click Link next to SAP Concur, you’ll be brought to the login page of their expense provider

    Note: Please log into Concur with the email address that’s connected to your Concur account. This email address may differ from your DoorDash account or business profile email address

Desktop

Mobile (IOS)

  1. Once you have logged into your account you will see a confirmation page.

For Emburse, Expensify, Ramp, & Brex

  1. Once you click Link next to the expense provider of your choice, you’ll be prompted to verify your work email via a 6-digit code sent to your work email inbox

  2. Verify the code to complete the expense provider integration.

  • If you have created a business profile without setting up expense provider linkage, you can do it later from several places:

    • You can start the linking process from the banner on your Orders page:

  • You can start the linking process from the Business Profiles section of your Account page, click Edit Profile, then under ‘Expense provider’ click Link:

Editing your Business Profile

Once you’ve created your Business Profile, the ‘Create Profile’ button in your Account Settings will change to Edit Profile. From the same window as before, you can edit both the payment method and email set during your initial Business Profile setup.

How to Use Your Business Profile at Checkout

Once a Business Profile has been created, you can toggle between your Personal and Business Profiles at Checkout on every order. You will find this button under Payment Details, on the Checkout screen:

Desktop

(Checkout Page - Payment Details section - Business Profile toggled ON)

Mobile (iOS)

Please note that this will automatically be set to your Personal profile, and must be toggled to Business manually.

Downloading Your Business Receipt

Once your delivery has been completed, you will receive an email with ‘Business receipt’ in the Subject. This email will contain:

  1. A link to view your Order back in DoorDash

  2. A PDF file attachment containing the business receipt

(Business Receipt Example from PDF Attachment)

Business Receipts in Order History

If you click into Orders from the left sidebar of your DoorDash homepage, you will now see two updates:

  1. Each order is now labeled either a Personal or Business order

  2. You can toggle between ‘Personal,’ ‘Business,’ or ‘All’ order types at the top.

Desktop

(Sample View of Orders Page - Business Orders Toggled)

Mobile (iOS)

Sending Receipts to your Expense Provider

Receipts for any new orders placed under your Business Profile will automatically be sent to your expense account.

You can retroactively submit receipts for past orders by going to your Orders page:

  1. Click View Receipt beside the order.

  2. Scroll to the bottom of your receipt

  3. Click Send Receipt

Please note that receipts will be listed under the name of the restaurant or store, not ‘Doordash’.

FAQ

Can I use the same Payment Method for my Business + Personal Orders?

Yes, you can use the same payment method for both Business and Personal Orders! You can use whichever payment method you need for either.

Can I use the same email for my Business + Personal Orders?

Yes - it can be whatever email you’d like order receipts sent to. This field is optional. Your Business order receipts will default to your DoorDash account email, if this field is left blank.

Is there a way for me to attach an expense code or memo to my Business Profile order?

No, at the moment there is no option to add an expense code or memo to Business Profiles orders.

How do I access my business order receipts?

You can opt in to automatically sharing your receipts with one additional email address. This may be your own work email address, that of a colleague, or internal department for accounting purposes.

You will still get an email receipt to your default DoorDash account email, and you will also get an email receipt to the email associated with your Business Profile.

Can I export my receipts?

After your order is delivered, you will receive an email to the email address provided during Business Profile creation. This will contain a PDF attachment of the business receipt that you may download.

You can also view the order receipts of all past orders by clicking into Orders from the left sidebar of your DoorDash homepage. Clicking the ‘Business’ toggle will filter these to only Business orders.

What expense providers are available?

DoorDash is integrated with Emburse Enterprise (Chrome River), Emburse Professional (Certify), Emburse Spend, SAP Concur, Expensify, Ramp, and Brex.

I used my Personal Profile instead of my Business, or I used my Business Profile instead of my Personal. Can I change which profile was used post-checkout?

If the wrong Profile was selected at checkout, this cannot be reversed. While we can potentially update the payment method used on the order (see below,) the order will still be marked as a ‘Personal’ or ‘Business’ order in your Order History, and the business receipt cannot be altered post-checkout.

Can I change the payment method on this order?

If you paid for your order with a credit card, please reach out to Support for assistance. If you used any other payment method, however, unfortunately this cannot be swapped post-checkout.

What’s the difference between being a DoorDash for Business (DDFB) customer and having a Business Profile?

DoorDash for Business is a corporate benefit program that a company signs up for with the DDFB sales team, while Business Profiles are a separate feature that any individual user can enable on their DoorDash account. Enabling your Business Profile will NOT sign you up for DDFB. If you’re interested in learning more about what DDFB can offer your company, start here.

If you are looking to start a DoorDash for Business account to unlock benefits such as Expensed Meals or corporate DashPass, start here.

If you are trying to join your company’s existing DoorDash for Business Portal, and need assistance, please email our VIP Support at business-support@doordash.com.

Store Rewards - Terms & Conditions

Effective Date: March 14, 2025

Store Rewards Program: From time to time, select Merchants and/or DoorDash may choose to offer a loyalty points program (each, a “Store Rewards Program”) in which consumers accrue loyalty points (“Points”) on eligible orders from a particular Merchant and can redeem Points (from that same Merchant) for a reward selected by the Merchant or DoorDash (each, a “Reward”). Certain Store Rewards Programs are only available to select customers with an active DashPass subscription (DashPass Store Rewards Program). The DashPass Store Rewards Program will not be made available to all customers with an active DashPass subscription, but only to select customers as determined by DoorDash from time to time in its sole discretion.

Subject to eligibility requirements, no additional registration, enrollment, or information is required for participation in the Store Rewards Program or the DashPass Store Rewards Program. Points will accrue automatically on eligible purchases from participating Merchants. Consumers must have a valid DoorDash account and a valid form of accepted payment on file in order to accrue and use Points. Points accrue on a per-Merchant basis and can be redeemed on a per-Merchant basis only.

Canceled Orders: Points will not accrue for any canceled orders, whether canceled by Consumer or by Merchant.

Eligible Items; Restrictions: Each Store Rewards Program is subject to Merchant’s or DoorDash’s selection of how Points are accrued and what Rewards may be earned and redeemed. Points cannot be earned on or redeemed on alcohol items or on any other restricted items, as determined by DoorDash from time to time. Points cannot be redeemed with any other promotion or combined to redeem more than one reward per order. DoorDash and Merchant reserve the right to update at any time which items are eligible to accrue Points for future purchases. To view your current Points with any Merchant, visit the Merchant’s store page on DoorDash.

Redeeming a Reward: Points cannot be redeemed in conjunction with any other promotion or discount. Rewards will be applied toward an order subtotal only (prior to the applicability of any fees). Rewards cannot be redeemed in part and any unused portion of a Reward will be forfeited if the consumer does not redeem the full value of the Reward in one order. For example, if a consumer earns a Reward of $10 off their next order and chooses to redeem the Reward on a $5 order, the full Reward is used on that order and cannot be redeemed on any subsequent order.

Expiration of Rewards: Merchants or DoorDash may choose whether Rewards accrued for their Store Rewards Programs either (i) expire after a specified period of time following their accrual; or (ii) never expire. A consumer’s progress towards a Reward will expire after a certain period of time as determined by DoorDash in its sole discretion. Rewards as well as progress towards a Reward accrued under the DashPass Store Rewards Program will expire after a certain period of time as determined by DoorDash in its sole discretion. Should a consumer’s Reward or progress towards a Reward expire, consumers will not be entitled to any substitute, credit, or compensation. For Merchants whose Rewards expire after a specified period of time, consumers may view any Rewards they’ve accrued and their expiration date by visiting the Merchant’s store page on DoorDash.

In-Store Orders: Notwithstanding any other provision in these terms and conditions to the contrary, a consumer may be able to accrue Points and earn and redeem Rewards for qualifying in-store orders (as determined by DoorDash) at certain locations of participating Merchants where such orders meet all applicable requirements of DoorDash’s Going Out program (which may require, for example, the consumer to “check-in” at the Merchant’s location) (“In-Store Orders”). For participating Merchants, a consumer’s In-Store Orders and eligible delivery or pickup orders on the DoorDash platform (“Marketplace Orders”) will each contribute toward accruing Points and earning Rewards, and a consumer may redeem a Reward in connection with either an In-Store Order or a Marketplace Order. Related to accruing Points on In-Store Orders: (a) for a visit-based Store Rewards Program, placing a qualifying In-Store Order will be equivalent to placing a Marketplace Order that is eligible to accrue Points; and (b) for a spend-based Store Rewards Program, placing an In-Store Order will be equivalent to placing a Marketplace Order of a particular amount as determined by DoorDash and/or Merchant. To redeem a Reward for an In-Store Order, the consumer must do so in the Going Out section of the DoorDash app. The Going Out program is only available in select geographic areas and is governed by these terms and conditions.

Modification; Termination: DoorDash and/or each Merchant reserves the right to modify, suspend, terminate, or discontinue the Store Rewards Programs or the DashPass Store Rewards Program at any time without any notice to consumers. VIP Delivery Terms and Conditions

VIP Delivery: For a limited time, select DashPass members in the United States will be eligible to receive a premium VIP delivery offer on select eligible DashPass orders (VIP Delivery). VIP Delivery will enable select DashPass members to enjoy the following benefits on eligible restaurant orders at no additional cost:

  • Money-back guarantee for orders containing missing or defective items.

  • On-time delivery promise.

  • Free upgrade to Express Delivery (when available).

  • Priority support.

  • Allocation to Top Dashers.

VIP Delivery is not available to all DashPass members, but only to select DashPass members as determined by DoorDash in its sole discretion. You’ll see a notification in your DoorDash app if you are eligible for VIP Delivery. If you pause or cancel your DashPass subscription at any time, you will lose access to VIP Delivery. DoorDash reserves the right to revoke eligibility for VIP Delivery at any time without notice. VIP Delivery benefits are only available on select restaurant delivery orders as determined by DoorDash.

Eligible orders: VIP Delivery is available only on eligible restaurant delivery orders from merchants participating in the DashPass program in the United States. Orders must have a subtotal of at least twelve dollars ($12), excluding fees and taxes. DoubleDash, Pickup, group, Merchant-fulfilled, Drive, and scheduled orders are not eligible. DoorDash may amend the eligibility requirements for VIP Delivery orders at any time without notice.

Money back guarantee: On eligible orders (as determined by DoorDash), DashPass members may contact DoorDash support and request a remedy if any item that has been ordered is not delivered or is defective. The remedies available at no additional cost include (at your election):

  • Refund - A refund to the original payment method for the value of the affected item(s);

  • Redelivery - Redelivery of the affected item(s); or

  • Credits - DoorDash credits in an amount greater than the value of the affected item(s).

Eligibility for this benefit, and the form and amount of any remedy, will be determined by DoorDash in its sole discretion.

On time delivery: On eligible orders (as determined by DoorDash from time to time), VIP Delivery includes an on-time delivery guarantee. If your order is delivered ten (10) minutes or more after the latest time in the delivery window displayed at checkout, you will automatically receive a ten-dollar ($10) DoorDash credit as an apology for the delay. This benefit applies only if you do not change or amend the delivery address after checkout. Eligibility for this benefit, and issuance of any credits, will be determined by DoorDash in its sole discretion.

Express Delivery Upgrade: On eligible orders with a subtotal of $12 or more (excluding fees and taxes), DashPass members will receive a free upgrade to Express delivery (when it is available). Express delivery means that your orders will not be batched with any other DoorDash orders. Other fees (including delivery and service fees) may apply. The Express delivery upgrade will only be applied to select restaurant orders and at select participating stores and is not available for redemption on all orders.

Top Dasher: On eligible orders (as determined by DoorDash from time to time), VIP Delivery may include assignment of a “Top Dasher” to complete your order. A Top Dasher is a highly rated, experienced Dasher selected by DoorDash to complete your order. Eligibility for this benefit, and availability of TopDasher assignment, will be determined by DoorDash in its sole discretion and is not guaranteed for every order.

Priority support: VIP Delivery may include access to priority support. If you contact DoorDash support about an eligible order, your case will be routed to specially trained support agents with enhanced tools and permissions to resolve issues more quickly and effectively. Eligibility for this benefit, and the availability of Priority Support, will be determined by DoorDash in its sole discretion and is not guaranteed for every order.

Modification of terms: DoorDash reserves the right to modify, suspend, terminate, cancel, or discontinue the VIP Delivery offer at any time without any notice. In the event of termination or modification of the VIP Delivery offer, customers will not be entitled to any substitute, credit, or compensation.

Fraud and misconduct: DoorDash reserves the right to revoke or suspend eligibility from the VIP Delivery offer if DoorDash believes in its sole discretion that the user is (or is attempting to) act fraudulently or in bad faith when seeking to redeem the VIP Delivery benefit. DoorDash may also refuse to award or revoke a customer’s refund or DoorDash credits at any time without notice if DoorDash believes that the customer has obtained the refund or credits in a fraudulent manner.

General: VIP Delivery is subject to the DoorDash Consumer Terms and Conditions. The offer is only available for select DashPass members in the US, as determined by DoorDash, VIP Delivery is not available to all DashPass members. Eligibility for VIP Delivery benefits, and the form, timing, and amount of any remedy or credit, will be determined by DoorDash in its sole discretion. DashPass benefits apply only to eligible orders from DashPass merchants that meet the minimum subtotal requirement, excluding fees and taxes. Subtotal minimums will be identified for each DashPass merchant on DoorDash.VIP Delivery benefits cannot be used in conjunction with any other offers or discounts. The VIP Delivery offer is available only to select DashPass users, as indicated in their accounts.

Welcome to Going Out!

Welcome to Going Out!

Going Out is currently available in select cities across the U.S. and Australia, including San Francisco, East Bay, Los Angeles, Atlanta, Seattle, Bellevue, Chicago, Dallas, Houston, Denver/Boulder, Phoenix, Auckland, Melbourne, and Sydney.

Q: What is Going Out?

  • Going Out is a new rewards program from DoorDash that gives you access to exclusive discounts and experiences when dining in person at select local restaurants.

Q: How do I use Going Out?

  • Open the DoorDash app (Available on IOS and Android).

    • Access Going Out from the top of the home page.

  • Claim a deal you’re interested in — some are available for a limited time.

  • Visit the restaurant and redeem your deal through the app. Follow the instructions on screen.

Q: How do I redeem a deal?

  • Most deals require uploading a photo of your receipt, while some require checking in with restaurant staff or linking your card. Please follow steps shown on-screen for redemption instructions. Please note: Deals offering DoorDash credits are automatically applied to your DoorDash account — not given by restaurant staff. You do not need to have any interaction with the staff.

Q: Where can I find my claimed deals?

  • Your claimed deals will appear automatically when you open the DoorDash app at the restaurant.

    • You can also go to the Going Out page → My Stuff tab to view and select your deals.

Q: What do I do if Going Out is not working?

If you’re having trouble using Going Out, try these quick steps:

  1. Update your DoorDash app to the latest version in the App Store.

  2. Turn on Precise Location by going to Settings → DoorDash → Location.

    • This helps us confirm that you’re at the restaurant when redeeming your deals.

  3. If the issue seems to be on the restaurant’s side or your deal doesn’t apply correctly, please submit a Going Out support ticket through the Going Out deal page.

Q: Can I use Going Out for delivery?

  • No — Going Out deals are for in-person ordering only. Order directly with the restaurant, NOT through the DoorDash app.

Get Started with DoorDash

Can I schedule a delivery in advance?

Can I schedule a delivery in advance?

Yes. Once you have selected your meal, at the checkout page, before clicking Place Order, simply select Scheduled and you can select the date and time you wish to have your meal delivered. After selecting the date and time you want, simply click Place Order and we will handle the rest.

How are Taxes Calculated?

Taxes apply to orders based on local regulations.

The amount of tax charged depends on many factors including the following:

  • The type of item purchased

  • The time and date of the purchase

  • The location of the store and your delivery address

  • The date and method of fulfillment

These factors can change between the time you place an order and when your order is complete.

We sometimes rely on our merchants to calculate the exact tax amount applicable. We display an estimated tax at checkout which may be updated later when your order is completed. Finalized tax will be shown on your order receipt.

If a refund is placed, any applicable tax will also be refunded.

How Is Your Dasher Paid?

How Is Your Dasher Paid?

Here’s a detailed look at how Dasher earnings work:

Base Pay

Base pay is DoorDash’s base contribution for each offer made to Dashers. This ranges from $2-10+ when a Dasher chooses to earn per offer, depending on the estimated time, distance, and desirability of the offer. Offers that include deliveries or tasks that require Dashers to travel a longer distance, that are expected to take more time, and that are less popular with Dashers will have a higher base pay. Base pay does not change based on the customer tip amount. For information about how base pay works when Dashers earn by time, see here.

Promotions

Dashers also have the opportunity to earn more through promotions. Promotions include Peak Pay, Challenges, and Delivery Streaks. Peak Pay allows Dashers to earn extra money on each offer. Challenges give Dashers the chance to earn extra money for completing a certain number of deliveries in a set amount of time. Delivery Streaks allows Dashers to earn extra money by accepting and completing offers consecutively when they dash.

Tips

Every dollar a customer tips is an extra dollar in their Dasher’s pocket - 100% of tips received by DoorDash go to the Dasher on top of base pay and promotions. The amount DoorDash pays in base pay and promotions never varies based on the tip amount.

How it works: Package Pickup

Package Requirements

Packages must abide by the following rules to be eligible for the Package Pickup service.

  1. Seal packages with shipping labels

  2. Send QR codes for packages that require it

  3. Under 30 lbs each

  4. Worth less than $500

  5. No postage stamps

  6. Do not contain anything, fragile, liquid, perishable, or potentially hazardous, including lithium batteries and perfume

  7. In good condition and not including previously used labels, markings or stickers.

  8. Comply with carrier and DoorDash requirements and item restrictions

How it works: Package Pickup

Where: In the U.S. at UPS, FedEx, USPS

  • How Does it Work?

  • Package Reimbursement

  • Cancellation Policy

  • FAQ

  • Terms & Conditions

Summary:

DoorDash is offering Package Pickup, a new service that allows you to request a Dasher to pick up your packages, whether with a QR code or packaged with a shipping label, and drop them off to either a FedEx, UPS, or USPS for a flat fee. DoorDash does not provide packaging materials.

  • Easy Requesting: Simply select your preferred drop-off store (FedEx, UPS, or USPS), choose how many & what type packages to return (up to 5), and check out!

  • Hassle-Free Pickup: When placing your order, let us know if you’d like to hand it directly to the dasher or would like a contactless pickup. Please remember to have your package ready: fully sealed, pre-paid, and labeled or with a QR code.

  • Real time Updates:** **Expect the same standard of notifications and Dasher care throughout your package pickup experience! You will receive in-app confirmation once the package has been delivered.

How Does it Work?

  • Navigate to the Packages icon on the homepage or use search to select your carrier of choice: USPS, UPS or FedEx. Note, if you have multiple packages going to multiple carriers, then please start a separate order.

  • Do you have a pre-printed label or a QR code? Select each type of package you’d like us to pick up and add them to your cart.

  • If you have a QR code, please be sure to follow the instructions within the app to share it with your Dasher.

  • Once you’re ready, checkout and review the Package Requirements to make sure your package(s) are eligible for the service. Each package should be properly sealed and labeled for shipping, weigh less than 30 lbs, valued less than $500, and contain no restricted or illegal materials.

  • You may add special instructions for pickup (i.e. ring the doorbell once you arrive), and specify whether you’d like to hand the package directly to the Dasher. Otherwise, tap ‘Accept and Continue’ as confirmation that you agree to the Package Requirements.

  • After you place your request, you can view the status of your Dasher to track when they’ll arrive to pick up your package.

  • Once your Dasher has picked up and dropped off your package, you will receive a notification of the drop-off with a photo confirmation.

Package Reimbursement

In the event of an incident where your Package Pickup was not successfully delivered to a UPS, FedEx or a UPS, you may request a reimbursement up to the $500 per order reimbursement limit.

DoorDash reserves the right to request the receipt of purchase and return request in order to verify the package value. DoorDash will conduct an investigation and determine if a reimbursement is warranted. DoorDash has no obligation to provide reimbursement in any circumstance but may grant it gratuitously at DoorDash’s sole discretion in each case.

Cancellation Policy

If you decide to cancel your Package Pickup request, you will be fully refunded the amount of your Package Pickup fee. However, if a Dasher has already picked up your package, you will need to contact Customer Support in order to coordinate package retrieval. Find more details on how to cancel your order through the app here.

FAQs

  • Can I send items going to two different drop-off locations in the same request?

a. No. Each delivery request must be limited to a single drop-off point (a UPS, USPS, FedEx location). However, you may send up to 5 packages to the same drop-off location. If you decide to place more than one request to multiple drop-off locations, we recommend you physically write the drop-off location on each package.

  • Can DoorDash print a label for me?

a. No, DoorDash will not print the label for your package return. Labels must be pre-printed and pre-attached to the package you intend to return for it to be eligible for this service.

  • How will I know that my package has been dropped off? Can I receive a tracking number?

a. The Dasher will send a photo confirmation of your package at the drop-off location, and the app will notify you once the package has been dropped off. DoorDash will not provide tracking numbers.

  • Will this service process my refund for me?
  1. No. This service only completes the first stage of your return; picking up your package and dropping it off to FedEx, USPS, or UPS. To get information on your refund, please contact the online retailer you purchased from.
  • Is this service eligible for DashPass?

a. Yes, this service is available at a reduced price for DashPass subscribers.

  • What happens if my package(s) are never delivered?

a. If you suspect your package has not been dropped off, please contact DoorDash Customer Support at +1(855) 973-1040 or through the Help Support Button in-app. Our team will investigate the incident and you may be subject to reimbursement for the value of your packages, up to $500 per order. Please see the Package Reimbursement section for more details.

  • How soon after requesting a package return can I expect the Dasher to arrive at my door?
  1. Requests for package return pickup are on an ASAP basis, but may take as long as 1-2 hours. You can track the Dasher’s status in-app. Please be ready as soon as you place the request to ensure a smooth process.
  • What will happen to my package if the store is closed?

a. You will only be able to place a request if your drop-off location is open and operating.

  • Do I need to be present for the Dasher to pick my package(s) up, or can it be a contactless pickup?

a. You can request contactless pickup by selecting “Pickup outside my door” while checking out. Please note that if the Dasher is unable to find the package, they will contact you to find it.

  • I live in an apartment. Can I still use this service?

a. Yes, you can still use this service. Just be sure to include your apartment number and clear instructions on how to find the apartment if you believe it may be difficult for a Dasher to locate.

  • What if the Dasher can’t find me or the package?

a. The Dasher will contact you if they cannot find you or the package, so be prepared to answer a call or message from the Dasher in the event they need to reach you. If the issue persists, the Dasher may contact Support for further assistance in finding you.

  • Can I cancel my request? (and how?)
  1. Yes, you may cancel your request after placing it (but before the Dasher has picked up your package). However, if you want to cancel your pickup after the Dasher has picked it up, you will need to contact Customer Support at +1(855) 973-1040.

Prescription Delivery

Get your prescriptions delivered with DoorDash. Now available at select pharmacy locations.

Flexible prescription delivery. Get your prescriptions delivered to you in as little as 30 minutes or schedule delivery for a time that works best for you. Currently available at select pharmacy locations.

Secure & discreet delivery. Pharmacists are instructed to use sealed packaging to ensure your privacy.

Need anything else? Bundle non-prescription items from the rest of the store with your prescription delivery.

How It Works

  1. Check for a text from your pharmacy: You’ll receive a message from your pharmacy when your prescription is ready. Open the link that allows you to order delivery directly from DoorDash.

  2. Verify prescription details at the top of the screen: The first 3 letters of the medication, your out of pocket cost, and your pharmacy location will be pre-populated.

  3. Enter your information to help a Dasher pick up your prescription: After verifying your prescription details, you’ll be asked to provide your first and last name, phone number, address on file at the pharmacy, and delivery address. To ensure there are no issues with delivery, please ensure all of this information matches exactly what the pharmacy has on file. Please note, your address on file at the pharmacy is the address that is associated with your prescription at the pharmacy and is needed to identify your prescription. Delivery address is the address you would like the prescription to be delivered to, and is needed to deliver your prescription to the right location.

  4. Select “Continue” to add your prescription to your cart: You will see the prescription added to your cart and have the opportunity to shop for other items from the front of the store.

  5. Add any other items from the store as part of the same order: Before you check out, you can add any additional non-prescription items from the store to your order for one easy delivery. As an added benefit, you may be eligible to receive reduced delivery fees when ordering your prescription + non-prescription items together from DoorDash.

6. Place your order: On the checkout page, the “Meet at door” delivery option will be pre-selected. “Leave at the door” is unavailable, as you need to meet your Dasher to provide the PIN to get this order.

  1. Meet your Dasher: You must meet your Dasher and provide the PIN code (available on the tracking page after placing your order) to get this order.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is my prescription delivery secure?

A: Yes. DoorDash does not collect or view information about your medication. Pharmacists are instructed to use opaque, tamper-evident packaging to protect your privacy and medication upon delivery from the pharmacy. You will also be asked to share a unique PIN code with the Dasher to confirm delivery is made to the right person.

Q: How does prescription delivery with DoorDash work?

A: You will receive a text message from your pharmacy with a link to get your prescription delivered with DoorDash. Please follow the instructions in that message.

Q: Can I sign up for prescription delivery on DoorDash without a text message from my pharmacy?

A: Unfortunately, not. You need a text message from your pharmacy with details on DoorDash delivery options in order to get your prescription delivered with DoorDash.

Q: Can I order other items from the store with my prescription delivery?

A: Yes, you will have the option to add additional items from the store when placing an order for prescription delivery. As an added benefit, you may be eligible for reduced delivery fees when adding any non-prescription items from the store to your order.

Q: Do I have to be home to sign for my prescription delivery order?

A: Before checkout, you will see the drop-off option for prescription delivery orders is “Hand it to me,” and you will have the option to add additional drop-off instructions.

A: To ensure your prescription is delivered to you in the most effective and secure way, you’ll be asked to provide a PIN code to the Dasher. You’ll see the PIN code on the tracking page on DoorDash after placing your order, and can share the PIN with the Dasher at drop-off to confirm you received your order.

Q: Is there a delivery fee for prescription delivery?

A: Delivery fees for prescription delivery orders may vary. Open the link in the text from your pharmacy to review delivery fee details.

Q: How long will it take to deliver my prescription?

A: Delivery times may vary by location and are not guaranteed. Estimated delivery times will be provided to you before placing your order. You will also have the option to schedule your prescription delivery for a later time.

Q: How will I know if my delivery is on its way?

A: You will be able to track delivery progress on the DoorDash app or at DoorDash.com, by navigating to the Orders page.

Q: Who do I contact with questions or concerns about my delivery order?

A: For questions about the delivery itself, you can contact DoorDash support through the “Help” button on your order tracking page. For questions about your prescription, please contact your pharmacy directly.

Q: How many stores offer prescription delivery?

A: Currently, prescription delivery is only offered at select pharmacy locations.

Q: Are any medicines not eligible for prescription delivery?

A: Most prescriptions are eligible for delivery. However, some prescriptions are ineligible, including, but not limited to, controlled substances. For more details, please contact your pharmacy directly.

Still have questions? We’re here for you! Click here to contact our live support.

Signature Required Delivery

Signature Required Upon Delivery

What is a Signature Upon Delivery and why am I seeing this option even though there is no Alcohol beverage in my order cart?

This new security feature has been implemented for our customers to avoid the order not being delivered; this is a temporary feature that should disappear once we can confirm your orders are being delivered successfully. Customers will be notified at checkout with a banner informing them that their signature will be required to complete the order once the Dasher arrives to ensure that the order is delivered successfully from DoorDash.

It will be applicable to all orders ( food, beverages, groceries, etc.) regardless of any amount.

How can I add my signature?

Once a Dasher arrives at the drop-off location, the Dasher will be prompted to begin the signature process and will have the Customer sign on the DoorDash App.

Once signed, Customers can now tap the “I Have Received This Order” button to confirm delivery and be instructed to pass the phone back to the Dasher.

What if Customers can’t sign for reasons such as illness or mobility issues?

If a Consumer can’t sign for reasons such as illness or mobility issues, they can communicate this with the Dasher and request;

  • Dasher to complete an alternative drop-off method by taking a photo of the drop-off location and waiting 5 minutes.

What are customer substitution preferences?

You have the option to add a substitution preference when placing your order. This guides what happens if an item becomes unavailable. If you do not select a substitution preference or select “Contact Me” but you are unresponsive, the Shopper may select for you a suitable substitution, where appropriate.

Go with Similar Item

If you select this option, the Shopper will select a replacement recommendation for the unavailable item. The Shopper will aim to select a substitute product that is similar in value and quality but reserves the right not to provide you with a substitute even if a suitable product is available. If you are provided with a substitute product where the price for that substitute product is less than the product you selected, we will charge you the price of the lower-priced substitute product and, if you have paid for the product you selected, we will refund you the difference between the price paid and the lower-priced substitute product.

Where a product selected by you is substituted with another product, the Shopper cannot ensure that the substitute product caters to your specific dietary requirements, including allergies. Please read the labels of all products for dietary and allergy information.

Pre-Select Substitutes

If you select this option, the Shopper will select your pre-approved item to be substituted for the originally ordered item.

Refund this item

If you select this option, the Shopper will remove the item from your order and refund the amount.

Contact Me

If you select this option, the Shopper will chat or call you to confirm if you wish to:

  1. Substitute the item; or

  2. Remove the item

NOTE : If you select this option and you do not answer our call, the Shopper may choose a suitable substitution, or the item will be refunded, as deemed appropriate.

What does it mean for a store to deliver its own orders?

What does it mean for a store to deliver its own orders?

There are certain stores on the DoorDash app that use their own couriers to deliver orders. This means that your order is not tracked in real-time within the DoorDash system the same as other deliveries you may be used to. Status updates may also be less frequent for these specific orders.

Why is there no map?

With Demand Gen orders, you cannot track the store’s courier. You can see what stage of the order is by opening up the details in the “Orders” tab.

How do I know when my order will arrive?

We provide an estimated time range for your order to arrive based on the store and your location. Please be patient as this is just an estimation, and may change depending on potential issues preparing or delivering your order. To get the most up to date status of your order, we encourage you to contact the store. You can call them directly from the app via your order page, under “Help.”

How do they know where to go?

Your name, address, phone number and delivery instructions are sent to the store & its courier so your order can be delivered, and so that they can reach out to you with any updates or questions.

What if I have an issue with my order?

Due to the limited information provided from the store, we encourage you to contact the store to get the most up to date status of your order. You can call them directly from the app via your order page, under “Help.” If the store cannot provide assistance, please reach out to DoorDash and we will try our best to help you.

What fees do I pay?

When you place an order on DoorDash, you may be charged various fees. These fees go to DoorDash to help us cover our costs of fulfilling your order, paying Dashers, operating DoorDash, and enabling us to provide the best service possible. We’re constantly working to make DoorDash even more affordable and accessible. The exact fees you pay also depend on the merchant, your DashPass membership status, and any local regulations.

DoorDash is in the process of updating how we calculate fees so they better reflect how far an order travels and how much effort it takes to deliver it, in addition to the size of your order. Starting in late July, this rollout will take place over the coming months in all locations, but will not apply to orders in California, Chicago, Colorado, the District of Columbia, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New York City, Puerto Rico, and Seattle to start (for more info on fees in these markets, see the section called “DoorDash Fees in markets where fee updates are not rolled out at this time”).

DoorDash Fees in markets where fee updates are rolling out starting in Late July 2026.

Fees that may apply to your order in U.S. markets outside of California, Chicago, Colorado, the District of Columbia, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New York City, Puerto Rico, and Seattle are listed below. These fees go to DoorDash.

  • Service Fee: A variable fee that helps cover the cost of facilitating your delivery and that varies with factors like distance and order size. A flat, minimum service fee may apply.

  • Delivery Fee: A fixed fee per order that varies by merchant.

  • Long Distance Fee: You may have the option to place longer distance orders, and this fee helps cover the cost of completing the delivery.

  • Regulatory Response Fee: DoorDash may charge this fee when a local or state regulation leads to increased operating costs. This additional fee enables us to continue offering you convenient services and ensure Dashers make meaningful earnings. Regulatory response fees are flat fees that vary based on region.

  • Small Order Fee: In some cases, this fee is charged to enable us to make small transactions worthwhile to fulfill. A fee may be charged if your order subtotal is below a certain amount.

  • Weather Impact Fee: Occasionally during major weather events, DoorDash may charge an additional fee to support Dashers for their efforts in delivering orders during the weather event.

  • Optional Express Delivery Fee: On some orders in some areas, you can choose Express delivery for an additional fee.

Other charges you may see:

  • Estimated Tax: Calculated based on local regulations and your order subtotal. The finalized tax appears on your order receipt.

  • Optional Dasher Tip: Every dollar you tip goes to your Dasher. Depending on your location, you can tip at checkout or after delivery. Dashers receive 100% of customer tips, and tipping is always optional.

  • Bag, Bottle, and Other Mandatory Fees: In some cases, government authorities require DoorDash to charge certain fees on bags and bottles, or for other reasons. These are applied as required by law.

Note: This list may be subject to change.

What is a group order and how can I create one?

What is a Group Order and how can I create one?

A group order allows multiple people to add their individual items into a collective order cart at the same time. Once a Group Order is created through your DoorDash Account, the rest of your group doesn’t need to have a DoorDash Account to use the group order link. And you can pre-order up to four days in advance, which makes for easy group meal planning.

Follow these steps to create a group order:

1. Log into your DoorDash account.

2. Choose your restaurant.

3. Tap the Group Order button on the restaurant page.

4. Send the Group Order link to others.

5. When everyone is done adding their items into the cart, you can close the Group Order and complete checkout.

Manage Your Account

Consumer Help Center for Dark Mode

How to Manage Dark Mode Settings

Dark Mode is available only on iOS. Dark Mode makes it easier to read menu options and details about your delivery. It’s especially useful in low-light conditions and great for late-night ordering.

iOS Users

Select the “Account” icon at the top right of the screen and scroll down.

Under the “Dark Mode” section you will find 3 options:

  • Light Mode - Applies the normal, default light color scheme to the application.

  • Dark Mode - Applies the dark colour scheme to the application.

  • System Default - Applies your device’s system settings color scheme to the application.

This feature is only supported for phones running iOS13 or above.

How do I change my delivery address?

How do I change my delivery address?

If you do not have an active delivery in process, you can change your delivery address through the DoorDash website or mobile app:

FOR WEBSITE USERS:

First, click on the existing address in the upper right-hand corner of the website.

  • To select a different delivery address:

    1. Click on the address from the list of addresses provided. This will become your default address.

  • To add a new address:

    1. Enter the address in the search bar and select the address from the populated results.

    2. If applicable, add in the apartment number or suite and any delivery instructions.

    3. Click Save. This will become your default delivery address.

  • To delete an address:

    1. Click on the X located on the right-hand side of the address. You can not delete a default address, please first select a different default address first before deleting.

  • To edit an existing address and/or the delivery instructions:

    1. Delete the address and then follow the add a new address steps

FOR MOBILE APP USERS:

IOS

If you do not have an active delivery in process, you can change your delivery address through the DoorDash App by following these steps:

  1. Tap on the Account icon at the top

  2. Tap on Addresses.

  3. Then continue to below.

  • To select a different delivery address:

    1. Click on the address from the list of addresses provided. This will now become your new default address.

  • To add an address:

    1. Enter the address in the Search bar and select the address from the populated results.

    2. If applicable, add in the apartment number or suite and any delivery instructions.

    3. Click Save Address. This will now become your new default address.

  • To delete an address:

  1. Tap on the pencil icon that address and then tap on the trash icon in the upper right corner to delete.

    • Note: You won’t be able to delete a default address. Please first select a different default address.

  • To edit an existing address and/or the delivery instructions:

    1. Delete the address and then follow the add a new address steps

If you have a delivery in process, you can change your delivery address by doing the following:

  1. Click the Help option on the order tracker screen.

  2. Select the Change Addresses tab and choose an address from the list of saved addresses.

    • If you’re not able to select your desired delivery address (i.e. address is grayed out) , this means that your address is not within range of the restaurant from which you ordered and we aren’t able to make this change. We set delivery ranges to ensure a speedy delivery and that your food arrives fresh.

    • If the address you wish to change to is not in the list of saved addresses, you can enter a new address by clicking the Enter Address button below the list of saved addresses (this feature only available in mobile app).

ANDROID

If you do not have an active delivery in process, you can change your delivery address through the DoorDash App by following these steps:

  1. Tap on the Account tab

  2. Tap on Addresses.

  3. Then continue to below.

  • To select a different delivery address:

    1. Click on the address from the list of addresses provided. This will now become your new default address.

  • To add an address:

    1. Enter the address in ““search”” for the new address and select the address from the populated results

    2. If applicable, add in the appartment number or suite and any delivery instructions

    3. Click Save. This will will now become your new default address.

  • To delete an address:

  1. Tap on the pencil icon for the address and then tap on the trash icon in the upper right corner to delete.

    • Note: You won’t be able to delete a default address. Please first select a different default address.

  • To edit an existing address and/or the delivery instructions:

    1. Delete the address and then follow the add a new address steps.

If you have a delivery in process, you can change your delivery address by doing the following:

  1. Click the Help option on the order tracker screen.

  2. Select the Change Addresses tab and choose an address from the list of saved addresses.

    • If you’re not able to select your desired delivery address (i.e. address is grayed out) , this means that your address is not within range of the restaurant from which you ordered and we aren’t able to make this change. We set delivery ranges to ensure a speedy delivery and that your food arrives fresh.

    • If the address you wish to change to is not in the list of saved addresses, you can enter a new address by clicking the Enter Address button below the list of saved addresses (this feature only available in mobile app).

How do I update my account information?

You can change personal information anytime in your account. To keep your account information secure, you will be required to validate your account ownership through a 2-Factor Authentication process.

You can make the following changes to your DoorDash account profile in the app or on the DoorDash website:

  • First Name

  • Last Name

  • Phone Number

  • Email Address

  • Country (Web only)

  • Password (will require to enter your new password again and the old password)

    • How to reset password?

      1. Go to the https://www.doordash.com/password-reset/

      2. Enter the email address associated with your DoorDash account and click Reset Password.

      3. You’ll receive an email with instructions from no-reply@doordash.com with subject line Password reset on www.doordash.com

      4. Click on the link inside the email and enter a unique strong password

  • Update your notification preferences

Follow the steps below to update your account profile.

Mobile app users

  1. Open your DoorDash app

  2. Tap the account icon at the top left of the screen

  3. Tap “Profile”

  4. Tap on the field you would like to update

  5. Tap the “check mark” in the upper right corner

  6. Verify your information through 2-Factor Authentication. On-screen instructions will guide you through the process.

Desktop users

  1. Log in to your account on the DoorDash website

  2. Open the menu in the upper left corner

  3. Select “Account”

  4. Edit the fields you would like to update

  5. Select “Save”

  6. Verify your information through 2-Factor Authentication. On-screen instructions will guide you through the process.

2-Step Verification Help - If you are having issues updating your account profile or you no longer have access to the phone number or email address of your account, we recommend that you create a new DoorDash account with the correct information.

How do I verify my account?

Verifying my phone number during account creation:

A part of creating a DoorDash account is verifying the phone number you entered. To verify, you will need to enter the 6 digit code that is sent to the phone number you added once prompted during the sign up process.

What if I don’t receive a SMS code during account creation?

Please follow the troubleshooting steps below if you are not receiving the verification code via text message:

  1. Check that your Wifi or network connection is working correctly

  2. Ensure the phone number you entered is correct and is able to receive SMS codes (landlines do not work here).

  3. Tap Resend Code at the bottom of the app screen after 1 minute to receive a new text message.

  4. If you have been blocked by the 2-Step Verification interface after too many code entry attempts, please wait 30 minutes for the systems to unblock you and try again.

  5. Check with your service provider.

  6. Contact support here if you are still not able to receive the SMS code.

Why do I need to verify my phone number during account creation?

DoorDash requires users to verify their phone numbers to improve the experience on the app. When Dashers deliver items to the user, the Dasher may need to communicate with the user using SMS. Please note that in order to verify the Phone number, the code can only be requested on the phone number and not the email address.

Still have questions? We’re here for you! Click here to contact our live support, or reference our Community Guidelines for more information on our values here at DoorDash.

How do I verify my account?

Why do I need to verify my phone number?

DoorDash requires users to verify their phone numbers to improve the experience on the app. When Dashers deliver items to the user, the Dasher may need to communicate with the user using SMS. Please note that in order to verify the Phone number, the code can only be requested on the phone number and not the email address.
Still need help? Visit our support page.

How do I verify my phone number?

When prompted on our platform, you will enter a 6-digit code that is sent to the phone number you added during the sign-up process. (You can update your phone number at any time in your profile. You must ensure that you are using a phone that is able to receive SMS (text messages).

What do I do if I am not receiving the code?

Please follow the troubleshooting steps below if you are not receiving the verification code via text message:

  1. Ensure that the phone number on your account is one that can receive SMS

  2. Check that your Wifi or network connection is working correctly

  3. If you have unsubscribed from receiving text messages from DoorDash, you can either choose to resend the code to your email address or opt into notifications from DoorDash by following the instructions here.

  4. Try to resend the code by tapping on ‘Resend Code.’

If you are still having trouble verifying, you may choose to call support using the phone with the phone number associated with your account that you are trying to verify.

Multi-Factor Authentication

To increase security on your account, we may periodically ask you to verify that you own the account. A part of the verification process is to receive a 6-digit code from DoorDash via Email or Text message to your phone. Once you have received the 6-digit code, follow the prompts in your account to enter the code and verify your identity.

Why am I not receiving an email?

Please check your spam, trash, and junk folders. Additionally, allow up to 2 minutes to receive the email before requesting the code to be resent or to send the code via text message instead.

How many attempts do I get?

You have 5 attempts before you are locked out of your account.

What can I do if I am locked out of my account?

After 5 failed attempts, you must wait 30 minutes until you can try again.

Why was there an error sending me the code?

If you encounter an error while sending the code, try to resend the code to the other option (For Example; if you chose SMS as the option, try the Email option). You can also close the app and try again.

Does the code expire?

Yes, the code generated and sent to you expires after 30 minutes. If you are not able to use it before then, you will need to send yourself a new code.

I received a “Login attempt from a new device” email from DoorDash, but I didn’t log in on a new device. What should I do?

Legitimate DoorDash notifications will come from a valid @doordash.com email address (example - “no-reply@doordash.com”).

If you believe you received this notification but didn’t try to log into DoorDash on a new device, you should access your account and change your password immediately. We also recommend confirming that the phone number within your DoorDash account is up to date.

If you’re concerned about the security of your account or if you see any unauthorized transactions, Contact Support right away.

Still have questions? We’re here for you! Click here to contact our live support.

How does DoorDash keep my account protected?

How does DoorDash keep my account protected?

In order to help keep Consumer accounts protected, we are currently implementing additional controls to further enhance account security.

  1. Whenever our system detects a login from a Consumer account using a new device, you will receive an email to notify you about the activity.

  2. If you don’t recognize the device and/or suspect suspicious activity, you can update their password on the DoorDash account page to help secure your account.

Managing your DoorDash Customer Email Preferences

Managing your DoorDash Email Preferences

As a Customer you may receive a variety of emails from DoorDash. While we’re required to provide some high-priority emails, for everything else, you’re able to decide exactly which types of communications you’d like to receive from us.

In order to update your email preferences, simply open an email you have received from DoorDash and locate the ‘Unsubscribe’ link at the bottom of the email. This link will direct you to your email preferences.

You can also uncheck any boxes for specific emails you’d like to opt out of, or opt out of all non-high priority communications.

Once you’ve made the selection of emails you’d like to receive, make sure to click ‘Save Preferences’

If you are unable to locate an email containing the ‘Unsubscribe’ link, you can contact Support for additional assistance.

Still need help? We’re here for you! Click here to contact our live support.

Notifications From DoorDash and Texts From Your Dasher

How do I opt into notifications from DoorDash and Dashers?

Follow these two steps to ensure your account is receiving notifications from DoorDash and text messages from Dashers. We recommend having SMS and Push Notifications turned on in order to receive updates about your delivery:

DoorDash Mobile App Users:

  1. Tap on the Account icon at the top of the app.

  2. Scroll down to Notifications

  3. Select the notification type

  4. Use slide bar to turn notifications on iOS or Android

How do I opt out of notifications from DoorDash?

We highly recommend keeping the Order Updates Push and Order Updates SMS options on - as these are used:

  • To notify you of the status of your order

  • To alert you when your Dasher is having trouble finding you

However, regardless of your opt in status for Order Updates Push and Order Updates SMS, your Dasher will be able to send a message to you directly about your order and reply to any messages you may have sent (including details on a no-contact drop off).

To opt out of notifications from DoorDash:

  1. Tap on the Account icon at the top of the app

  2. Scroll down to the Notifications

  3. Select the notification type

  4. Use slide bar to turn notifications off

AfterPay Frequently Asked Questions

For questions about your 4 payments or Afterpay account, please click here to contact Afterpay customer service.

What is Afterpay?

Afterpay allows you to purchase from DoorDash online store and pay later in 4 easy interest-free installments.

How does Afterpay work?

  • To pay with Afterpay:

    1. Add your items to the cart

    2. Select Afterpay as the payment option at the checkout

    3. Signup or use your existing Afterpay account

    4. Once approved, DoorDash will despatch your order

Is there any interest on the amount paid?

No, there is no interest payable by you

What are other terms and conditions I need to be aware of?

Full terms & conditions are available at http://www.afterpay.com/terms

How often is repayment?

Afterpay offers your order to be paid in 4 installments with repayment automatically occuring every 2 weeks.

How do I sign up for Afterpay?

Visit the website

How do returns work with Afterpay?

Merchants will be able to initiate all eligible refunds on your behalf. Once completed, your refund will be applied to your order.

Does Afterpay charge interest?

There is no interest payable by you if you place an order using Afterpay.

Where can I find out more about Afterpay?

If you would like to know more about Afterpay, visit the Afterpay website www.afterpay.com for a comprehensive list of FAQs & terms. Afterpay’s Privacy Policy which can be found at https://www.afterpay.com/ privacy-policy

What can I do if my gift card(s) were not delivered?

Gift card delivery can be impacted by incorrect emails or phone numbers, spam filters, corporate firewalls, and accidental deletions. Your order confirmation email will have the gift card link, you can copy the link and share it with the recipient.

If you have not received your gift card, please contact customer support.

How can I update the recipient’s email address or phone number?

If the recipient’s email address or phone number was entered incorrectly, and you need to update it:

  1. Navigate to the receipt for your gift card purchase in the DoorDash app. Click “Resend,” and you will be able to send the gift card to the same recipient or a new email address or phone number.

  2. If the issue persists, please contact customer support.

*Note: You will not be able to switch the delivery option from phone to email, or email to phone.

  7. Complete Payment Details

  8. Place Order

Do I need to have a primary form of payment on my DoorDash account to use my gift card?

Primary payment method is not required if gift card funds cover the entire order; however, a primary payment method will need to be added if there is any remaining amount on the order.

Why haven’t I received my Gift Card email?

Gift card delivery can be impacted by incorrect emails or phone numbers, spam filters, corporate firewalls, and accidental deletions. Your order confirmation email will have the gift card link. You can copy the link and share it with the recipient. If you still cannot find your order confirmation email, please contact customer support.

Why have I not received my gift card after purchasing it online?

If you purchased a gift card from a third-party website (i.e., Target, Amazon), please contact them directly.

When will the recipient receive the digital Gift Card?

The recipient will receive their gift card on the Send Date that you have chosen. The Send Date is automatically set to the current date, so if you don’t choose an alternate date, the gift card will be sent on the day you purchase.

What does the recipient receive when I send a digital Gift Card?

Depending on the date you have chosen to have the gift card delivered, the recipient will receive a message letting them know that they have received a gift card, with a link to obtain their gift card pin. The link in the email/text message (depending on the delivery option you have chosen) will take them to the digital gift cards page (with the design you have selected), showing them the gift message, value, and gift card pin number. They will also see quick instructions for how to redeem the gift card.

How do I add an address?

For customers receiving an error message, we need your address to determine the credit currency.

  1. Sign in to the DoorDash app or on www.doordash.com

  2. For Mobile users:

    1. Tap on the address or the red arrow at the top of the screen

    2. Tap on “Addresses”

    3. Tap on the “+” for Android and the magnifying glass for iOS

    4. Enter & select your desired address

      (Suggested locations will show while you type your address into the search box. Ensure that you select the correct address among the suggestions.)

    5. Select the Drop Off option that you prefer by clicking the radio button next to the option.

    6. Input Delivery Instructions for your dasher, if there are any, in the space provided

    7. Tap Save

  3. For Desktop users:

    1. Click on the address in the top left-hand corner

    2. Enter & select your desired address under “search for a new address.”

      (Suggested locations will show while you type your address into the search box. Ensure that you select the correct address among the suggestions.)

    3. Select the Drop Off option that you prefer by clicking the radio button next to the option.

    4. Input Delivery Instructions for your dasher, if there are any, in the space provided

    5. Tap Save

    6. Confirmation: click on your new address to set it as your primary address
