Troubleshooting

How do I troubleshoot my DoorDash website?

Use this step-by-step guide when encountering:

  • Browser errors

  • Signing in errors

Step-by-Step :Step 1: Restart the browser

  1. Open the browser menu.

    Windows: Click File within the top menu bar.

    Mac: Click the browser name on the top menu bar (top left).

  2. Quit the browser.

    Windows: Click Exit.

    Mac: Click Quit.

  3. Relaunch the browser by finding the application and double clicking it.

Step 2: Alternate the browser

Open a different internet browser to see if the issue is related specifically to the original browser the Customer was using.

  • Google Chrome and Mozilla Firefox are two recommended browsers to try as alternatives.

Step 4: Clear cache and cookiesChrome:

  1. Open Chrome.

  2. Locate the 3 stacked dots ” ⁞ ” in the upper right hand side of the browser window and select History, then clear browsing data.

  3. In the box that appears, click the check boxes for Cookies and other sites and data and Cached images and files.

  4. Use the dropdown at the top to select the amount of data that you want to delete.

  5. Click Clear browsing data.

  6. Ask the customer to restart their browser.

Step 5: Confirm a stable internet connection

1. Directly Connected (Ethernet)

  • Check the ethernet cable to see if it connects completely within the computer’s ethernet port.

  • Check the cable’s connection to the router or modem to confirm it is also secure.

  • Check the Modem to confirm no red lights appear.

  1. Connected Wirelessly (WiFi)
  • Check the wireless router and modem. Do all the right lights appear? You shouldn’t see any red lights. Try unplugging it and plugging it back in.

Other Browsers:

  • Mozilla Firefox

  • Apple Safari

  • Opera

Step 6: Confirm the web browser is up to date

  1. PC/Mac:

    • On the top menu bar, go to the main menu and click About. The browser automatically checks for updates and prompts an update if necessary.

Step 7: Check third party extensions/programs

Third party browser extensions & programs sometimes prevent certain sites from loading properly.

  • Also check the permissions for any of these programs such as firewall software or extensions like Ghostery or uMatrix that tend to block important page elements, like a pop-up, on some pages.

How do I troubleshoot the DoorDash App?

How do I troubleshoot the DoorDash App?

ANDROID

Your Android DoorDash app may be experiencing issues due to a glitch from a third-party vendor (i.e., app crashes when on a map page). We are working on a fix to resolve this, but in the meantime to correct the issue immediately, please follow the steps below. Please note that you will be logged out and will need to log back in with your DoorDash username and password:

  1. Launch Settings

  2. Go to Apps

  3. Tap DoorDash

  4. Tap Storage

  5. Tap CLEAR DATA, and then DELETE

  6. Reinstall DoorDash from the App Store.

  7. You will be asked to re-login to your DoorDash app

IOS

Your iOS DoorDash app may be experiencing issues due to a glitch from a third-party vendor (i.e., app crashes when on a map page). We are working on a fix to resolve this, but in the meantime to correct the issue immediately, please follow the steps below. Please note that you will be logged out and will need to log back in with your DoorDash username and password:

  1. Check your internet connection.

  • Turn your phone’s wifi off and back on again.

  • Make sure you’re not in airplane mode.

  • Temporarily turn off your device’s WiFi and use cellular data instead. Having a strong phone signal without wifi improves the app’s connectivity.

  1. Restart your phone

  2. Uninstall and Reinstall your DoorDash app.

  • Uninstall the DoorDash app, turn off your phone for 3-5 seconds, and then reinstall the app.

  • If you are not connected to wifi, installing the app will use data and affect your data usage.

Your DoorDash Order

Can I adjust the tip I provide to the Dasher?

Can I adjust the tip I provide to the Dasher?

Yes, there are multiple ways to adjust the original tip you left for your Dasher during checkout.

*Note: You can only tip once per order.

[TABLE]

Can I order from different restaurants at the same time?

Yes, you can order from multiple merchants in a single order using DoubleDash. You can add your favorite items from nearby stores to your original order for no additional delivery fee or order minimum. Both your orders will arrive together, with the same Dasher.

DoorDash Grocery Orders

Shop & Deliver: DoorDash Grocery & Convenience Store Orders

Why did my order not have all the items I ordered?

Convenience and Grocery stores sometimes have their famous items go out of stock. In those cases, we will automatically refund your card on the items we weren’t able to fulfill. Please check your email for the updated charges and refunds.

Why is my order taking so long to confirm once I place an order?

Since Shop & Deliver orders require us to match a Dasher who’s opted to do shopping, it may take an extra few minutes to find and confirm a Dasher. Hang tight and we will find a Dasher for your order and have your order delivered to you!

What are DoorDash Shop & Deliver Orders?

Our new grocery and convenience store offering allows you to shop at your favorite grocers and convenience stores and have your items delivered quickly. We currently offer a curated list of top grocery and convenience items and will be expanding our list regularly.

What happens if the store doesn’t have an item I requested?

We will do our best to deliver all the items you’ve requested. If we can’t find an item or the store is out of stock, you will receive a refund for any missing items.

What happens if the store doesn’t have exactly the quantity of an item I requested?

If for example, you requested 3 limes and only received 2, we will refund you the difference at the end of the delivery.

Can I ask my Dasher to pick up other items not on my initial order?

Yes. If you’re using Doordash on your mobile phone, you can continue to add items to your cart. Simply tap “Add” on the order tracking page while your Dasher is still shopping to add items to your order. Your Dasher will be notified and will contact you if they have any questions or need you to approve any potential substitutions.

What if I have an issue with my order?

Please contact the Dasher while the delivery is ongoing. Additionally, you can contact our support teams here.

How can I report a missing or incorrect item from my order?

First and foremost, we’re sorry! While we strive to make both your order and delivery experience perfect every time, sometimes mistakes happen. And when they do, we’re here to make things right.

If your order was delivered, but had a missing or incorrect item, one of the quickest way to get help is by reporting the issue on the DoorDash website by following the instructions below:

Mobile app users

  1. Select an order from the Orders button

  2. Tap “Help”

  3. Under “Order Issues”, select “Missing or incorrect items”

  4. Follow the prompts on the screen

Desktop users

  1. Select the button with three lines [icon] on the top left-hand corner

  2. Select Orders and choose the corresponding order

  3. Select “Help” on the right-hand side

  4. Under “Order Issues,” select “Missing items” or “Items made incorrectly”, depending on the scenario

  5. Follow the prompts on the screen

Here is a quick guide on what missing or incorrect items are:

[TABLE]

By using the Self-Help functionality, you will be offered our full suite of resolution options that a support representative can provide depending on the specific circumstances, which may include a Credit, Refund or Redelivery of your missing / incorrect items (when available).

Guidelines for Submitting Photos with Your Order Issue

To help us review and resolve your report as quickly as possible, please include clear and accurate photo evidence related to your issue. Below is a list of what we consider helpful:

What to Include:

  • Original, clear photos of the items you received

    Ensure all delivered items are visible and unwrapped. Photos should not be blurry.

  • A photo of the receipt (if available)

    This can be either a screenshot from the app or a photo of the printed receipt, and helps confirm your order contents.

  • A photo that directly supports your reported issue

    Please submit photos that show the specific problem. For example:

    • If you’re reporting a missing item, such as fries, show the opened bag with the fries missing.

    • If you received an incorrect item, include a photo of what you received instead.

Providing appropriate photo evidence helps us better understand your concern and reach a resolution more quickly.

If you need further assistance, please contact Support so we can make it right.

Note: If you received the wrong order (i.e. all item(s) were not what you ordered), please follow the above instructions but report as “Order never arrived” under “Order Issues”.

How do I cancel my order?

Decisions to provide any refunds or credits are in DoorDash’s sole discretion and are subject to the DoorDash Consumer Terms & Conditions.

Generally, for orders that are not late:

Order Status Refund
Restaurant has not confirmed order and a Dasher has not been assigned Full Refund

How do I specify special instructions when placing my order?

Examples of special instructions include requesting the sauce on the side or no tomatoes. Restaurants may not be able to accommodate certain special instructions, in these cases, the restaurant may not fulfill your request.

Note: Some special instructions will incur additional charges. If there are additional charges, DoorDash will revise the order total and send you an updated receipt. Examples of requests that may be subject to additional charges include requesting guacamole or double meat.

What is the Packages tab in my Orders?

What is the Packages tab in my Orders?

The Packages tab in your Orders page shows if it’s available in your area. The tab shows deliveries that are being sent to you from retailers for orders you placed outside of the DoorDash app (for example: Best Buy, Staples, H&M, and more). If a retailer sends your order using a delivery service powered by DoorDash, you’ll be able to track your package in real-time, view delivery updates, and communicate with your delivery Driver directly if needed. You can find the Packages tab in the Orders section of the DoorDash app.

What can I do in the Packages tab?

When a retailer sends an order to you using a delivery service powered by DoorDash, the delivery will appear in the Packages tab, where you can:

  • Track your delivery in real time

  • View delivery status updates

  • See estimated delivery times

  • Contact your Driver if there are delivery questions

  • View details about your delivery

This helps you stay updated on your delivery from the moment it’s picked up until it arrives at your door.

What is the Packages tab, and how is it different from DoorDash orders?

Your orders placed directly through retailer sites (such as Best Buy, H&M, and more) will appear within both the Packages and the All tab if they’re available in your area. Orders appear in the Packages tab when they are sent to you as a delivery from a retailer rather than a standard DoorDash order placed in the app. These deliveries may come from retailers that partner with DoorDash to deliver products directly to customers.

What if I made an order with a retailer, but I can’t see my shipment in the Packages tab?

If you placed an order with a retailer but don’t see it in the Packages tab:

  • Your shipment may not have been picked up yet.

  • The order may not always be fulfilled through a delivery service powered by DoorDash. To confirm which courier service is being used, please contact your retailer’s customer service directly with your order number.

If you need help with the order itself, please contact the retailer you purchased from.

What if I ordered multiple items from the same retailer, but I am not seeing all of my items?

If you ordered multiple items from a retailer, it’s possible that your items may arrive in separate deliveries. Retailers often split orders based on item availability, fulfillment location, or delivery timing. However, please note that deliveries powered by DoorDash will only track one package in our Packages tab, even if there are multiple deliveries from the same order. If you have any additional questions, please contact your retailer directly.

Why am I seeing a shipment that isn’t mine in the Packages tab?

If you see a delivery in your Packages tab that does not belong to you or is delivered to you, please inform DoorDash using the Customer Support line (1-855-431-0459) that the order is not intended for you.

Where is my order?

Getting hungry and wondering where your food is? We’ve got you covered.

Follow this link to check the status of your order, and contact your Dasher if you have any questions in your account. We can also send you notifications about any important updates regarding your order - just make sure you’ve opted into notifications.

  • How to check the status of your order

  • Why is my order taking longer than expected?

How to track the status of your order

After check-out, your order will go through different stages:

  • In the process of being confirmed

  • At the restaurant

  • The Dasher is on the way to you

If the restaurant you ordered from had the message, “This store delivers its own orders” (either on its store page or in check out) then DoorDash is unfortunately not able to track your delivery. Please contact the restaurant directly.

  • Mobile users

  • Desktop users

Mobile users:

  1. From the “Orders” tab, tap on your order to view its status

  2. The status information includes the estimated time of arrival and one of the three stages described above

  3. Tracking the Dasher’s status

    1. If a Dasher has already agreed to deliver your order

      • A map will appear in the orders tab showing the Dasher location respective to the restaurant and the delivery address

      • You can also contact the Dasher directly by tapping the text or call button below the status bar on your order

      • Please note that Dashers need to stay safe and obey the rules of the road. If a Dasher does not answer immediately, they may be driving

    2. If your order has yet to be picked up by a Dasher

      • Please bear with us as we may be more busy than usual
Desktop users:

  1. Select your order and click “Help”

  2. Select “Order Status”

  3. Follow the prompts to check when your order is going to be delivered and the status of your Dasher

Why is my order taking longer than expected?

First and foremost, we’re sorry that your order is taking longer than expected! While we strive to make both your order and delivery experience perfect every time, sometimes mistakes happen. And when they do, we’re here to make things right.

Restaurants and Dashers do their best to complete orders within the estimated delivery time, but external factors can cause delay. Reasons why an order may take longer than expected:

  • The Dasher may be stuck in traffic

  • The Dasher may need to take a detour

  • The restaurant may be busy

If your order is running behind the provided estimated time of arrival, you can report this issue directly in the app. Please click here for instructions if you order arrived late.

Still have questions? We’re here for you! Click here to contact our live support.

Why was my order cancelled?

Orders may be cancelled for a variety of reasons, such as:

  • The restaurant is closed

  • The restaurant is out of an item

  • The restaurant is no longer accepting takeout orders

While we never want a situation where your order is cancelled by a party other than you, if it is, we will ensure you receive a full credit or refund.

Credit Back Terms and Conditions

Annual Plan Credits Reward. From time to time, DoorDash may choose to provide certain annual plan DashPass members a credit back reward, where select users will, during their first DashPass annual plan billing cycle, earn a percentage of their order subtotal back as DoorDash credits (Annual Plan Credits Reward). The Annual Plan Credits Reward will not be available to all DoorDash customers, but only available to select DashPass customers as determined by DoorDash from time to time at its own discretion. Subject to eligibility requirements, no additional registration, enrollment, or information is required for participation in the Annual Plan Credits Reward.

Earning credits. Annual Plan Credits Rewards are only available to be earnt during the 12 month period from when a customer signs up to the DoorDash Annual Plan. Annual Plan Credits Rewards will only be earnt on select orders during a as determined by DoorDash from time to time. The value of the DoorDash credits will be calculated as a percentage of a customer’s order subtotal, with the value of that percentage determined by DoorDash from time to time. The subtotal value will not include any promotional discounts, and will exclude the value of any DoorDash credits used to purchase the order. Credits will not be earned on fees, taxes or gratuity. Credits will not be earnt or on any items containing alcohol or other restricted items as determined by DoorDash.

Maximum credits. Customers participating in the Annual Plan Credits Reward will not be able to earn more than $100 worth of DoorDash credits within each annual plan billing cycle. DoorDash may change the maximum value of credits a customer may earn in any billing cycle at any time.

Using credits. Credits will only be deposited to a customer’s account and be available for use following within 5 days of customer’s DashPass annual plan membership renewing. If a customer fails to renew their DashPass annual plan membership, any credits earnt will be forfeited. Customers will not be entitled to a refund for the DashPass annual subscription fee should credits be deposited into their account. DoorDash credits can only be redeemed for DoorDash orders on www.doordash.com or in the DoorDash app with the latest version, and within DoorDash service areas and service hours. Credits can only be applied to orders in the jurisdiction of the currency in which the credits are issued Credits cannot be applied to the purchase of alcohol where prohibited. Credits cannot be applied to the purchase of any gift cards unless otherwise permitted. DoorDash reserves the right to refuse or restrict the use of credits on any order.

Canceled Orders. Orders that are canceled whether by consumer, Merchant or DoorDash will not be eligible to earn DoorDash credits.

Expiration of Credits. Credits earnt under the as an Annual Plan Credits Reward may expire after a certain period of time as determined by DoorDash in its sole discretion. Should credits expire, the credits will be forfeited and consumers will not be entitled to any substitute, credit or compensation for the expired DoorDash credits.

Fraud and misconduct. DoorDash reserves the right to prohibit consumers from earning, accruing or redeeming credits and canceling a customer’s DashPass subscription without notice if DoorDash believes in its sole discretion that the user is or is attempting to act fraudulently or in bad faith when seeking to earn, accrue or redeem credits. DoorDash may also revoke a consumers credits at any time without prior notice.

Modification; Termination. DoorDash reserves the right to modify, suspend, terminate or discontinue the Annual Plan Credits Rewards program at any time without any notice to consumers. In the event of termination or modification of the Annual Plan Credits Rewards program, consumers will not be entitled to any substitute,credit or compensation for unredeemed credits.

Miscellaneous. Consumers participation and use of the Annual Plan Credits Rewards program is subject to the Doordash Consumer Terms and Conditions. Annual Plan Credits Reward are only available for select US residents only. DoorDash credits may not be auctioned, traded, copied, transferred, bartered, modified, sold, or redeemed for cash or a cash equivalent.

Dasher DashPass Benefit - Sign Up Promo

We are excited to offer Active Dashers an exclusive DoorDash perk — one month of free DashPass, followed by 50% off ($4.99 a month). To be eligible for this offer, Dashers must complete at least 1 delivery a month. Once eligible, an email will be sent with more info on how to redeem.

What is DashPass? DashPass is a subscription service that offers unlimited deliveries from thousands of eligible restaurants with $0 delivery fee on orders over $12.* DashPass is currently available in the United States and Canada with some areas excluded. See full terms here.

My DashPass Benefits did not apply? If you are a DashPass subscriber but your order does not meet the minimum basket subtotal, your DashPass benefits will not apply. Additionally, to make sure your order is eligible, look for the green DashPass icon underneath the merchant’s name. In order to make sure benefits are applied correctly please follow these steps:

  • Enjoy $0 delivery fees and reduced service fees on all DashPass orders over $12.* or more and eligible grocery store orders of $25 or more.

  • DashPass subscribers save an average of $4-5 per eligible order. With new restaurants added and more on the way, you’ll spend more time picking the food you want and less time hunting for deals across delivery platforms.

I see an unauthorized charge of $4.99. We know that seeing an unfamiliar charge on your account can be alarming. We’re here to help. If you see an unknown charge:

  • Consider who else has access to your account. If a family member or partner has your login info, it’s possible for them to place an order with your saved payment information from a different device.

  • If you don’t have a DoorDash account, consider all parties with whom you have willingly shared credit card information. It’s possible that they used your card to place an order with their own account.

  • If the bank statement says DoorDash DashPass or DashPass then it is a charge for our subscription service. You can verify the same by opening Manage DashPass Banner and check Billing History.

What else is included? Subscribers enjoy exclusive member benefits, like priority customer support and DashPass-only promotions. When you subscribe to DashPass you will be able to redeem the benefits on both Caviar and DoorDash.

Will my DashPass benefits apply to both Caviar and DoorDash? Yes! Please use the same login information for both Caviar and DoorDash. Your DashPass benefits will automatically be available on both platforms.

What will happen if I cancel my free trial? If you cancel during a trial period, your benefits will be terminated immediately. If you cancel after the billing date your subscription will be charged to your default payment method and DashPass benefits will be valid till the end of the billing cycle.

How much does it cost? Eligible Dashers get all of the above for just $4.99/month. You can redeem this exclusive offer through your promo link sent via email. Make sure to use your Dasher log-in information and dash at least once a month to keep your benefit.

DashMatch Terms and Conditions

DashMatch is a memory-matching game offered by DoorDash to select DoorDash customers in the United States. DashMatch is offered on a weekly basis, typically on Tuesdays from 12:00 AM to 11:59 PM EST, on an ongoing basis until modified, suspended, or discontinued by DoorDash. Themes, timing, format, and rewards may vary. DoorDash does not guarantee that DashMatch will be offered at any given time or in any given week.

DashMatch is open only to select DoorDash customers who (a) reside in the United States, (b) maintain an active DoorDash account in good standing, and (c) have completed at least one prior DoorDash order. DashMatch is not available to all DoorDash customers, and eligible participants are selected by DoorDash at its sole discretion. DoorDash may revoke eligibility or access to DashMatch at any time, without notice.

How to participate: Eligible customers may be presented with a memory-matching game in the DoorDash app and will have one (1) attempt during that week. The game will consist of a grid of face-down tiles arranged in matching pairs. Participants must match all pairs within the time limits to be deemed a winner. Participants may only attempt the game once per week. If a participant exits or otherwise terminates the game before completion, their progress will not be saved and they will not be awarded a prize.

Rewards: Each week, participants will receive either (i) no promotional prize or reward for completing DashMatch or (ii) a promotional reward in a form that will be disclosed to eligible customers within the DoorDash platform. The promotional reward may only be redeemed on qualifying purchases in specified restaurant or food categories (for example, $10 off dessert or burger orders). Eligible categories, participating merchants, and applicable terms will be disclosed within the DoorDash platform, including through in-app banners, the notification hub, and the store pages of eligible merchants.

Promotional rewards must be redeemed within the time specified in your DoorDash account and may only be redeemed at participating restaurant locations. The rewards may only be redeemed on eligible orders with a minimum subtotal of $12 excluding fees and taxes. Discounts apply to subtotal only; no discount will be applied to fees, taxes, and gratuity. If the full value of the promotional reward is not used on a single order, the remaining value will be forfeited. Not valid for pickup orders or gifting orders. Limit of one weekly reward per person. Not valid for the purchase of alcohol and other restricted items. Fees, taxes, and gratuity still apply. To redeem, select the reward to apply in your wallet at checkout.

Modification of terms: DoorDash reserves the right to modify, suspend, terminate, cancel or discontinue the DashMatch offer at any time without any notice. In the event of termination or modification of the DashMatch offer, customers will not be entitled to any substitute, credit, or compensation.

Fraud and misconduct: DoorDash reserves the right to revoke or suspend eligibility for DashMatch if DoorDash believes, in its sole discretion, that a participant is (or is attempting to) act fraudulently, in bad faith, or otherwise in violation of these Terms. DoorDash may refuse to award or may revoke a reward at any time without notice if DoorDash believes that it has been obtained in a fraudulent or abusive manner.

General: DashMatch is subject to the DoorDash Consumer Terms and Conditions. The offer is only available for select DoorDash members in the US only as determined by DoorDash. DashMatch is not available to all DoorDash members. Eligibility for participating in DashMatch and whether you will be awarded the reward is in DoorDash’s sole discretion.

DashPass benefits apply only on eligible orders from DashPass merchants that meet the minimum subtotal requirement, excluding fees and taxes. Subtotal minimums will be identified for each DashPass merchant on DoorDash.

DashPass Family Sharing - Terms & Conditions

By sharing your DashPass account or accepting an invitation to share a DashPass account, you agree to the DoorDash Consumer Terms & Conditions (including Section 13 “DashPass Subscriptions”) and the following terms and conditions (the “DashPass Family Sharing Terms & Conditions”)

DashPass Family Account Sharing: The DashPass family sharing feature allows certain DashPass members (“Account Sharers”), as indicated in their DoorDash accounts, to invite another person (“Invitees”) to join their DashPass family account and apply select DashPass benefits on the Invitees’ eligible orders. Account Sharers may only share their account with one Invitee at a time; Account Sharers may replace the Invitee with another Invitee up to one (1) time per calendar year. Account Sharer may remove the Invitee from their family account at any time.

Availability & Eligibility: DoorDash reserves the right to limit the availability of the DashPass family account sharing feature only to select Account Sharers. DashPass members on partnership DashPass plans, DashPass Student Plan and corporate DashPass plans are not eligible to be Account Sharers. DoorDash further reserves the right to limit the ability of certain Invitees to participate in DashPass family accounts. The DashPass family account sharing feature is only available to Account Sharers and Invitees who meet the following conditions (“Eligibility Criteria”):

  • DashPass Account Sharers and Invitees must each have or create a valid DoorDash account with a valid form of accepted payment on file;

  • DashPass Account Sharers must not have a paused DashPass subscription and must not have their subscription pending cancellation;

  • Invitees cannot have another active DashPass membership;

  • Invitees can only participate in one DashPass family account at a time;

  • The Account Sharer and Invitee must reside in the same country; and

  • Account Sharers must not invite Invitees who reside in a different country.

DoorDash reserves the right to temporarily or permanently remove or suspend Invitees who do not meet these Eligibility Criteria as determined by DoorDash in its sole discretion. If Account Sharers invite Invitees who do not meet these Eligibility Criteria as determined by DoorDash in its sole discretion, DoorDash may temporarily or permanently restrict the Account Sharer’s ability to create or invite others to their family accounts.

DoorDash further reserves the right to restrict access to the DashPass family sharing feature to any Account Sharers or Invitees who have engaged in any fraud, abuse, tampering, or violation of these DashPass Family Sharing Terms & Conditions or the DoorDash Consumer Terms and Conditions.

Orders: If you place an order on DoorDash as an Invitee on a DashPass family account, you are solely responsible for payment for that order. You are also solely responsible for any communications with respect to that order and for ensuring that you meet any applicable order requirements (e.g., signature on delivery, identification verification).

Benefits: By accepting a DashPass family account invitation, Invitees will have access to certain DashPass benefits associated with the DashPass membership of the Account Sharer. DoorDash reserves the right to restrict, modify, or limit the DashPass benefits that are shared with Invitees and made available to them. DashPass benefits will only apply to the individual user placing the order; those benefits will not apply or transfer to the other members in the family account. The Account Sharer or Invitee may not both be able to access any offer or other benefits that have a “one per DashPass membership” limitation if that offer or benefit has already been redeemed by another member of the DashPass family account. Participation in a DashPass family account may also restrict the ability of the Account Sharer or Invitee to participate in free or discounted DashPass memberships or trials.

Termination of DashPass Benefits: The Invitee will immediately lose access to DashPass benefits if (1) the Account Sharer’s DashPass membership terminates or expires for any reason, (2) the DashPass family sharing feature is deactivated, either by the Account Sharer or by DoorDash, or (3) the Invitee leaves the DashPass family account.

Other: These DashPass Family Sharing Terms & Conditions are subject to change at any time. DoorDash reserves the right to modify, restrict, or cancel these DashPass Family Sharing Terms & Conditions at any time. DoorDash further reserves the right to modify, restrict, or cancel the DashPass family sharing feature at any time.

Q: What is the DashPass offer for Amazon Prime members?

A: Amazon.ca Prime members in Canada can get all the benefits of a DashPass membership for free. This offer is active as long as your Prime membership is active, and the free membership does not convert to a paid DashPass membership. Amazon customers in Canada can also order from DoorDash restaurants on the DoorDash digital store on Amazon. The offer is limited to one per customer and account and is non-transferable and may not be resold. See DashPass Terms.

Q: What if I’m not a Prime member?

A: If you’re not a Prime member, you can still order from DoorDash merchant restaurants via the DoorDash digital store using your Amazon account, but you will not be eligible for a free DashPass membership.

Q: Will Amazon share any of my personal information with DoorDash?

A: Yes. When you link your Amazon and DoorDash accounts, Amazon will share your Prime membership status and customer identification code with DoorDash so that DoorDash knows you are a Prime member. The collection and disclosure of your personal information will be done in accordance with the Amazon.ca Privacy Notice.

Q: What benefits do I receive with a free DashPass membership?

A: Your free access to DashPass includes unlimited $0 delivery fees, reduced service fees, and exclusive offers on eligible orders placed from DoorDash merchants that meet the subtotal minimum, as well as 5% DashPass credit back on eligible pickup orders. See DashPass Terms.

Q: How long does the free DashPass membership last?

A: As long as your Prime membership is active and this offer is available, you are eligible for a free DashPass membership.

Q: Are existing DoorDash members eligible for this offer?

A: Yes. Follow the redemption steps to activate your free DashPass membership. Once you activate this Prime-only offer, your existing DashPass membership will be cancelled. If you’ve already paid for a DashPass membership, you’ll receive a prorated refund for the unused portion of your current billing period calculated from the date you activate this offer:

  • For monthly plan subscribers: You’ll be refunded for the days remaining in your current billing month.

  • For annual subscribers: You’ll be refunded for the unused portion of your year.

Q: Who do I contact if I have an issue connecting my account?

A: First, verify that you are logged into Amazon. For questions about your Amazon Prime membership, contact Amazon customer service. For questions about your DoorDash account, DashPass membership, or DoorDash orders, contact DoorDash customer support.

Q: How do I place an order on the DoorDash digital store on Amazon?

A: If you have confirmed that you are logged in and have activated the offer, visit to start your order. You may still place DoorDash orders on Amazon even if you are not a Prime member by selecting “Continue without Prime”. You will not receive the benefits of free DashPass (e.g. $0 delivery fees and reduced service fees on eligible orders).

Q: Will I be able to earn third party reward programs or benefits on purchases within the DoorDash digital store on Amazon?

A: Purchases made through the DoorDash digital store may be ineligible for third party reward programs or benefits. Contact us to find out more information.

Q: How do I unlink my Amazon and DoorDash accounts?

A: You can unlink your accounts at any time by visiting the “Manage apps & services with data access” within the “Your Account” page on Amazon and unlinking your DoorDash and Amazon accounts. Unlinking your Amazon account, however, will result in the termination of your free DashPass membership. If you would like to continue your DashPass membership, you can sign up for a paid DashPass membership.

Q: How do I cancel my free DashPass membership?

A: You can cancel at any time by visiting the “Manage DashPass” section in your DoorDash account settings or contacting DoorDash customer support. See DoorDash Cancellation Instructions. If you cancel your free DashPass, your DashPass membership and benefits will end immediately.

Q: What if I cancel my Amazon Prime membership?

A: If you cancel or pause your Amazon Prime membership or if your membership is otherwise terminated, your free DashPass membership and benefits will end immediately and will not be auto renewed to a paid DashPass membership. If you would like to continue your DashPass membership, you can sign up for a paid DashPass membership. If you choose to join Prime again, you will need to activate your free DashPass benefits again by visiting amazon.ca/DoorDash.

Q: If after redeeming the free DashPass membership, I decide that I want to delete my DoorDash account, what happens to my Prime x DashPass offer?

A: If you delete your DoorDash account, you will lose access to this offer. The offer is limited to one redemption per customer and account.

Help page link added on the offer landing page:

Prime x DashPass

All Amazon.ca customers can order on the DoorDash digital store on Amazon, irrespective of their Prime membership. Only Amazon.ca Prime members in Canada are eligible to receive this free DashPass membership.

  • Amazon.ca Prime members can enjoy a FREE DashPass membership (normally $9.99/month) (plus tax) with Amazon Prime as long as your Prime membership is active.

  • DashPass members get exclusive benefits like $0 delivery fees and lower service fees on eligible delivery orders that meet the subtotal minimum (before taxes, fees, and any tip) from eligible merchants, 5% back in DashPass Credit on eligible pickup orders, and access to exclusive offers.

  • Amazon Prime for Young Adult members who are at least 18 years old are also eligible for a FREE DashPass membership as long as your Amazon Prime account is active.

  • The offer is limited to one per customer and account and is non-transferable and may not be resold. See DashPass Terms.

  • Existing DashPass members are eligible for this offer as well. You may activate the offer on the Amazon DashPass Prime Offer landing page, connect your DoorDash account, and your DashPass membership will convert to the free membership at the start of your next billing cycle.

  • To activate this offer, visit the Amazon DashPass Prime Offer landing page.

  • For any additional information about the DashPass membership, visit DoorDash.

2. Will my DashPass benefits apply to both Caviar and DoorDash?

  • All DashPass benefits will apply to DoorDash and Caviar. Please use the same login information for both Caviar and DoorDash. Your DashPass benefits will automatically be available on both platforms.

  • Chase specific Non-restaurant and Restaurant promos are not available in the Caviar app.

  • If you are having trouble accessing your benefits, please see below for troubleshooting steps.

3. What makes an order eligible for DashPass benefits?

  • An order is eligible for DashPass benefits if it is from a participating DashPass store and the order meets the subtotal minimum identified in the DoorDash/Caviar app or website.

  • Things to check before placing an order:

  1. Check the DoorDash app or doordash.com for restaurants near you that have the green DashPass symbol.

  2. Enjoy a $0 delivery fee and reduced services fees on eligible restaurant, grocery, and convenience orders from DashPass merchants that meet the subtotal minimum, as detailed in the DoorDash app or website.

  3. Make sure the payment method is the same Chase credit card you used to sign up for DashPass.

4. What happens if I remove my Chase credit card from my account?

  • DashPass benefits are available when using your Chase credit card as the selected payment method at checkout with your activated DashPass subscription.

  • You won’t be able to access these DashPass benefits if you remove your eligible Chase credit card as your selected payment method at checkout

5. I have a Sapphire Reserve for Business or Ink Business Preferred card, in addition to a Consumer card (i.e. Sapphire/JPMorgan Reserve, Sapphire Preferred, Freedom, Slate or Co-Brand card), can I receive promos on both cards?

  • Restaurant and non-restaurant promos are tied to each consumer’s DashPass membership. While DoorDash consumers may have both a Chase Business credit card and Chase Consumer credit card in their DoorDash wallet on one account, only 1 DashPass subscription can be tied to an individual DoorDash account at one time, and therefore only 1 set of promos can be associated with an account at one time.

  • In order to utilize the Restaurant and Non-Restaurant promos tied to multiple DashPass memberships, please create two separate DoorDash accounts with separate login details (e.g., email, password) – one account associated with your business card and one associated with your Consumer card. You will need to use a different email for each account.

  • Please log out and log back in to the desired account to unlock the Restaurant and Non-Restaurant promos associated with each account.

​​​​7. What happens if I add another eligible Chase card to my DoorDash or Caviar wallet?

  • DashPass benefits are tied to the Chase card that is the default payment for your order.

  • For example, if you add a Chase Freedom card and then add a Chase Sapphire card as your default, you’ll receive the benefits for Chase Sapphire cardmembers after your successful DashPass activation.

  • You will then have a new activation and expiration date for your Sapphire DashPass benefit.

8. How is the expiration date of my Chase benefit determined?

  • The subscription period for all users on a Chase account will begin and end based on when the first cardmember activates the subscription on the DoorDash or Caviar mobile app.

9. What happens if I activate my free DashPass with my eligible Chase card then upgrade or downgrade to another eligible Chase card?

  • You will be unenrolled from your existing DashPass subscription and notified by DoorDash or Caviar to update your payment information in your DoorDash or Caviar wallet with your new Chase card payment information.

  • Once your new card is added to DoorDash or Caviar you will be prompted to enroll in the benefit offer specific to your eligible Chase product.

  • If the subscription benefit is different for your new product, your subscription will reset including a new activation and expiration date. If the subscription benefit is the same, your subscription will not reset and your expiration date will remain the same.

10. What happens if I pay for an order with an ineligible payment method?

  • While you’re free to use the payment method of your choice, exclusive DashPass benefits, and promotions, will only apply when using an eligible Chase credit card as the default payment method.

  • You’ll pay the full delivery fee on an order from a DashPass restaurant if you pay with an ineligible payment method.

  • To take advantage of your DashPass benefits, make sure you activate your DashPass subscription and pay for your DashPass order using an eligible Chase credit card.

11. What happens if I currently pay for a DashPass membership?

  • Upon activation of your Chase DashPass membership, your existing membership will be replaced and you will no longer be charged for your DashPass membership. In order to take advantage of the DashPass benefits, you will need to use your eligible Chase credit card as your default payment method.

12. If I have two Chase cards with a limited time DashPass, can I take advantage of a second free period after one expires?

  • Yes! Simply add your other Chase credit card after your prior free DashPass expires and make sure it is the default payment method for your DoorDash orders.

  • It is important to note that only one DashPass can be active at a time.

​​

13. Am I eligible for the DashPass Family Sharing feature as part of my free or discount DashPass with Chase?

  • As of June 2025, Chase card holders do not have access to the DashPass Family Sharing feature, but stay tuned as this feature may be available at a later date. Don’t forget - Sapphire Reserve and Preferred card members have the ability to add multiple authorized users to their DashPass account.

14. How do promos work?

  • Add your desired items from a vendor to your cart

  • Navigate to View cart

  • Tap the toggle to “ON” to active the Chase restaurant or non-restaurant promo

  • If you wish to apply an additional DoorDash promotion:

    • Scroll down to order Summary

    • Click Promo codes, rewards & gift cards

    • Click the promo you wish to apply

  • Chase promotions are stackable with up to one other DoorDash order cart-level promo

Q:What DashPass benefits do I get as an Avion Rewards member?

A: DoorDash Inc (DoorDash) and RBC Royal Bank of Canada (RBC) or (Royal Bank) are pleased to offer a complimentary DashPass subscription to eligible RBC cardholders and Avion Rewards members (Offer).

To be eligible for the Offer you must be either (i) the primary cardholder of an Eligible RBC credit card (see“Eligible Card types” below), or (ii) an Avion Select member, and also meet the following criteria:

No Recent DashPass Subscription: You must not have been subscribed to DashPass in any form (including but not limited to a paid membership, free trial, promotional subscription, or partnership plan) within the six months immediately preceding redemption of the Offer. For clarity the six-month eligibility requirement is a fixed look-back period, not a rolling period.

Redemption Limit: You may redeem at most two complimentary DashPass subscription periods in your lifetime through DashPass for RBC, regardless of whether obtained via a previous offer, this Offer, an upgrade, or any other related promotion. Once this limit is reached, the individual is no longer eligible for additional complimentary DashPass Subscription periods through DashPass for RBC.

You must be a resident of Canada at the time of redemption.

The specific benefits depend upon which RBC credit card is added to your account or if you joined through Avion Rewards

  • Eligible Avion Rewards members will receive 2 months free of DashPass

  • Eligible Premium credit cards will receive 6 months free of DashPass

  • Eligible Elite credit cards will receive 12 months free of DashPass

If you have already claimed a second complimentary DashPass Subscription through DashPass for RBC through an RBC product (whether through an upgrade or otherwise), including in a prior Offer period, you will no longer be eligible for a complimentary DashPass Subscription through DashPass for RBC.

DashPass Highly Rated Dashers Benefit Terms & Conditions

DashPass Highly Rated Dashers Benefit Terms & Conditions

The DashPass Highly Rated Dashers benefit is available for select DashPass members as indicated in their account. This benefit gives eligible orders from eligible DashPass members higher priority to Highly Rated Dashers compared to non-DashPass orders.

Eligible orders are more likely to be assigned Highly Rated Dashers and Platinum Dashers, as indicated in-app after Dasher assignment on an order.

Dashers that qualify for the Top or Platinum Dasher program have:

  • Customer rating of at least 4.7

  • Completion rate of at least 95%

Highly Rated or Platinum Dasher availability and assignment depends on market conditions. We reserve the right to cancel this benefit at any time at our sole discretion.

If you would like to learn more about Platinum Dashers from the Dasher Rewards program please visit this page.

DashPass Household Sharing - Terms & Conditions

DashPass Household Sharing Terms & Conditions (U.S. Only)

By sharing your DashPass account or accepting an invitation to share a DashPass account, you agree to the DoorDash Consumer Terms & Conditions (including Section 13 “DashPass Subscriptions”) and the following terms and conditions (the “DashPass Household Sharing Terms & Conditions”):

DashPass Household Account Sharing: The DashPass household sharing feature allows certain DashPass members (“Account Sharers”) as indicated in their DoorDash accounts to invite household members (“Invitees”) to join their DashPass household account and apply DashPass benefits on the Invitees’ eligible orders. Account Sharers may only share their account with one Invitee at a time; Account Sharers may replace the Invitee with another Invitee up to one (1) time per calendar year. Account Sharer may remove the Invitee from their household account at any time.

Availability & Eligibility. DoorDash reserves the right to limit the availability of the DashPass household account sharing feature only to select Account Sharers. DashPass members on partnership DashPass plans, corporate DashPass plans, non-US DashPass plans are not eligible to be Account Sharers. DoorDash further reserves the right to limit the ability of certain Invitees to participate in DashPass household accounts. The DashPass household account sharing feature is only available to Account Sharers and Invitees who meet the following conditions (“Eligibility Criteria”):

  • DashPass Account Sharers and Invitees must each have or create a valid DoorDash account with a valid form of accepted payment on file;

  • DashPass Account Sharers must not have a paused DashPass subscription and must not have their subscription pending cancellation;

  • Invitees cannot have another active DashPass membership;

  • Invitees can only participate in one DashPass household account at a time

  • DoorDash reserves the right to temporarily or permanently remove or suspend Invitees who do not meet these Eligibility Criteria as determined by DoorDash in its sole discretion. If Account Sharers invite Invitees who do not meet these Eligibility Criteria as determined by DoorDash in its sole discretion, DoorDash may temporarily or permanently restrict the Account Sharers’ ability to create or invite others to their household accounts.

DoorDash further reserves the right to restrict access to the DashPass household sharing feature to any Account Sharers or Invitees who have engaged in any fraud, abuse, tampering, or violation of these DashPass Household Sharing Terms & Conditions or the DoorDash Consumer Terms and Conditions

Orders. If you place an order on DoorDash through a DashPass household account, you are solely responsible for payment for that order. You are also solely responsible for any communications with respect to that order and for ensuring that you meet any applicable order requirements (e.g., signature on delivery, identification verification).

Benefits. By accepting a DashPass household account invitation, Invitees will have access to certain DashPass benefits associated with the DashPass membership of the Account Sharer. DoorDash reserves the right to restrict, modify, or limit the DashPass benefits that are shared with Invitees and made available to Invitees. DashPass benefits will only apply to the individual user placing the order; those benefits will not apply or transfer to the other member in the Household Account. The Account Sharer or Invitee may not both be able to access any offer or other benefits that have a “one per household” limitation if that offer or benefit has already been redeemed by another member of the DashPass household account. Participation in a DashPass household account may also restrict the ability of the Account Sharer or Invitee to participate in free or discounted DashPass memberships or trials.

Termination of DashPass Benefits. The Invitee will immediately lose access to DashPass benefits if (1) the Account Sharer’s DashPass membership terminates or expires for any reason, (2) the DashPass household sharing feature is deactivated, either by the Account Sharer or by DoorDash, or (3) the Invitee leaves the DashPass household account.

Other. These DashPass Household Sharing Terms & Conditions are subject to change at any time. DoorDash reserves the right to modify, restrict, or cancel these DashPass Household Sharing Terms & Conditions at any time. DoorDash further reserves the right to modify, restrict, or cancel the DashPass household sharing feature at any time.

DashPass Lyft Partnership FAQs

DashPass Lyft Partnership FAQs

1. What is the Lyft & DashPass partnership?

a. All active US DashPass members can link their Lyft account to their DoorDash account to enjoy exclusive rideshare and food delivery benefits.

2. What benefits do I get with the Lyft x DashPass partnership?

a. Always-on benefits include:

  • 4 discounted rides per month:

    • 10% discount for scheduled Lyft rides to and from the airport

    • 5% discount for on-demand Lyft rides in Standard, Extra Comfort, XL, Black, and Black SUV modes.

  • 2 free Priority Pickup upgrades per month

  • For new DashPass members only: 3 months of DashPass, free. Eligibility requirements apply.

b. Benefits available through 1/31/26 include:

  • New Lyft riders who link their DashPass accounts get up to $10 off their next 2 Lyft rides valid for 14 days after account linking (for any ride mode, up to $10 per ride and $20 in total)

3. How do I link my Lyft account to DashPass?

a. You can link your accounts at http://doordash.com/lyft

b. Please ensure you click ‘Confirm’ on the ‘Confirm linking your Lyft account to DoorDash’ screen when linking your account.

4. Why do I see a blank screen when clicking on a Lyft Advertisement?

a. If you click on a Lyft advertisement banner on DoorDash and it leads you to a blank screen, please update your DoorDash app to the latest version. If the issue persists, update your Lyft app as well.

5. I’ve linked my account, but I’m not receiving the benefits. What should I do?

a. Ensure you clicked ‘Confirm’ on the ‘Confirm linking your Lyft account to DoorDash’ screen when linking your account at http://doordash.com/lyft.

b. For scheduled airport rides, the discount only applies to rides specifically scheduled to (and not from) the airport.

  1. If using a Business Profile, discounts don’t apply automatically. To apply these discounts:

  • After the ride is completed, locate the “Rate and Pay” screen (see below).

  • Tap on the section with the details of your payment setup (see circled in red above)

    • On the Payments screen, tap to change the applied benefits

    • Choose available benefits (0-10% off your next ride)

    • Tap the back button

    • On the Payment screen, tap on Done

    • Observe that the coupon was applied on the Rate and Pay screen

    • Reach out to Lyft Customer Support if you need help or have additional questions.

d. For issues specifically related to Lyft rides or discounts, please contact Lyft Customer Support.

For questions about your DashPass account or the linking process, contact DoorDash Support.

6. What happens to my Lyft benefits if I cancel DashPass?

a. After you cancel your active, non-trial DashPass subscription, your Lyft benefits will be valid through the end of your current billing period. Thereafter, you will no longer be eligible for the Lyft benefits or any DashPass benefits. Please visit this article for more information on what happens to DashPass benefits when you cancel your DashPass and instructions for how to cancel your DashPass.

7. Is there a free trial available for DashPass after connecting my Lyft account?

a. Some consumers may be eligible for a free DashPass trial, which might include a three-month period through the Lyft partnership. If you meet the eligibility requirements, the offer will appear in your account. For more information on who is eligible for a free trial, please visit this article. DoorDash may change the eligibility requirements for a free DashPass trial at any time without notice.

8. What happens if I unlink my Lyft and DoorDash accounts?

a. You can unlink your accounts here.

b. You can also unlink your accounts by going to Manage DashPass > Lyft Benefit > Manage Lyft Link > Unlink Icon Next to Lyft > Confirm Unlink.

c. If you unlink your Lyft and DoorDash accounts, you will no longer be eligible for any of the Lyft benefits.

d. If you unlink your Lyft and DoorDash accounts during the three-month free trial referred to above, then you will no longer be entitled to any Lyft benefits and will also be downgraded to a 30-day free DashPass trial. At the conclusion of that 30-day free trial, you will automatically be charged the then-current monthly DashPass membership fee (currently $9.99) plus applicable tax until you cancel. The DashPass membership fee will be charged to your preferred payment method or any other payment method in your DoorDash account.

DashPass Lyft Partnership FAQs (Canada)

DashPass Lyft Partnership FAQs (Canada)

1. What is the Lyft & DashPass partnership?

a. All active DashPass members in Canada can link their Lyft account to their DoorDash account to enjoy exclusive rideshare benefits, on top of existing delivery benefits.

2. What benefits do I get with the Lyft x DashPass partnership?

a. Always-on benefits include:

1) Up to 4 discounted rides per calendar month:

  • 10% discount for Lyft rides scheduled to and/or from the airport in Standard, Extra Comfort, XL, Black, and Black SUV modes

  • 5% discount for on-demand Lyft rides in Standard, Extra Comfort, XL, Black, and Black SUV modes (excludes Wait & Save rides)

  • 2 Priority Pickup upgrades per calendar month (unused upgrades expire at the end of each calendar month and do not roll over) when available.

  • For new DashPass members only: 3 months of DashPass, free. Eligibility requirements apply.

b. New Lyft riders who link their DashPass accounts get 50% off one Lyft ride, up to $10 CAD, valid for 30 days after linking accounts. This offer does not stack with other promotions and replaces any existing new user offers in the market.

3. How do I link my Lyft account to DashPass?

a. You can link your accounts at doordash.com/dashpass/partner/lyft

b.. Please ensure you click ‘Confirm’ on the ‘Confirm linking your Lyft account to DoorDash’ screen when linking your account.

4. Why do I see a blank screen when clicking on a Lyft Advertisement?

a. If you click on a Lyft advertisement banner on DoorDash and it leads you to a blank screen, please update your DoorDash app to the latest version. If the issue persists, update your Lyft app as well.

5. I’ve linked my account, but I’m not receiving the benefits. What should I do?

a. Ensure you clicked ‘Confirm’ on the ‘Confirm linking your Lyft account to DoorDash’ screen when linking your account at doordash.com/dashpass/partner/lyft.
b. For scheduled airport rides, the 10% discount applies to rides scheduled to and/or from the airport in Standard, Extra Comfort, XL, Black, and Black SUV modes. Wait & Save rides are not eligible for any discount.
c. If using a Business Profile, discounts don’t apply automatically. To apply these discounts:

  • After the ride is completed, locate the “Rate and Pay” screen.

  • Tap on the section with the details of your payment setup (see circled in red above)

  • On the Payments screen, tap to change the applied benefits

  • Choose available benefits (0-10% off your next ride)

  • Tap on the back button

  • On the Payment screen, tap on Done

  • Observe that the coupon was applied on the Rate and Pay screen

  • Reach out to Lyft Customer Support if you need help or have additional questions.

d. For issues specifically related to Lyft rides or discounts, please contact Lyft Customer Support.
e. For questions about your DashPass account or the linking process, contact DoorDash Support.

6. What happens to my Lyft benefits if I cancel DashPass?

a. After you cancel your active, non-trial DashPass subscription, your Lyft benefits will be valid through the end of your current billing period. Thereafter, you will no longer be eligible for the Lyft benefits or any DashPass benefits. Please visit this article for more information on what happens to DashPass benefits when you cancel your DashPass and instructions for how to cancel your DashPass.

7. Is there a free trial available for DashPass after connecting my Lyft account?

a. Some consumers may be eligible for a free DashPass trial, which might include a three-month period through the Lyft partnership. If you meet the eligibility requirements, the offer will appear in your account. Eligibility is limited to consumers who are not current or past DashPass subscribers and have not had a free DashPass trial in the past 6 months. DoorDash may change the eligibility requirements for a free DashPass trial at any time without notice.

8. What happens if I unlink my Lyft and DoorDash accounts?

a. You can unlink your accounts here.
b. You can also unlink your accounts by going to Manage DashPass > Lyft Benefit > Manage Lyft Link > Unlink Icon Next to Lyft > Confirm Unlink.
c. If you unlink your Lyft and DoorDash accounts, you will no longer be eligible for any of the Lyft benefits.
d. If you unlink your Lyft and DoorDash accounts during the three-month free trial referred to above, then you will no longer be entitled to any Lyft benefits and will also be downgraded to a 30-day free DashPass trial. At the conclusion of that 30-day free trial, you will automatically be charged the then-current monthly DashPass membership fee (currently $[X.XX] CAD) plus applicable tax until you cancel. The DashPass membership fee will be charged to your preferred or any other payment method in your DoorDash account.

9. Do benefits apply to rides outside of Canada?

a. No, Lyft benefits through DashPass are currently available only to DashPass members in Canada and apply solely to eligible Lyft rides taken within Canada. Lyft benefits are not available for rides outside of Canada, and benefits do not travel or apply cross-border.

DashPass Pickup Benefit 5% Back in DoorDash Credit on Eligible Pickup Orders

In this articles:

  • How do I earn credit back?

  • How do I redeem my DoorDash credit? Can I save them and apply them toward a future purchase?

  • Does credit that I earn expire?

  • Can I combine this benefit to earn credit back with another promo?

  • When will I get my credit back?

  • How do I know how much credit I have in my account?

  • Does this benefit work on Caviar?

  • DashPass Pickup Benefit Terms and Conditions:

Frequently Asked Questions:

Q: How do I earn credit back?

A: As a current DashPass subscriber who has this benefit available in your DoorDash account, you can earn 5% back in DoorDash credit by following the steps below:

  1. Order Pickup from a DashPass restaurant and you’ll earn 5% credit back unless another promo code is applied to that order.

  2. In your cart, you’ll see how much credit you’re getting back, based on the order subtotal. If you don’t, tap Promo Code and select ‘DashPass Pickup Benefit’.

  3. After your Pickup is complete, your DoorDash credit will be added to your account and automatically applied to your next order.

Q: How do I redeem my DoorDash credit? Can I save them and apply them toward a future purchase?

A: No, DoorDash credit cannot be accrued. DoorDash credit in your account will be automatically applied to the next Delivery or Pickup order that you place on DoorDash.

Q: Does credit that I earn expire?

A: DoorDash credits earned through this DashPass Pickup Benefit are promotional credits as described in DoorDash’s Promotional Offers and Credits Terms and Conditions and are subject to expiration.

Q: Can I combine this benefit to earn credit back with another promo?

A: No, you cannot redeem the code to earn credit back on an eligible Pickup order if another promotion, offer, or discount is applied to that order. However, you can apply the available credit balance as a payment method while also redeeming another promo code on the same order.

Q: When will I get my credit back?

A: We’ll deposit credit into your account once your order is marked complete, which may take up to an hour in some cases.

Q: How do I know how much credit I have in my account?

A: You can find your available credit balance in the same place you manage other payment methods by tapping ‘Payment’ in your ‘Account’ tab.

Q: Does this benefit work on Caviar?

A: As a DashPass subscriber, you’ll be able to earn credit back on Pickup orders placed on both DoorDash and Caviar. However, credit earned on DoorDash will be deposited into your DoorDash account as “DoorDash credit,” which is only available to be applied toward orders placed on DoorDash. Credit earned on Caviar will be deposited into your Caviar account as “Caviar credit” and can only be applied toward orders placed on Caviar.

Q: DashPass Pickup Benefit Terms and Conditions:

A: Only available to select DashPass subscribers as indicated in their account. Credits are promotional credits as described in DoorDash’s Promotional Offers and Credits Terms and Conditions. Credits only earned on eligible Pickup orders with participating DashPass merchants. Credits cannot be earned, but may be redeemed, on Group orders. Credits will not be earned if other promotions are applied to the order. Credit calculated on order subtotal; max. credit of $100 per order. After the order is complete, credit will be awarded to the user’s account and automatically applied to the next order, whether Delivery or Pickup. All orders are subject to availability. Must have or create a valid DoorDash account on the latest available version of the application with a valid form of accepted payment on file. No cash value. Non-transferable. May not be exchanged or redeemed for cash or any equivalent, and are not intended as payment. Cannot be applied to the purchase of alcohol where prohibited. May not be combined with any other promotion unless otherwise permitted. Cannot be applied to the purchase of gift cards unless otherwise permitted. The maximum amount of DoorDash credits that may be earned is $600 per person per year. Credits will be issued in the currency of the country associated with your DoorDash account and can only be applied to orders in that country. DoorDash reserves the right to modify, suspend, terminate, or discontinue the pickup credit benefit at any time without any notice to customers. In the event of termination or modification of the benefit, customers will not be entitled to any substitute, credit, or compensation for unredeemed credits. See further offer terms and conditions here.

Must have an active DashPass subscription with the latest available version of the DoorDash application, with a valid form of accepted payment on file in order to be eligible for the benefit. This DashPass Pickup Credit Benefit is governed by the DashPass Terms and by DoorDash’s Promotional Offers and Credits Terms and Conditions.

DashPass Rewards Card Rewards Program Terms and Conditions

DashPass Rewards Card Rewards Program Terms and Conditions

By activating and using your DashPass Rewards Visa Prepaid card (“DashPass Rewards Card”), you agree to be bound by and comply with these DashPass Rewards Card Rewards Program Terms and Conditions (“Rewards Program Terms and Conditions”).

These Rewards Program Terms and Conditions are subject to and should be read in conjunction with the DoorDash DashPass Rewards Visa® PrePaid Card Cardholder Agreement, the DoorDash Consumer Terms and Conditions, the DoorDash’s Promotional Credits Terms and Conditions, and DashPass Rewards Card Electronic Communications Disclosure, the DoorDash Consumer Privacy Policy, Lincoln Savings Bank Privacy Policy, and the Pay by Bank Terms.

Rewards Program: The DashPass Rewards Card provides you with the opportunity to earn rewards in the form of DoorDash credits when making eligible purchases using their DashPass Rewards Card (“Rewards Program”).

Eligibility: To participate in the Rewards Program, you must reside in the US, have an active DashPass Rewards Card linked to a checking account, and an active DashPass membership in good standing. Additionally, you must be at least 18 years of age or, in the case of account holders residing in states where the age of majority exceeds 18 years of age, have attained the age of majority in the state in which you reside. DoorDash has the right to determine in its sole discretion whether a particular cardholder is eligible to participate in the Rewards Program. You will automatically be enrolled in the Rewards Program after activating your DashPass Rewards.

Data Sharing and Usage: In order to provide and operate the Rewards Program, DoorDash will receive and use prepaid debit card data and all Transaction Data from Lincoln Savings Bank to:

  • Monitor your transactions and determine which qualify for or have earned rewards and provide you with credit or other rewards or benefits.

  • Target offers that may be of interest to you in the future.

  • Analyze the data to measure the effectiveness of the Rewards Program and create performance reports that may be shared with Participating Merchants, vendors, or offer networks.

  • Provide Transaction Data to participating merchants or their agents to facilitate and administer the Rewards Program, to validate qualifying transactions, and assess the results of campaigns.

“Transaction Data” means merchant name, merchant location or other store identifier, transaction date, transaction amount, the last 4 digits of your credit card, and any other information that Lincoln Savings Bank may make available to us in connection with your card activity.

You authorize Lincoln Savings Bank, financial intermediaries, card networks, program managers, and providers of payment processing or other technology services (collectively, the “Card Related Parties”) to provide DoorDash with Transaction Data for these purposes. You may opt out of the above-referenced data sharing by terminating your Card Account.

For more information on how we use your Transaction Data, see the “What Personal Information does DoorDash collect or process” section of the DoorDash Privacy Policy.

Earnings Rewards: After enrollment, you may earn rewards by making purchases using your DashPass Rewards Card in accordance with the transaction types listed below.

On Platform Spend

Any purchases you make on the DoorDash platform using your DashPass Rewards Card will earn a % back of the order subtotal in the form of DoorDash credits. The subtotal value will not include any fees, taxes, or gratuity and will also not include any promotional discounts or the value of any DoorDash credits used to purchase the order. The value of your % back earned in credits can be found within the DashPass Rewards Card page within your DoorDash app. To access this page, open your app, click ‘me’ (in the bottom right-hand corner), click settings, and then click “DashPass Rewards Card.”

In-store purchases at ALDI, Meijer, Dollar General & 7-Eleven

Any in-store purchases you make at select ALDI, Meijer, Dollar General & 7-Eleven will earn 5% credit back of the order subtotal in the form of DoorDash credits. The subtotal value will not include any fees, taxes or gratuity and will also not include any promotional discounts. The value of rewards earned from these in-store purchases will be capped at $25 per day across all participating merchants.

In-store purchases in Detroit

You may also earn rewards by using your DashPass Rewards Card to make purchases at select stores in the Detroit, Michigan area. To find participating stores, see the ‘Rewards’ tab in the DoorDash app. The reward earned from these purchases will be $5 in DoorDash credit, subject to the purchases having a subtotal of $15 or greater. The subtotal value will not include any fees, taxes or gratuity and will also not include any promotional discounts. You will be limited to earning $5 in DoorDash credits per day at each participating location.

Bonus Reward: You will earn a one-off reward of $100 in DoorDash credits if you spend $1,500 on your DashPass Rewards Card within 3 months of activating your DashPass Rewards Card (“Bonus Reward”). The Bonus Reward is strictly limited to one per customer.

Limitations on earnings: In addition to the limits stated above, DoorDash may set further limits on the amount of DoorDash credits you may earn. These limits may apply to the value of DoorDash credits earned on each purchase or the sum of DoorDash credits earned within a period of time (e.g., a limitation on the amount of DoorDash credits that you may earn in a day or a year).

Exclusions: Whether a purchase qualifies for earnings rewards will be at DoorDash’s sole discretion, and DoorDash reserves the right to exclude certain purchases from earning rewards without prior notice. In particular, DoorDash may exclude purchases containing restricted items from earning rewards in its sole discretion without prior notice.

Calculating rewards: The amount of DoorDash credits earned for each qualifying purchase is determined solely by DoorDash. All reward values assigned by DoorDash to qualifying purchases are final and not subject to dispute.

Redeeming your rewards: DoorDash credits earned through the Rewards Program will be automatically deposited into your DoorDash account on a regular basis. For example, Rewards earned from Monday through Sunday will be automatically added to your DoorDash account as DoorDash credits by the end of the following week, typically on Friday. DoorDash reserves the right to deposit earned credits at any time and not necessarily on a weekly basis.

DoorDash credits may be used solely for purchases on the DoorDash platform in accordance with DoorDash’s Promotional Credits Terms and Conditions. DoorDash credits expire 6 (six) months from the date of issue, credits may expire earlier if your DoorDash account is deactivated or deleted. DoorDash credits may not be redeemed for cash or cash equivalent and do not have a cash value; DoorDash credits can only be redeemed for DoorDash orders on www.doordash.com or in the DoorDash app with the latest version, and within DoorDash service areas and service hours. DoorDash credits cannot be applied to the purchase of alcohol where prohibited. DoorDash credits apply to order subtotals only and do not apply to fees, taxes, or gratuity. DoorDash credits may not be combined with any other offer unless otherwise permitted. DoorDash credits cannot be applied to the purchase of any gift cards unless otherwise permitted. DoorDash credits may differ from other types of DoorDash credits that you may receive, including credits that you have purchased (“Purchased Credits”), which are governed by the DoorDash Purchased Credits Terms and Conditions.

Adjustments: DoorDash reserves the right to make adjustments to and revoke your rewards as the result of canceled transactions, fraudulent transactions, refunds, or other credits from merchants (including those resulting from successful transaction disputes). If DoorDash determines that an adjustment is required due to a canceled transaction, fraudulent transaction, refund, credit from a merchant, or any other reason,n DoorDash may revoke your DoorDash credits and may also adjust the value of your rewards that have been accrued but not yet deposited as DoorDash credits into your account.

Removal from Rewards Program: DoorDash reserves the right to remove you from the Rewards Program, cancel your DashPass Rewards Card, cancel your DashPass subscription, and revoke any awarded rewards at any time and at its sole discretion without notice. DoorDash may exercise its right under this provision for any reason, including without limitation (i) you no longer meet the eligibility requirements of the Rewards Program, and (ii) DoorDash suspects or has reason to suspect that you are acting or attempting to act in a fraudulent manner.

Modification; Termination. DoorDash reserves the right to modify, suspend, terminate, or discontinue the Rewards Program at any time without any notice to users. This may include amending how rewards are earned and the value of rewards earned under the Rewards Program. In the event of termination or modification of the Reward Program, users will not be entitled to any substitute, credit, or compensation for any unredeemed or accrued DoorDash credits. DoorDash further reserves the right to amend these Rewards Program Terms and Conditions at any time without notice.

Release: You hereby release and hold harmless DoorDash and the Card Related Parties from any liability, claim, or damage relating to the Rewards Program or the information shared with DoorDash. Specifically, to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, the Card Related Parties and their respective employees, officers, directors and agents will not be liable for damages of any kind, under any legal theory, arising out of or in connection with your access to or use of the Rewards Program or any information, products, or other content (including that of third parties) included in or accessible through the Rewards Program (or information shared by the Card Related Parties as described above), including, but not limited to, any direct, indirect, special, incidental, consequential, exemplary or punitive damages of any kind, including, but not limited to, personal injury, pain and suffering, emotional distress, loss of revenue, loss of profits, loss of business or anticipated savings, loss of use, loss of goodwill, loss of data, and whether caused by tort (including negligence), breach of contract, or otherwise, even if foreseeable.

Support: For support relating to the DashPass Rewards Card or the Rewards Program, please call (877) 805-2133.

4. HOW TO ENTER

During the Sweepstakes Period, eligible individuals may receive entries in one of the following ways (each an “Entry”). Sponsor may assign eligible participants to one of two program variants (T1 or T2) in its sole discretion. Entry limits and mechanics differ by variant, as described below.

A. Entry Through Qualifying Purchase

Eligible participants may earn Entries by completing qualifying orders on the DoorDash platform, as described in the participant’s in-app messaging, account dashboard, or promotional materials. The Sponsor may assign participants to one of the following variants, including the required number of qualifying orders, such as 2 or 4, and the applicable 30-day challenge period(s).:

  • Variant T2 (Multiple Mystery Prize Opportunities): Participants may receive up to four (4) Entries per thirty (30) day challenge period by completing the required number of qualifying orders for each Entry, as shown in-app (e.g., 2 or 4 qualifying orders). 314 W Superior St, Suite 502

Chicago IL, 60654

Entry limits depend on the variant to which the participant is assigned:

Please read this Section 8 carefully. It requires that any and all claims between you and DoorDash be resolved by binding arbitration or in small claims court or tribunal and, to the extent permitted by applicable law, prevents you from pursuing a class action or similar proceeding in any forum.

(a) Scope of Arbitration Agreement. This Arbitration Agreement shall apply, without limitation, to all claims that arose or were asserted before, on, or after the effective date of this Agreement. You agree that any dispute or claim arising out of or relating in any way to the subject matter of the Agreement will be resolved by binding arbitration, rather than in court, except as otherwise required by law or as otherwise provided in this Arbitration Agreement.
